Assistant Research Officer
Division of Science
(Post Ref.: 26/159 )
The Division of Science ( http://www.LN.edu.hk/dos ) would like to invite applications for the above-mentioned post.
The appointee will join the Applied Ecology and Conservation Laboratory led by Dr. Roger Lee ( https://www.ln.edu.hk/dos/about-us/ourteam/rogerlee ) and will be involved in a hiking trail monitoring project focusing on recreation impacts in Hong Kong.
Responsibilities
• Field surveys along the MacLehose Trail to monitor and document recreation impacts
• Trail condition measurement and assessment, including tracking soil erosion, vegetation degradation, and trail widening
• Data processing and spatial analyses using GIS and remote sensing techniques to map habitat changes
• Prepare educational and public outreach materials to promote sustainable hiking and conservation awareness based on project findings
• Other education and research-related duties assigned
Requirements
• A recognized bachelor’s degree (or above) in geography, earth/environmental sciences, life sciences, biology, or related disciplines
• Proven field survey experience, with a strong passion for hiking, ecological research, and biodiversity conservation
• Practical experience or proficiency in GIS software (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) and habitat mapping
• An outstanding level of physical fitness, including the ability to conduct demanding, full-day outdoor fieldwork carrying equipment in rough terrain
• Good organization and communication skills (both written and spoken) for compiling research data and creating clear public educational content
Applicants with prior experience in GIS and habitat mapping are highly encouraged to apply for this position.
Salary and Benefits
The commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits and mandatory provident fund.
Appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract for a period of up to 12 months with the possibility of a further extension on related research projects.
Application Procedure (online applications only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will start immediately and continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

0130f3a397f68fc2151ee8f3.description:
Department/ Unit: Faculty of Law
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Faculty of Law at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK LAW) is among the most dynamic and accomplished law schools in Asia. Since welcoming its inaugural cohort in 2006, CUHK LAW has experienced remarkable growth, both in scale and international stature. With a strong global outlook, our academic staff represent nearly twenty jurisdictions through their origins or training.
CUHK LAW is now inviting applications for appointment(s) as Professional Consultant(s). Professional Consultants primarily focus on teaching courses in the Postgraduate Certificate in Laws (PCLL) programme, as well as core and elective common law subjects in the LLB, JD, and LLM programmes.
Applicants should possess: (i) a law degree from a recognized university and/or a relevant professional qualification for legal practice; (ii) at least two years of post-qualification experience as a solicitor or barrister in Hong Kong, or its equivalent in another common law jurisdiction; and (iii) experience in teaching law or demonstrable aptitude for legal education.
Candidates with expertise in the following areas are of particular interest: Writing and Drafting Commercial Documents (English and Chinese), Commercial Practice, China Practice, and Banking and Finance. Applications from highly qualified individuals with other areas of expertise may also be considered.
The appointee(s) will perform duties assigned by the Faculty Dean, including but not limited to: (a) teaching at the CUHK Graduate Law Centre in Central and the CUHK campus in Shatin; (b) contributing to curriculum development and supporting programme administration; (c) serving as academic advisor(s) to students; and (d) undertaking administrative duties and providing service to CUHK LAW, the College, and/or the University, as appropriate.
The appointment(s) will initially be made on a contract basis for up to three years, renewable subject to mutual agreement and satisfactory performance.
Applicants are required to complete the online application form and upload the following documents: a full curriculum vitae; a statement of teaching philosophy and/or methodology (maximum 2 pages); copies of qualification documents; and contact details of three referees who have agreed to provide references. Applicants with current or prior law school teaching experience should also include teaching evaluations. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.
CUHK LAW is firmly committed to fostering diversity and warmly encourages applications from candidates whose backgrounds and experiences will enrich the diversity of our faculty. Further details about CUHK LAW can be found at http://www.cuhk.edu.hk/law .
Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until the relevant teaching needs of the Faculty have been met. We regret that we will only be able to contact candidates selected for further consideration.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

COUNSELLING & DEVELOPMENT CENTRE
Student Development Officer (Part-time) (26270138)
The appointee will join the Unit for Students with Special Educational Needs (USSEN), supporting a range of inclusion programmes and activities.
Responsibilities:
Coordinate experiential learning opportunities, inclusive programmes, and wellness activities;
Provide administrative support for the Unit’s daily operations;
Identify and engage potential service providers; and
Perform other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
A recognised bachelor's degree with at least two years of relevant work experience in a tertiary institution or public organisation;
An excellent command of written and spoken English, Chinese and Putonghua;
Good analytical abilities, strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as good computer skills;
Skills and experience in graphic design, social media management, and content creation are preferred;
A strong sense of commitment, proactivity, and a good learning attitude; and
Be detail-minded and able to work independently.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a one‑year fixed‑term contract.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after the closing date may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Closing date: 11 September 2026

Associate Professor of Teaching / Assistant Professor of Teaching
Department of Management
(Post Ref.: 26/32 )
The Department of Management ( http://www.LN.edu.hk/mgt/ ) is one of the constituent departments that contribute to the undergraduate programme of Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons) degree. The Department offers a variety of courses in Management and aims to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and qualifications to meet the needs of a thriving business centre like Hong Kong.
The primary responsibilities of the appointee include teaching and supporting the University’s educational mission. The appointee is expected to teach a variety of core and elective courses, develop new programmes, courses, teaching methods and procedures to enhance students’ learning. Additionally, appointee is encouraged to apply for teaching grants, organize knowledge transfer activities, and take responsibility for facilitating such initiatives. Candidates with advanced qualifications and more extensive experience may be considered for higher-level appointments.
General Requirements
For appointment as Associate Professor of Teaching / Assistant Professor of Teaching , candidates should have a doctoral degree in the relevant discipline, with a distinguished teaching record with professional recognition through leadership in the field of education, and should commit to teaching excellence, curriculum development, programme coordination, promotion and management, student advising and mentoring.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The rank and remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on a fixed-term contract of up to three years.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click Apply Now to submit your application. Applicants should provide a CV and information about their work experience, qualifications, research interests and achievements. A statement of their publications and of any works in progress currently under review are required. Applicants should provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

072c6c41011c0b0922412ff6.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Management
Closing Date: Until the position(s) is/ are filled
The Department of Management at the CUHK Business School is now inviting applications for faculty position(s) at the Professor/ Associate Professor levels commencing in 202 7 . Applications are invited from qualified scholars with expertise in macro management (e.g., strategy, innovation, entrepreneurship, international business, family business, sustainability, etc.) or micro management (e.g., organizational behavior, leadership, human resource management, etc.).
Applicants should possess (i) a PhD degree in management or a related discipline; (ii) excellent teaching performance, particularly in delivering graduate courses; (iii) a sound track record of publications in top-tier journals; and (iv) strong commitment to service at Faculty and Departmental levels. The appointee(s) will teach courses mainly at the graduate level, such as MBA, EMBA, DBA and MSc courses; publish high-quality scholarly research; and participate in academic and professional activities. He/she is expected to actively bid for competitive external funding support for research endeavors.
Appointment will commence in 202 7 . Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
Salary will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The University offers a comprehensive fringe benefit package, including medical care and housing benefits for eligible appointee(s).
About the Department of Management
The Department of Management offers three specialized concentrations in Entrepreneurship (ENT), Human Resource Management (HRM), and Management of International Business (MIB) in the Integrated BBA Programme, and two Master’s Programmes in Management and Sustainable Global Business. Our competitive curriculum equips students with cutting-edge knowledge in management, a global outlook, an innovative spirit, and a strong sense of social responsibility and integrity, enabling future business leaders to lead transformative initiatives worldwide. For more information about the Department, please visit our website at https://www.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/departments/management/ .
About CUHK Business School
The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in the Asia Pacific.
The Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (MBA, MSc, MAcc, EMBA, DBA, MPhil, PhD) with over 6,500 students from 30+ countries/regions, as well as executive education programmes. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 4 9 ,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
- Accountancy
- Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
- Finance
- Decisions, Operations and Technology
- Management
- Marketing
Application Procedure
Applicants should submit the application package online via the CUHK career site (including a completed on-line application form, full resume, publication list, and evidence of teaching excellence, if any), and provide names and email addresses of at least three referees for providing reference.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .
Review of applications will be conducted on a rolling basis and will continue until the position(s) is/are filled. For enquiries, please contact the Department of Management via mgt@cuhk.edu.hk .
Interested scholars are welcome to connect with Department colleagues at upcoming major conferences to learn more about the Department. These include the 2026 AOM Conference (Philadelphia, US), the Department’s AOM Reception (Philadelphia Marriott Downtown, evening of 2 August), and the 2026 AIB Conference (Manchester, UK).

A strong understanding of user account life cycle management and access rights control
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

0963049ccc2e017beb6bd06d.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Mathematics
Closing date: Until the posts are filled
Founded in 1963, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a forward-looking comprehensive research university with a global vision and a mission to combine tradition with modernity, and to bring together China and the West. The Department of Mathematics in CUHK has developed a strong reputation in teaching and research. Many of the faculty members are internationally renowned and are recipients of prestigious awards and honours. The graduates are successful in both academia and industry. The Department is highly ranked internationally, e.g., it is 66th, 63rd and 42nd in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 QS World University Rankings, and 42nd, 56th and 51st in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 US News Rankings, respectively.
The Department is now inviting applications for substantiable-track faculty posts at all the academic levels, with the opportunity for a joint appointment between the Department and The Institute of Mathematical Sciences. Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree in mathematics or related disciplines; (ii) an established track record in research, including publications; and (iii) a demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching.
Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing August 2026, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to substantiation or longer-term appointment later.
Applicants please upload a full resume and attach copies of academic credentials, together with names and e-mail addresses of at least four referees (at least three on research and one on teaching) to whom the applicants' consent has been given for their providing references. Review of applications will begin on December 1, 2025 and will continue until the positions are filled.

Lecturer / Senior Lecturer / Assistant Professor / Associate Professor / Professor
Department of Social Work
Department of Social Work is inviting applications for full -time Lecturer, Senior
Lecturer, Assistant Professor , Associate Professor and Professor. Rank will
commensurate with qualifications and experience.
 Requirements for Lecturer / Senior Lecturer:
Candidates should have a master degree in social work or related disciplines, and
5 years of clinical practice experience as a social worker. Preference will be given
to applicants with at least two years of teaching experience at the undergraduate
level and conducting fieldwork supervision. Applicants are expected to take up
teaching task, fieldwork supervision and administrating task.
Applications should contain (a) application form, (b) a cover letter, and (c) a
complete CV.
 Requirements for Assistant Professor / Associate Professor / Professor:
Candidates should have a doctorate degree in social work or related disciplines,
and 5 years of clinical practice experience as a social worker. Preference will be
given to applicants with at least two years of teaching experience at the
undergraduate and postgraduate levels and a good track record in research and
publication. Applicants are expected to pursue an active research agenda.
Fields of specialization could include, but not limited to, children and family;
youth work; digital social work practice; support for children with special needs;
social service management; interdisciplinary collaboration; social policy and
advocacy. Proficiency in Chinese and English is required.
Applications should contain (a) application form, (b) a cover letter, (c) a complete
CV including list of publications, ( d) a sample of recent publications, and ( e) 3
references to be sent directly from the referees to the Executive Officer.
The appointment is contract-based and renewable upon mutual agreement.
Enquiry and application should be sent to the University Secretary at
recruit_ap@hksyu.edu.

Deadline: Open Until Filled
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Personal data collected will be used for
staff recruitment purpose only.

JC STEM Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (2026/27)
Postdoctoral Fellow
(Post Ref.: 26/666 )
Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education. It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a better world. Moving forward, Lingnan University is well positioned to take lead as a comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful research and innovations.
Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies. To foster interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students. With traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and critical thinking skills to thrive in the future. Subsequent to the establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric technology and social policies. Further information about Lingnan University is available at https://www.ln.edu.hk/ .
The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust (the Trust) has set up the Jockey Club STEM Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (formerly known as Jockey Club Global STEM Post-doctoral Fellowship for Translational Research and Application) and is now inviting applications from early career researchers from all over the world. The Fellowship will provide comprehensive support and unique opportunity to help STEM post-doctoral researchers develop their research and innovation career, expand their professional network and create social impact. The Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong is a Partner Organisation of this Fellowship.
The Fellowship
The Trust provides support for 3 years of full-time appointment for each awardee as Postdoctoral Fellow at the supporting university.
Terms and Benefits
a) a stipend of up to HK$579,200 per annum for three years, with additional 15% gratuity to be offered upon completion of the Fellowship;
b) a top-up amount of HK$10,000 per month will be provided to the appointee in addition to the basic salary;
c) academic development and exchange allowance: up to HK$32,000 per annum for three years;
d) research project seed funding: up to HK$389,000;
e) proof-of-concept ("PoC") fund: up to HK$500,000 (subject to the condition as set out in para.3 of the application guideline);
f) capacity building programmes to be offered by the Trust and its partner to enhance its translational capability, commercialisation readiness and exposure to industry and innovation ecosystems;
g) fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees.
Eligibility
Applicants should have obtained/ been conferred the first PhD degree or an equivalent qualification in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics disciplines on or after 1 January 2023 ; or will complete the required qualification on or before 31 December 2026 . (If the Applicant’s conferment date is after 31 December 2026, he/she must provide supporting documents required).
Applicants must be legally permitted to work in Hong Kong.
IMPORTANT NOTE : Candidates applying for this Fellowship will not be considered by RGC for the RGC Junior Research Fellow Scheme in the same year. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend the Commercialisation Workshop and Presentation Feedback Session arranged by the Trust.
Application Procedure
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application before 25 September 2026 . Applicants shall provide CVs, academic qualification proofs, and supporting documents. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will start from mid-September 2026 and continue until the posts are filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the posts advertised, or to fill the posts by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Language Education Institute
Instructor (Chinese Language) (several posts)
(Ref. 260512003)
The Language Education Institute (LEI), a new academic unit established on 1 July 2025, formulates policies, designs curricula and delivers teaching activities for the education of languages among students at PolyU, focusing mainly on the Chinese and English languages. LEI strives to become a regional and international leader in language education, particularly in the application of the latest technologies in language learning, teaching and assessment. It drives scholarship and best practices in language education among the PolyU community.
LEI comprises the Chinese Language Centre (CLC), English Language Centre (ELC) and Technology-Enhanced Language Education Centre (TELEC), which are constituent units with their own Directors. CLC and ELC offer service language teaching in Chinese and English for all students in the University while TELEC undertakes service language teaching using digital learning platforms and technological tools such as artificial intelligence and immersive technologies.
CLC and ELC are committed to excellence in learning and teaching and aim to strengthen students’ language proficiency and communication skills, foster independent and life‑long learning, and support whole‑person development. They provide Chinese and English language teaching services tailored to the diverse needs of the University’s students, delivering language enhancement and communication subjects, including AI as a Tool for Language Learning, in accordance with University requirements. In addition to curriculum‑based teaching, the Centres coordinate a range of co‑curricular learning activities to support students’ academic development and learning needs. Please visit the websites at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/clc/ and https://www.polyu.edu.hk/elc/ respectively for more information about CLC and ELC.
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) teach a range of courses in Chinese for Academic Purposes (CAP), Chinese for Specific Purposes (CSP) and communication skills for undergraduate students, with effective and responsible integration of AI/GenAI to enhance learning, teaching, and assessment;
(b) engage in Chinese language enhancement initiatives of the University, including workshops and support activities related to technology- and AI-enhanced language learning;
(c) participate in the pedagogical development and administration of teaching and learning activities, including promoting student language skills through technology-enhanced language teaching methods and responsible AI use; and
(d) perform any other duties as assigned by the Director of Language Education Institute or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a master’s degree in Applied Linguistics / Chinese Language/Literature / Chinese Language Education or a related discipline;
(b) preferably at least three years’ post-qualification relevant teaching experience at tertiary level;
(c) effective classroom teaching skills;
(d) demonstrated strong commitment to excellence in teaching;
(e) demonstrated pedagogic AI competencies for Chinese language education;
(f) an excellent command of written Chinese with proficiency in Putonghua (at least B2 level in Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi [PSC] or equivalent) and Cantonese; and
(g) the ability to use English as a working language.
Preference will be given to teachers with experience or expertise in incorporating GenAI in language teaching, expertise in discipline-related Chinese, digital literacies, assessment design, and supporting students to use AI tools for self-regulated language learning.
Preference may be given to those with relevant teaching experience in Chinese/Putonghua at tertiary level, including subjects offered to non-Chinese speaking students.
Applicants should indicate in their cover letter how their qualifications and experience would enable them to effectively perform the duties of the post.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
Consideration of applications will commence on 1 June 2026 .
Apply Now
Posting date: 12 May 2026

Part-time Lecturer, DAE (Clerical Work in Practice in Government), Faculty of Arts and Humanities [Ref. 2026/ACAD034]
Faculty of Arts and Humanities
The Faculty of Arts and Humanities at UOW College Hong Kong offers a diverse range of academic programmes, including two bachelor’s degree programmes, four associate degree programmes, and one diploma programme. We are dedicated to fostering a vibrant and intellectually stimulating environment for our students. Our faculty is a hub of intellectual curiosity and critical inquiry, offering a diverse range of programmes that prepare students for the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century. Our graduates are well-prepared for further studies and successful careers, equipped with the knowledge and skills from their respective disciplines.
Our curricula, designed by our experienced academic staff, aim to provide students with essential principles, concepts, and methodologies in their chosen fields of study. Our Faculty boasts a team of highly qualified academic staff from various parts of the world, including Hong Kong, Chinese Mainland, the UK, Japan, Korea, and Canada, creating a rich multinational and multicultural community.
To enhance the learning experience, we offer internationally recognized language assessment tests (PSC for Putonghua, DELE for Spanish, KLAT for Korean, and TCF for French) as well as IELTS preparatory courses. We also facilitate internships, field trips, corporate visits, academic seminars, competitions, and career talks with our long-term partner organizations, along with opportunities for overseas visits and exchanges to promote comprehensive student development.
We are currently recruiting a part-time lecturer to support teaching in Diploma of Applied Education (DAE) in Clerical Work in Practice in Government for a duration of 6 months starting 1 January 2027.
Duties
The appointee will be required to deliver a full-time, face-to-face Diploma of Applied Education course. He/she will be mainly responsible for the followings:
Conducting tutorials related to the recruitment of Clerical Grade in the Government,
Developing course materials;
Marking assignments and assessment scripts; and
Performing other related teaching and administrative duties.
Requirements
Applicants should meet the following requirements:
a degree in any disciplines;
well versed in the Clerical Grade in the Government;
at least two years of relevant work experience in related field. Retired officers in government with prior teaching experience are preferred.

Remuneration package will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Please submit a Cover Letter together with a Curriculum Vitae and a completed Application Form to UOWCHK, c/o Human Resources Unit, UOW College Hong Kong, 1/F, 18 Che Kung Miu Road, Tai Wai, N.T., Hong Kong or by Email: uowchk-hr@uow.edu.au . 0eca5067d35a986a5009f46e.description:
Information Manager
Information Technology Services Centre
(Post Ref.: 26/205)
Responsibilities
Lead and manage the database services team, provide technical guidance and resource allocation to ensure the stable and efficient operation of all database and application systems
Oversee the plan, architecture, and execution of the new ERP system setup, with a primary focus on database migration, data integrity, performance optimization, and seamless cutover from legacy systems
Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the performance, availability, and security of mission-critical application systems and database infrastructure
Provide technical support for UNIX and Linux system administration, including system setup, configuration, third-party software installation, patch upgrades, system monitoring, and health checks
Implement and maintain robust database and system backup strategies, disaster recovery (DR) plans, and high-availability (HA) solutions to ensure business continuity and minimize downtime
Collaborate with application development teams to optimize database schema design, complex PL/SQL, and index strategies to achieve maximum application efficiency
Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and database incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence
Maintain and enforce stringent system and database security procedures, including access control, role-based permissions, data encryption, and vulnerability management to comply with organizational policies and audit requirements
Manage the lifecycle of systems and databases, including version upgrades, capacity planning, and storage management to support future growth
Work in shifts and irregular hours as required
Performing any other duties as assigned by supervisors
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related discipline
Minimum 10 years of experience in system administration and database administration, with at least 2 years in a team leadership or supervisory capacity
Excellent system and database troubleshooting skills
Proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration
In-depth knowledge of RDBMS, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, and administration
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across development and infrastructure teams
Hands-on experience in script programming such as Linux shell script, Python, Perl or C will be an advantage
Candidates with less/more experience will also be considered for appointment at the relevant rank.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and gratuity.

Department of Biomedical Engineering
Assistant Professor in Biomedical Engineering
(Ref. 260601010)
The Department of Biomedical Engineering (BME) is one of the five academic departments in the Faculty of Engineering, and it offers a full spectrum of BME programmes, from BSc, MSc to PhD. The team is the first group to offer Biomedical Engineering related undergraduate programme in Hong Kong, and has made great achievements in BME education, innovative research, and technology transfer. Currently BME has four thematic research areas, including Biomedical Imaging, Instrumentation, Sensing and AI, Molecular, Cellular and Tissue Engineering, Sports and Neuromusculoskeletal Engineering, Prosthetics, Orthotics, Smart Ageing and Rehabilitation Engineering. It aims to conduct cutting-edge researches in these areas and nurture future leaders in prosthetics and orthotics, clinical engineering, medical instrumentation and sensors, and biological engineering by imparting interdisciplinary knowledge, innovative ideas, critical thinking and practical skills. Please visit the website at http://www.polyu.edu.hk/bme for more information about the Unit.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) teach at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, and contribute to programme and curriculum development;
(b) initiate innovative research projects that leads to publications in top-tier refereed journals and awards of external research grants;
(c) supervise student projects and theses;
(d) engage in industrial and scholarly research/consultancy activities;
(e) undertake academic and departmental administrative duties; and
(f) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Unit or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in Biomedical Engineering or Neurotechnology, with expertise in Biomedical Imaging or Brain Computer Interface or a related discipline;
(b) strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(c) good publication records;
(d) good networking ability; and
(e) excellent communication skills and the ability to use English as the medium of instruction.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Appointment will only be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract.
Consideration of applications will commence on 15 June 2026 until the position is filled.
Apply Now
Posting date: 1 June 2026

0fb4890e1f7a28d70799fff7.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Curriculum and Instruction
Closing Date: Until the position is filled
The Department of Curriculum and Instruction under the Faculty of Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a dynamic centre in the Asia-Pacific region for teaching and research in the broad areas of curriculum and instruction. In addition to Faculty-based undergraduate teacher education, Postgraduate Diploma in Education, Master of Education, Doctor of Education and PhD programmes, the Department offers several Master of Arts/ Science programmes as well as research supervision across a range of subject areas. The Faculty of Education of CUHK is an international centre for professional training and research in education. Detailed information about the Faculty of Education and the Department is available at http://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/ .
The Department invites applications for a full-time appointment as Senior Lecturer/ Lecturer in Curriculum Studies.
For Senior Lecturer, applicants should have (i) a relevant doctoral degree; and (ii) at least 8 years of post-doctoral relevant experience. Evidence of research and scholarly activities is also generally expected.
For Lecturer, applicants should have (i) a Master’s degree (preferably a doctoral degree in a relevant discipline); and (ii) at least 4 years of post-Master relevant experience. Applicants who possess a doctoral degree with less experience will also be considered.
Applicants should also have (a) a strong track record in teaching; (b) extensive professional experience, leadership services to schools and the education community; (c) good knowledge of the education systems of Hong Kong and its neighbouring communities; and (d) strong commitment to excellence in teaching. A good track record of pedagogical research and an initial record of refereed publications are added advantages.
The appointee will be responsible for curriculum development and teaching teacher education and higher degree programmes offered by the Faculty of Education. Supervision of teaching practice is also required.
Appointment will initially be made on a contract basis for up to two years, renewable subject to performance and mutual agreement.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. Applicants should complete the online application form and upload a full curriculum vitae with details of three referees.
Review of applications will start on March 16, 2026. Applications will be considered until the position is filled.
For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

111b9e0f8baae35e2f95b18b.deadline_raw: Closing Date: Until the post is filled The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP). RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
111b9e0f8baae35e2f95b18b.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Electronic Engineering
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP).
RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
The research focuses on advancing neuromorphic/physical computing, optical signal processing, integrated photonics. The research encourages interdisciplinary approaches that integrate photonics with artificial intelligence, and machine learning, communication systems and networks with the goal of developing new computing and signal-processing paradigms for next-generation intelligent systems.
Applicants should have:
(i) a PhD in Electronic Engineering, Optoelectronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline;
(ii) a strong track record of research and publications in reputable journals and conferences;
(iii) excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
(iv) potential to become an independent researcher in obtaining future/sustained extramural funding and establishing significant externally-funded research programmes;
The appointee will work closely with Prof. Chaoran Huang in the Department to enhance the existing strengths. The appointee is expected to:
(a) be able to have top-tier research outputs and apply for RGC GRF grants and similar external competitive grants;
(b) undertake some teaching duties at undergraduate and postgraduate levels; and
(c) provide service at departmental, faculty and/or university levels.
HOW TO APPLY
To apply, please upload a full resume, copies of academic credentials, a publication list with soft copies of the five most representative publications, details of courses taught and evaluation results (if available), a research plan, a teaching statement, and the names and contact information of three to five referees.
Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years, renewable subject to performance, funding availability and mutual agreement. Review of applications will begin as soon as possible and only shortlisted applicants will be notified. Applications will be accepted until the post is filled.
Further information about the Department is available at http://www.ee.cuhk.edu.hk/ .

1133443e837f5284d1c0a56b.description:
School of Architecture
Professor / Associate Professor (Landscape Architecture)
(Ref. 240001HB) Closing Date: Until the post is filled.
The Chinese University of Hong Kong is one of the world’s leading universities. Its location makes it one of the most exciting places to research and teach architecture. The School of Architecture has a world-class, research-led, and professionally connected learning environment. It embraces new approaches to architectural education and cross-disciplinary research that impact on society and the profession.
The School of Architecture at the Chinese University of Hong Kong is seeking an outstanding candidate to provide academic leadership for its new Master of Landscape Architecture (MLA) Programme. Applicants should possess (i) a PhD degree in Landscape Architecture, Planning, Architecture, Environmental Studies or a related discipline. Applicants with international recognition in the field will be highly appreciated.
Preference will be given to candidates with an active research agenda and/or design practice that addresses pressing environmental, ecological and urban challenges in the Asian region. We are particularly interested in candidates who can contribute to the development of interdisciplinary research and teaching that connect landscape architecture with allied built environment disciplines, including, but not limited to, Architecture, Urban Design and Planning.
Appointments will normally made on a contract basis for up to three years initially commencing August 2025, which, subject to performance, funding availability and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation later. Outstanding candidates may be considered for substantive appointment upon initial appointment.
To apply for the post, please complete the online application form, and submit a letter of interest, CV, portfolio, teaching statement, research statement, together with names/ e-mail addresses of three referees with consent for providing references. Appointment level and salary will be commensurate with the applicant’s qualifications and experience.
The CUHK School of Architecture is actively building a more diverse and inclusive environment. Qualified individuals from underrepresented sections of society are encouraged to apply. Enquiries may be directed to Ms. Sylvia Kwok, School Manager at arc.appointment@cuhk.edu.hk
Review of applications and shortlisting will start in July / August 2024 until the post is filled.

11ca63d6bdbb0cb3fda411c0.description:
Department/ Unit: The Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care is a leading institution in the Asia-Pacific region, dedicated to advancing excellence in public health and primary care through innovative education, impactful research, and meaningful community engagement. The School fosters strong international partnerships with schools of public health, government bodies, and centres for disease control in Mainland China and beyond. For more information, please visit http://www.sphpc.cuhk.edu.hk .
We are now seeking a motivated and forward-thinking individual to join us as a Clinical Professional Consultant in Family Medicine or Public Health Medicine. A courtesy title of Associate Professor of Practice in a related clinical specialty may be granted to appointee, subject to their professional qualifications and recognized clinical experience within the field.
Applicants should possess:
(i) a medical qualification registrable with the Medical Council of Hong Kong;
(ii) at least three years of relevant experience in family medicine, primary care, health services, or related fields; a recognized higher professional qualification in family medicine will be an advantage;
(iii) strong strategic thinking and planning abilities, a proactive and collaborative work ethic, and well-developed problem-solving skills;
(iv) experience in teaching at the tertiary level, with a passion for nurturing future healthcare professionals; and
(v) professional proficiency in written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese). Proficiency in Putonghua will be an advantage.
The appointee will play a key role in shaping medical education and will be responsible for:
(a) delivering high-quality teaching and providing student supervision;
(b) contributing to and coordinating the development of innovative teaching and training curricula, with a particular focus on medical programmes; and
(c) undertaking other academic and administrative duties as required.
This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a dynamic academic environment and to influence the development of future leaders in primary care and public health. The appointment will be offered on a contract basis for up to three years, commencing as soon as possible, with the possibility of renewal subject to performance and mutual agreement.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

161437af2f01ac67ea300039.description:
Department/ Unit: Zhizhen School of Interdisciplinary Mathematical Sciences
Closing date: Until the posts are filled
Founded in 1963, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a forward-looking comprehensive research university with a global vision and a mission to combine tradition with modernity, and to bring together China and the West.
CUHK has established the Zhizhen School of Interdisciplinary Mathematical Sciences ("Zhizhen School" or "the School"). It aims to cultivate mathematical science talent in Hong Kong, aligning with the national aspiration to building China into a leading country in education, as well as the 14th Five-Year Plan’s vision of strengthening basic research. This also aligns with the aspiration in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government’s policy address to develop Hong Kong as an international hub for post-secondary education and establish the “Study in Hong Kong” brand. Professor Shing-tung Yau is the Founding Director of Zhizhen School.
The School will offer an eight-year training programme similar to that of Qiuzhen College in Tsinghua University which includes three years of mathematical foundation training, two years of scientific research training and three years of doctoral training. Students who fulfil the general academic and whole-person education graduation requirements will be awarded CUHK Bachelor and PhD degrees. The School will build a team of world-class scholars, who will participate in high-level scientific research, lead various academic activities of the School, and also be responsible for teaching and supervising students and postdoctoral fellows.
The School is now inviting applications for substantiable-track faculty posts at all the academic levels.
Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree in mathematics or related disciplines; (ii) an established track record in research, including publications; and (iii) a demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing August 2025, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to substantiation or longer-term appointment later.
Applicants please upload a full resume and attach copies of academic credentials, together with names and e-mail addresses of three to five referees (at least two on research and one on teaching) to whom the applicants' consent has been given for their providing references.
Review of applications will begin on May 15, 2025, and will continue until the positions are filled.

16dc5c63c15f3ec13b74d56f.department: Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
16dc5c63c15f3ec13b74d56f.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
The Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care is based at the Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH), a 1,637 bed tertiary referral teaching hospital managed by the Hospital Authority (HA) and affiliated with The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK). The hospital provides a wide range of acute specialist services, including both a cardiac and trauma centre. Each year we deliver anaesthetic services for 14,000 operations in the main operating theatre, with one third being emergency cases. An additional 2000 anaesthetics are administered in the labour ward and other areas outside the operating theatre suite. The Intensive Care Unit provides adult medical and surgical critical care for approximately 1700 patients per year.
Applicants should have (i) a medical qualification (approved for registration with The Medical Council of Hong Kong); (ii) experience/strong interest in anaesthesia and/or intensive care; and (iii) preferably some teaching experience. A good command of spoken and written English is required (proficiency in Cantonese will be an advantage but not essential).
Duties include (a) providing high quality clinical services in anaesthesia and intensive care; (b) teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses; and (c) other duties as assigned by the Department Chairman.
Appointment will be made on contract basis for one year, renewable subject to mutual agreement and satisfactory performance.

174dbd431ce499820ad26d24.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Application Development & Support) (Ref. No.: 26270115)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities:
The candidate will focus on application support, design, development, and system enhancement, contributing to DevOps practices that streamline deployment, improve system stability, and support continuous improvement
Map, analyze, and document interfaces between legacy systems and new platforms, ensuring seamless integration and efficient, reliable data exchange
Perform end‑to‑end software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
Design and develop innovative application solutions and contribute to product and system enhancement initiatives
Enhance and modernize existing legacy applications to support institutional transformation and evolving operational needs
Prepare and maintain comprehensive testing and system documentation, ensuring quality, reliability, and adherence to delivery timelines
Produce clear and user‑friendly manuals to support effective adoption and optimal utilization of new systems
Collaborate closely with IT colleagues and business users on institution‑wide IT initiatives and projects
Perform other IT projects and assignments as assigned
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant work experience in end‑to‑end application development, covering front‑end, back‑end, and database design and development, with experience in responsive design and system integration. (Candidates with less relevant experience are welcome to apply and may be considered for an associate-level role)
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

18ff4533f061e298b22e621c.description:
Associate Professor/Assistant Professor
Division of Artificial Intelligence
(Post Ref.: 25/72)
The Division is looking for an experienced Associate Professor/Assistant Professor who will (1) conduct high-quality research in the state-of-the-art areas in artificial intelligence, natural language processing, large language models, and computer vision; (2) secure external competitive research grants in various funding bodies; (3) teach multiple subjects in both undergraduate-level and postgraduate-level programs in data science areas focusing on industrial data sciences, blockchain, data sciences, artificial intelligence, etc.; (4) work on the promotions and admissions as well as the operations for undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, and (5) contribute to other administrative duties as required by the supervisors.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (i) a doctoral degree in a relevant data science, computer science, artificial intelligence, information engineering, or other relevant areas; (ii) a strong publication record and outstanding citation counts in the research areas; (iii) experience in applying external grants and teaching relevant courses and relevant programme administrative experience will be advantages; (iv) good command of English and Chinese (including Mandarin). For the post of Associate Professor, six years of relevant experience in the tenure-track academic post should be required. The candidates with less experience will be considered as Assistant Professor.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The rank and remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees. Appointments will normally be made on a fixed-term contract of up to three years.
Appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of three years, which, subject to review and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment with possibility of consideration for substantiation.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the posts are filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the posts advertised, or to fill the posts by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

198cc08c019d842e65590db3.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Senior System Engineer) (Ref. No.: 26270053)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high-performing IT infrastructure and operations team to support the School's ongoing digital transformation and future growth. We are seeking a motivated and technically capable professional who is passionate about modern IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and delivering reliable technology services that enable business success.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of the IT infrastructure team, reporting to Information Technical Manager, working closely with users, application team, vendors, and technology partners to maintain and enhance the School's Microsoft ecosystem, network environment, and security posture. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting day-to-day IT operations, administering Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity platforms, managing network and server infrastructure, and contributing to infrastructure modernization initiatives that support the School's evolving digital landscape.
Key Responsibilities:
Core Infrastructure Management: Support deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Microsoft infrastructure including Windows Server, AD DS, Entra ID, Group Policy, and Intune.
M365 Administration: Manage daily operations of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive, ensuring service health, configuration accuracy, and policy compliance.
Routine Server Operation: Conduct daily health checks, including reviewing logs, backups, disk usage, and service status. Perform housekeeping tasks, monitor server room equipment (power, cooling, cabling), and report abnormalities to ensure availability and proper functioning.
Managing Network infrastructure: Deploy and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices to ensure optimal performance and security.
Performance Monitoring: Monitor system and network performance, identify and resolve issues to minimize downtime and maintain service availability.
Updates and Maintenance: Participate in system and network updates and maintenance activities , including patch management and routine system upgrades.
IT projects support: Assist with documentation, testing, and deployment activities. Contribute to initiatives such as SSO integration and system improvements.
Perform ad hoc assignments and responsibilities requested by supervisor.
Required skills and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
At least 5 years of hands-on working experience in supporting Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, DNS, GPOs, Exchange & SharePoint Online, MS Teams, Intune, Cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS).
Solid experience in managing enterprise network environment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.
Solid understanding of cybersecurity technologies and best practices, including Microsoft Defender, EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, and endpoint protection.
Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently manage incidents and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues.
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Professional certifications are highly desirable, including: Microsoft, public cloud (Azure/AWS), VMware, ITIL; CISSP is a plus.
Candidates with more extensive experience may be considered for the position of Assistant Information Technology Manager (Infrastructure).
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered a one-year contract (up to 31 August 2027). Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

1c30a3feb6e270ad775fbc05.description:
Full-time /Part-time Academic Position in Business Administration
Department of Business Administration
The Department of Business Administration invites applications for full - time/part-time
Lecturer/Senior Lecturer/Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor .
Applicants should possess doctoral/master qualifications in relevant business discipline.
Fields of specialization include, but are not limited to human resource management,
digital marketing, applied business psychology, AI/IT business application s , and
business analytics.
Applicants should have a good command of both written and spoken English and
Chinese. Excellent communication skills and the ability to use Putonghua and
Simplified Chinese as the primary language of instruction will be highly advantageous.
Preference will also be given to those applicants who have at least two years of teaching
experience, a good track record in research and publication, and good academic and/or
professional experience in teaching at the higher education level (bachelor and/or
master).
The appointment is contract-based and renewable upon mutual agreement. Salary will
be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure
Applicants should apply by sending:
(1) a cover letter;
(2) a s tatement of teaching and research;
(3) a complete CV ( including a list of publications);
(4) at least two representative publications (within recent 5 years);
(5) three references to be sent directly from the referees; and
(6) the application form which can be downloaded from
https://www.hksyu.edu/en/about/career/
Please send the above documents to the University Secretary via email
recruit_ap@hksyu.edu . For further information about the Department, please visit
https://ba.hksyu.edu/.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Personal data received will be used for
recruitment purposes only. The posts are open until filled and all applications will
receive full consideration.

1c4ff0b5a25c3414fa56d40c.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Human Resources Manager (26270049)
The School aims to complete registration as a post-secondary college within one or two years, committed to enhancing the internationalisation and diversification of higher education, and developing distinctive and professional programmes that address the manpower needs of society. Once this strategic development is solidified, it is planned that the role will evolve with a long-term prospect.
The appointee will be assigned to the Human Resources Section of the School to perform duties including recruitment and appointment, benefits administration, performance assessment, preparation of staff statistical reports, arrangement of staff training and development, supervision of Officers and clerical staff in daily operation of work. The appointee will be required to support the implementation and rollout of the new HCMS across departments. The appointee will also assist in policy and operation review, system development, and committee work.
Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in human resources management or related disciplines with at least seven years of relevant work experience;
Strong knowledge of Hong Kong employment legislation and HR best practices;
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills;
Excellent command of both written and spoken English and Chinese. Competency in computing applications and data extraction, processing and analysis are essential; and
Preference will be given to those with experience in HRMS platforms and data migration tools.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of applications may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

1d2d068ebb9052587024af92.description:
Senior Programme Officer
Division of Artificial Intelligence
(Post Ref.: 26/14)
Responsibilities
The appointee is expected to:
• Assist the programme director/coordinator in preparing the programme proposal and conduct relevant surveys
• Perform a wide range of administrative duties to ensure the smooth operation of the programme, including programme management and operation as well as admission and promotion
• Carry out various programme administrative tasks such as promotion, timetabling, scheduling programme courses and seminars and other teaching and learning activities, and other tasks pertaining to course operations
• Administer the admission, registration, document verification and visa application processes
• Coordinate administrative processes for course arrangement, examinations, student activities, course evaluations, and events
• Handle purchases, reimbursement, payments and other financial and budgeting matters
• Liaise with internal and external parties
• Handle quality assurance related matters such as secretary duties related to various committees
• Prepare annual programme report and other required reports as well as data reporting to various units of the university
• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor
Requirements
• A recognized bachelor's degree with at least four years of relevant experience, preferably in the tertiary education sector
• Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (including Putonghua)
• High level of competence in computer literacy
• Willingness to assume various responsibilities with a passionate attitude
• Proactive mindset and strong analytical ability to carry out duties independently and efficiently with minimum supervision
Salary and Benefits
The commencing salary will be competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, and gratuity.

Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.

1ed2bf418887d642f362dc0e.deadline_raw: Closing Date: Until the posts are filled The Department of Psychiatry at the Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is recruiting Research Assistant Professor(s )/ Assistant Professor(s) (non-clinical) within the following research areas:- Neuroscience
1ed2bf418887d642f362dc0e.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Psychiatry
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
The Department of Psychiatry at the Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is recruiting Research Assistant Professor(s )/ Assistant Professor(s) (non-clinical) within the following research areas:-
Neuroscience
Sleep and circadian
Digital mental health
This is an exciting opportunity for outstanding young investigators to play a leading role in advancing mental health research programmes related to the above-mentioned research areas at CUHK.
The successful candidates are expected to (i) hold a PhD degree in a relevant field with post-doctoral experience; and (ii) have ample experiences in the field of any of the above-mentioned research areas and mental health, as evidenced by publications in international journals.
They must have passion to advance by establishing a dynamic, creative and internationally oriented research group and attract external research funding.
Appointment of Research Assistant Professor(s) will initially be made on contract basis for up to two years commencing as soon as possible, renewable subject to good performance, funding availability and mutual agreement.
Appointment of Assistant Professor(s) (non-clinical) will normally be made on contract basis for up to two years initially, which, subject to good performance, funding availability and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
Applicants should complete the on-line application form and upload the followings:
• A full curriculum vitae;
• Copies of academic credentials;
• A full list of the applicant's scientific publications indicating the five most important publications;
• Copies of all publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated;
• A brief survey of the applicant's most important research results and research plans for the next three years, including research management and research grants; and
• An outline of how the applicant’s future research strategy would build on current research, identifying how it would complement existing research in the above-mentioned research areas and mental health research programmes of CUHK.

SCHOOL OF CREATIVE ARTS
Manager (26270093)
The School of Creative Arts (SCA), comprised of three well-established academic units: the Academy of Film, the Academy of Music, and the Academy of Visual Arts. Established on July 1, 2022, SCA is dedicated to nurturing future-ready talents for Hong Kong and beyond, while making a significant impact on society through innovative research and transdisciplinary studies.
SCA is looking for a proactive and resourceful Manager to support its portfolio of education, cultural and community engagement initiatives. The successful candidate will possess strong administrative and project management skills, a solutions-oriented mindset, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively in a dynamic environment.
Responsibilities
Provide high-level executive and administrative support to the Dean’s office of the SCA including managing schedules and meeting arrangements, preparing briefing materials, attending meetings and tours, coordinating follow-up actions with relevant teams;
Serve as a key relationship manager and liaison between the SCA, project teams, University offices, and external partners, facilitating effective communication, alignment of expectations, and ensuring the smooth execution of collaborative projects;
Develop and maintain strategic partnerships that enhance the profile and impact of the SCA, including identifying collaboration opportunities, initiating stakeholder engagement, coordinating meetings, and arranging campus visits and tours;
Support the School’s daily operations, provide secretarial services and prepare reports with internal and external units/parties; and
Undertaking other duties and special assignments as required.
Requirements
A recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience, preferably in the education, arts and cultural sectors;
Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to provide high-level support to senior management and prepare professional reports, presentations, and briefing materials;
Excellent command of both written and spoken English and Chinese, including Putonghua;
Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a high level of professionalism, attention to detail, and a strong sense of responsibility; and
Proficiency in computer applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, andChinese Word.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written / skills assessment.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written / skills assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract for up to 2 years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of the application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Department of Journalism and Communication, Hong Kong Shue Yan University

of Full-time Assistant Professor / Associate Professor / Associate Professor of Practice /
Professor of Practice / Professor in Digital Communication.
Rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Candidates of Assistant
Professor/Associate Professor/Professor should have a doctorate degree in
communication or a related discipline . Recognized professionals with substantial years

Associate Professor / Assistant Professor
Department of English
(Post Ref.: 26/220 )
The Department of English ( http://www.LN.edu.hk/eng/ ) of Lingnan University now invites applications for a tenure-track position at the rank of Associate/Assistant Professor specializing in Modern Literature. The appointee is expected to: 1. teach relevant courses at both the undergraduate and postgraduate levels, including supervising undergraduate and/or postgraduate final projects; 2. generate research outputs with high impact and participate in competitive grant applications exercises; and 3. assist the Department with administration and curriculum development.
Requirements
Applicants for the position should have:
(i) a PhD degree in Modern Literature or a relevant area
(ii) good track record of publications, grants, and awards
(iii) some experience in teaching or developing courses in digital humanities, modern literature or world literatures
An appointee at the level of Associate / Assistant Professor should, besides being an effective teacher, demonstrate great potential to produce quality research output in the very near future.
Lingnan University is fully committed to the pursuit of excellence in both teaching and research. Candidates are required to provide evidence of quality teaching and information on their research records.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The rank and remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
