Department/ Unit: Department of Mathematics
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
Founded in 1963, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a forward-looking comprehensive research university with a global vision and a mission to combine tradition with modernity, and to bring together China and the West. The Department of Mathematics in CUHK has developed a strong reputation in teaching and research. Many of the faculty members are internationally renowned and are recipients of prestigious awards and honours. The graduates are successful in both academia and industry. The Department is highly ranked internationally, e.g., it is 41st, 66th and 63rd in the 2022, 2023 and 2024 QS World University Rankings, and 51st, 42nd and 56th in the 2022, 2023 and 2024 US News Rankings, respectively.
The Department invites applications for multiple non-substantive-track positions at the Research Assistant Professor (RAP) level in Mathematical Artificial Intelligence . We seek exceptional researchers who combine deep engineering expertise with a passion for engineering-driven AI innovation.
Applicants should have (i) a PhD in Management Science and Engineering, Computer Science , or a related discipline, with a focus on AI/ML theory, algorithms, or applications; (ii) a proven engineering expertise : hands-on experience transforming the theory into scalable production systems, backed by patented innovations; (iii) a proven research record in mathematical AI (e.g., optimization, dynamical systems, graph theory, probabilistic modeling) or adjacent fields with engineering impact; and (iv) fluency in prototyping and software development (e.g., Python, C++, CUDA, or ML frameworks) and interest in open-source collaboration.
The positions provide opportunities to collaborate with faculty on cutting-edge projects at the math-AI interface and lead engineering-intensive research initiatives, and access to high-performance computing resources and industry partnerships.
We encourage applicants who thrive at the intersection of theory and implementation, with a vision to bridge mathematical rigor with real-world AI challenges.
Appointments will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years commencing August 2025, renewable subject to performance and mutual agreement.
Applicants should submit online application form, copies of qualification documents, a publication list and/or selected abstracts, together with the names and e-mail addresses of at least three referees to whom the applicant's consent has been given for their providing reference.
Review of applications will begin on May 1, 2025 and will continue until the positions are filled.

SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
CONTINUING AND PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION DIVISION (CPED)
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. The School invites applications for the following positions in the Continuing and Professional Education Division:
Lecturer I / Lecturer II / Assistant Lecturer (Accounting) (25260775)
Applicants should possess relevant teaching and/or professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
Financial Accounting
Management Accounting
Financial Management
Economics
Statistics
The appointee is required to (i) perform teaching duties in related disciplines; (ii) provide academic guidance to students; (iii) develop, coordinate curriculum and manage programmes; (iv) supervise projects; (v) coordinate with the part-time teaching staff; (vi) assist administrative work for the responsible programmes/courses such as admission interview, handling students’ enquiries and organising student activities.
Requirements:
Applicants should possess a higher degree, preferably at the doctoral level, in the relevant discipline, along with teaching experience. A master's degree may also be considered. Candidates must demonstrate dedication and commitment to teaching and education; meanwhile, research competence is a factor to be considered. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team are essential.
Candidates with less experience will be considered for the post of Lecturer II or Assistant Lecturer.
Reference salary range:
Lecturer I : HK$51,000 - HK$86,000
Lecturer II : HK$38,000 - HK$53,000
Assistant Lecturer : HK$30,000 - HK$39,000
The appointee will mainly work at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Associate Director
School of Graduate Studies
(Post
Ref.: 26/226)
The School of Graduate Studies is established for strengthening the central
support for postgraduate programmes as well as the monitoring of their quality
in alignment with the University’s strategic direction of expanding and
providing quality postgraduate education. It also proactively seeks
collaboration with leading institutions in the international academic
communities to co-organise scholarly activities to enhance postgraduate student
learning.
Responsibilities
• Oversee the administrative support in various functional areas of the School of Graduate Studies including, but not limited to, Research Postgraduate programmes (RPg) admissions, promotion/publicity, academic development, academic quality assurance and enhancement, formulation of academic policies and regulations, and programme review and approval
• Manage the day-to-day operations of research postgraduate programmes, e.g. in publicity, admission, programme/course registration, academic studies and progress, financial support, student records, etc.
• Provide secretarial support to committees
• Manage and oversee the daily operations of school office administration and general services
• Perform any other duties as assigned by the supervisor(s)
Requirements
• A Bachelor’s degree with 15 years' relevant experience in the tertiary education institutions
• Substantial management experience and a high level of competence in committee work
• Strong logical thinking, analytical, interpersonal, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills
• An excellent command of written and verbal English and Chinese (including Putonghua), especially with a high level of English proficiency in writing reports, proposals and minutes
• A strong sense of responsibility
• A good knowledge in IT applications
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will
be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include
annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and
gratuity.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your
application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit
their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the
right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post
by invitation or by search. We regret
that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

36b31722101861b2586d7110.description:
Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Microelectronics and Quantum Technology under Strategic Hiring Scheme (several posts)
(Ref. 260521007)
Since its inception in 1974, the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE), formed through the merger of the Department of Electronic and Information Engineering and the Department of Electrical Engineering, has maintained a distinguished history of providing outstanding engineering education and applied research in Hong Kong. The Unit offers extensive resources to support a wide variety of teaching activities and research interests, frequently hosting leading scholars for collaboration to enhance its global research profile. Please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/eee for more information about the Unit. EEE is a constituent unit in the Faculty of Engineering. Information on the Faculty is available at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/feng/ .
To boost the leadership and impact of PolyU’s research work in areas of significant societal needs and strategic importance, the Strategic Hiring Scheme is introduced to recruit faculty members at all levels and outstanding scholars are invited to join the University under the Strategic Hiring Scheme. Appointees recruited under the Strategic Hiring Scheme should have conducted / led world-leading research that is commensurate with the stage of their academic career.
EEE is now seeking highly qualified candidates for Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor positions across several strategic research tracks.
Duties
(A) Microelectronics and Silicon Photonics
Appointees for this track should possess substantial research experience in devices design, cleanroom fabrication and device characterization etc. EEE prioritizes expertise in device design, simulation, fabrication and packaging, specifically encouraging those with experience bridging microelectronics with silicon photonics or heterogeneous integration.
Teaching Duties: The appointees will be responsible for delivering courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels specifically focused on silicon photonics and microelectronics.
(B) Embedded Circuits and Packaging
Appointees for this track should possess substantial research experience in advanced embedded circuits and electronic packaging technologies. EEE prioritizes expertise in embedded circuit design, simulation and system-level integration, specifically encouraging those with experience in SoC architectures, 2.5D/3D integration, chiplet packaging or co-packaged optics with FPGA.
Teaching Duties: The appointees will be responsible for delivering courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels specifically focused on embedded circuit design and advanced packaging technologies.
(C) Photonic Quantum Computing
Appointees for this track should possess substantial research experience in quantum optics, integrated quantum photonics and photonic quantum computing experiments. EEE prioritizes expertise in quantum light sources and programmable photonic circuits, specifically encouraging those with experience in optical quantum information processing or hardware implementation of quantum algorithms.
Teaching Duties: The appointees will be responsible for delivering courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels specifically focused on quantum optics, quantum computing, and quantum information processing.
(D) Quantum Theory and Algorithms
Appointees for this track should possess substantial research experience in quantum optics, photonic quantum computing theory, architectures and quantum error correction. SCHOOL OF COMMUNICATION
DEPARTMENT OF JOURNALISM
Founded in 1968, Department of Journalism is part of School of Communication, and remains one of the best-known journalism faculties in Hong Kong. In fact, many of the city’s top media professionals are our graduates, including the top executives of some leading media organisations. The department is now offering journalism and digital media as a major undergraduate programme with two concentrations: Journalism, and Digital & Media Communication. Its faculty members also work in a dynamic, interdisciplinary academic environment that entails collaboration across multiple fields of study.
Associate Professor / Professor (25260691)
The Department invites applications for full-time faculty positions of Associate Professor / Professor in Journalism, Media and Communication Studies. The following specialty fields are based on the department’s strengths, disciplines, and teaching/research areas.
Journalism and Media Studies
Broadcast Journalism and Social Media
Digital Journalism
Data Journalism
Emerging Media Studies
Global/International Communications
AI/Computational Communication
AI Literacy/Ethics in Journalism
AI Application in Journalism
Interactive Media
Responsibilities:
Conduct cutting-edge research and contribute to the research strengths of the Department;
Deliver quality teaching and supervision in relevant discipline(s) at undergraduate and postgraduate levels;
Obtain competitive research grants; and
Engage in professional, institutional and community services .
Requirements:
Hold a Ph.D. degree in related field(s);
Have a solid research track record and active research agenda;
Show evidence-based research impact and publications in international refereed journals;
Demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence in teaching; and
Have competitive research grant records and an outstanding record of achievement in scholarship for appointments at senior ranks.
The appointee will be allocated to one of the three departments based on his/her research field, teaching area and/or other relevant expertise. The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of up to three years commencing September 2026 or on a mutually agreed date. Re-appointments thereafter will be subject to performance and mutual agreement. Tenured appointments are expected to be attained in 6 years. Outstanding candidates at Associate Professor or above may be considered for walk-in tenure on appointment.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

DEPARTMENT OF JOURNALISM
Founded in 1968, the School of Communication offers 7 programmes at the undergraduate and postgraduate (MA, MPhil, PhD) levels to 1,700 students. As a leading school in the Asia-Pacific region, its faculty members work in a dynamic, interdisciplinary academic environment that entails collaboration across multiple fields of study. The School now invites applicants to fill the following positions:
Professor of Practice / Associate Professor of Practice (25260692)
Responsibilities:
Teach core multimedia journalism classes at the undergraduate and postgraduate level in English and should be versatile and experienced enough to also teach other professional courses as needed, such as broadcast journalism, photojournalism, audio storytelling, investigative journalism and English news and feature writing ;
Stay abreast of contemporary digital trends in the industry to advise on equipment purchases and ensure student skills and curriculum meet industry needs; and
Be expected to create and develop curriculum, design syllabuses, assist in organising events, workshops and extracurricular activities, mentor students, advise student news publications, maintain industry connections, initiate and work with other faculty members on journalism-related projects and contribute to the overall development of whole-person and journalism education at the University.
Requirements:
A master’s degree or PhD in journalism or a closely related communication field from an accredited college or university;
Have extensive experience in professional journalism, especially in multimedia, broadcast and online journalism;
Have the ability of designing and delivering online content will be a distinct advantage;
Have teaching experience at the university level is preferrable;

DEPARTMENT OF BIOLOGY
The Department of Biology is an academic unit under the Faculty of Science and Technology at The Hong Kong Baptist University. Founded in 1961, the Department of Biology seeks to cultivate our students on two fields of biology (biotechnology and environmental science).
The Department now invites applications for a tenure-track or tenured faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor or higher. This is an open search; we seek an outstanding scientist whose research will enhance and complement our existing programmes.
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor (Ref: 25260430)
Responsibilities:
Responsibilities include establishing a vigorous, externally funded research programmes, teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses, supervising students, and contributing to departmental service. Collaboration with other faculty members in research and teaching is also expected.
Requirements:
Applicants should hold a PhD in a related discipline and demonstrate excellence in research and teaching. They are expected to be energetic and self-motivated. They will also actively participate in current research and teaching programmes of the Department and be capable of securing individual research grants. Those with substantial teaching experience and a good record of scholarly achievements will be considered for appointment at the rank of Associate Professor/Professor.
For enquiries, please contact Professor Jianming Li, Head of Department (email: biol@hkbu.edu.hk).
More information about the Department can be found at https://biol.hkbu.edu.hk/index/.
This is a tenure-track position with an initial appointment to be made on a fixed-term contract of three years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. Tenure is expected to be attained within six years.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System with samples of publications, preferably three best ones out of their most recent publications/works. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the posts advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the positions are filled.

Senior Programme Officer
Taught Postgraduate Programmes Office
Office of the Faculty of Business
(Post Ref.: 26/42 )
Responsibilities
• Perform a wide range of administrative duties to ensure the smooth operation of the programme, including admission, programme management and operation
• Carry out various programme administrative tasks such as promotion, timetabling, scheduling programme courses and seminars, handling teaching and learning activities, and other tasks pertaining to course operations
• Administer the admission, registration, document verification and visa application processes
• Coordinate administrative processes for course arrangement, examinations, student activities, course evaluations, and events
• Handle purchases, reimbursement, payments and other financial and budgeting matters
• Liaise with internal and external parties
• Handle quality assurance related matters such as secretary duties related to various committees
• Prepare annual programme report and other required reports as well as data reporting to various units of the university
• Lead programme team members for overall programme management and smooth operation
• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor
Requirements
• A recognized Bachelor’s degree with at least two years of relevant experience, preferably in the tertiary education sector; For Senior Programme Officer rank, the candidate should have at least four years of relevant working experience
• Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (including Putonghua)
• High level of competence in computer literacy and familiarity with relevant university systems
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills for advising students and liaising with diverse stakeholders
• Good team spirit with a strong sense of responsibility and is willing to go the extra mile to complete tasks before deadlines
• Willingness to assume various responsibilities with a passionate attitude
• Proactive mindset and strong analytical ability to carry out duties independently and efficiently with minimum supervision
• Experience in programme administration, student admissions, or quality assurance is highly desirable

Visiting English Tutor
Centre for English and Additional Languages
(Post Ref.: 26/04)
Lingnan University cordially invites fresh graduates from Hong Kong and our partner institutions across the world, as part of the Liberal Arts Alliance, to apply for the Visiting English Tutor position.
Visiting English Tutors (VETs) run the English Language Support Service (ELSS) within the Centre for English and Additional Languages (CEAL) at Lingnan University, Hong Kong, where they provide English advice to undergraduate and postgraduate students, aid in the development of self-access materials, conduct writing and speaking tutorial workshops, and design and run academic workshops.
VETs also organise a wide range of academic and social events aimed at broadening students’ English language skills, including film nights, board games, and dinners. A major objective of the VET scheme is to provide opportunities for Lingnan University students to mix with people of a similar age but from different cultural backgrounds. Therefore, those with a willingness to actively engage and socialize with local Hong Kong students are strongly encouraged to apply.
Requirements
• Be about to graduate or have recently graduated from a Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Hong Kong, one of our partner universities, or a member of the Global Liberal Arts Alliance
• Be highly proficient in English language, preferably with an IELTS score of 8.0 or above
• Be interested in living in and working in Hong Kong for at least one year
• Be interested in interacting with students from different cultural backgrounds
• Be interested in gaining experience in the tertiary education ESL field
• Have an outgoing personality
• Have a basic certificate-level teaching qualification (e.g. TEFL Certificate) with a minimum of 100 hours input (can be gained after receiving a provisional offer)
Salary and Benefits
• The position is tenable from mid-August 2026 till mid-June 2027 (10-months), with the possibility of a further one-year (10-months) extension
• The monthly salary is fixed at HK$18,030 per month (approximately US$2,311)
• All VETs are provided with a single occupancy, fully furnished and fully equipped apartment on campus
• Medical and dental benefits are provided by Lingnan University
• Assistance will be given in obtaining a valid Hong Kong work visa from the Hong Kong Immigration Department
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application by 28 February 2026 . Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the posts are filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the posts advertised, or to fill the posts by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

The Academy of Visual Arts is the first-of-its-kind local institution in delivering Arts and Technology education, which is looking for Part-time Lecturer(s) to teach the course(s) at undergraduate level in the following areas:
Unreal VR technology
Digital media and fabrication
Creative computation
Any other related disciplines
The ideal candidate should hold a master’s degree or above in related disciplines, with 3 years of experience in creative industries with aspects of content development, budgeting, licensing, administration, marketing, or audience engagement, preferably with teaching experience at the university level. A good command of English and Chinese, excellent communication skills, and a strong sense of responsibility are required.
Duties may also include supervision of students, marking of examination papers, and any other work as assigned by the Programme Director and Director of the Academy.

SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Senior System Engineer) (Ref. No.: 26270053)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high-performing IT infrastructure and operations team to support the School's ongoing digital transformation and future growth. We are seeking a motivated and technically capable professional who is passionate about modern IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and delivering reliable technology services that enable business success.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of the IT infrastructure team, reporting to Information Technical Manager, working closely with users, application team, vendors, and technology partners to maintain and enhance the School's Microsoft ecosystem, network environment, and security posture. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting day-to-day IT operations, administering Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity platforms, managing network and server infrastructure, and contributing to infrastructure modernization initiatives that support the School's evolving digital landscape.
Key Responsibilities:
Core Infrastructure Management: Support deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Microsoft infrastructure including Windows Server, AD DS, Entra ID, Group Policy, and Intune.
M365 Administration: Manage daily operations of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive, ensuring service health, configuration accuracy, and policy compliance.
Routine Server Operation: Conduct daily health checks, including reviewing logs, backups, disk usage, and service status. Perform housekeeping tasks, monitor server room equipment (power, cooling, cabling), and report abnormalities to ensure availability and proper functioning.
Managing Network infrastructure: Deploy and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices to ensure optimal performance and security.
Performance Monitoring: Monitor system and network performance, identify and resolve issues to minimize downtime and maintain service availability.
Updates and Maintenance: Participate in system and network updates and maintenance activities , including patch management and routine system upgrades.
IT projects support: Assist with documentation, testing, and deployment activities. Contribute to initiatives such as SSO integration and system improvements.
Perform ad hoc assignments and responsibilities requested by supervisor.
Required skills and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
At least 5 years of hands-on working experience in supporting Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, DNS, GPOs, Exchange & SharePoint Online, MS Teams, Intune, Cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS).
Solid experience in managing enterprise network environment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.
Solid understanding of cybersecurity technologies and best practices, including Microsoft Defender, EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, and endpoint protection.
Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently manage incidents and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues.
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Professional certifications are highly desirable, including: Microsoft, public cloud (Azure/AWS), VMware, ITIL; CISSP is a plus.
Candidates with more extensive experience may be considered for the position of Assistant Information Technology Manager (Infrastructure).
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered a one-year contract (up to 31 August 2027). Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

3ea28dbacb570e6d74251b22.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Educational Administration and Policy
Closing date: Until the position is filled
The Department of Educational Administration and Policy now seeks to appoint distinguished scholar as Department Chairperson. An academic appointment will be made at Professor or Associate Professor level on substantiative (tenured) or contract basis concurrently subject to the appointee’s credentials. Applicants from the areas of Educational Leadership and Administration or Foundations in Education and Policy Studies in Education are welcome.
As one of the four academic departments under the Faculty of Education at CUHK ( www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk ), the Department is part of an internationally recognized center for professional training and research in education. Further information about the Department is available at http://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/eap .
Applicants should have (i) excellent academic qualifications including a doctoral degree in educational administration, leadership, policy studies, early childhood education, ethics for teaching profession, sociology of education, philosophy of education, artificial intelligence in education or a related discipline; (ii) proven leadership experience in tertiary education institution(s); (iii) a strong research background in areas that will contribute or enhance the existing strengths of the Department; (iv) a track record of programmatic research and publications; and (v) strong commitment to excellence in teaching and scholarship. For appointment at Professor level, applicants should demonstrate a strong record of professional achievement and visibility.
The appointee will be required to:
(a) Provide visionary leadership in formulating and implementing the Department’s long-term strategies and plans, ensuring alignment with the University’s Strategic Plan. Foster a culture of excellence by mentoring and empowering team members to achieve objectives efficiently and to world-class standards;
(b) Promote and support innovative, high-impact research, and actively encourage interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration;
(c) Ensure the delivery of high-quality teaching across undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional programmes; and
(d) Lead efforts to build and strengthen strategic partnerships with leading tertiary institutions, creating opportunities for collaboration in education, research, and knowledge transfer.
Applicants should complete the online application form and upload a full curriculum vitae with details of three referees. Applicants may consider their applications unsuccessful if they are not invited for an interview within 6 months after application.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Senior Information Security Analyst (at the rank of Senior Officer)
Information Technology Services Centre
(Post Ref.: 26/185)
Responsibilities
Application Security
Act as the Security Champions Program Captain
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of information security practices and trends, and apply to the Security Champions Program
Provide guidance and support to security champions to identify and address security issues throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC),
Practice DevSecOps and secure software development
Identify potential security issues of internal applications by threat modelling
Conduct security testing such as Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Component Analysis (SCA)
Ensure that applications and systems comply with internal standards, the data governance framework, and code of practice for handling personal data
Conduct cybersecurity risk assessment and personal data protection impact assessment
Cyber Threat Intelligence
Identify, track, and predict cyber threats in relation to the University’s digital assets.
Analyze the cyber threat data and intelligence to understand the tactics, techniques, and procedures (TPPs) used by threat actors, and develop the relevant detection rules.
Other Day-to-Day Operations
Triage security alerts, investigate, and respond to security incidents
Promote security awareness among students and staff members, including IT teams
Operate the security stack such as Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management (ASM), Web Application Firewall (WAF), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), NDR, EDR, SIEM, SOAR, and maintain good cyber hygiene
Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisor(s)
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field
At least 3 years’ working experience in the IT sector
Practical experience in handling security incidents, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
Relevant experience in DevSecOps and data governance will be advantageous
Ability to work independently and across teams
A good command of English and Chinese
Relevant certificates (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH) are highly desirable
Previous working experience in a university or similar environment will be an advantage
Candidates with less/more experience will also be considered for appointment at the relevant rank.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and gratuity.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only .
We are an equal opportunities employer . Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified .

短期研討會兼職教師招聘 – 理財保險業
[RF: 2025/26-PT-172-JDB]
本校現誠邀具備專業背景人士，為理財保險從業員提供日間短期研討會。請申請者註明希望申請的職位：
招聘崗位及職責：
1. 銀髮經濟與長者理財保險專題講師
為保險從業員講解銀髮經濟相關保險與風險管理。
介紹適合銀髮族的金融及理財產品。
分析銀髮市場潛力及發展趨勢，協助從業員識別及開發高潛力客戶群。
2. AI社群媒體行銷講師
教授保險從業員如何運用AI工具提升社群媒體行銷內容，包括自動生成文章、短視頻及文案。
示範如何運用AI於小紅書、微信朋友圈等平台快速製作高質量貼文及影音內容，協助從業員拓展客源。
分享最新AI行銷策略及實用工具。
3. 個人銷售及溝通技巧培訓講師
為保險從業員進行個人銷售技巧、溝通及客戶關係管理培訓。
分享實戰經驗，教授提升客戶轉化率及忠誠度的方法。
設計互動式課程，提升學員實際應用能力。
4. 危疾及保險財務規劃
危疾及醫療產品在財務規劃中的應用
保險理賠對家庭及企業財務的實際影響
危疾/醫療保險與投資產品組合策略
入職資格：
1. 持有相關領域碩士學位或專業資格。
2. 具備相關領域教學或行業實務經驗至少5年（銀髮經濟、金融、保險／社群媒體行銷、AI應用／銷售培訓等）。
3. 能以普通話及廣東話授課者優先考慮。
4. 目前未持有任何保險公司保險牌照，以避免利益衝突。

分享最新AI行銷策略及實用工具。

分享實戰經驗，教授提升客戶轉化率及忠誠度的方法。
設計互動式課程，提升學員實際應用能力。

保險理賠對家庭及企業財務的實際影響
危疾/醫療保險與投資產品組合策略

Ethical Implications of Generative AI in Media Communication [Note 1]

Senior Student Development Officer / Student Development Officer (Ref. No.: 26270043)
The appointee will join the Shek Mun Campus Student Development Centre at the School of Continuing Education (SCE), supporting various whole-person development activities. Key responsibilities include administering career support, experiential learning, cultural and inclusive programmes, leadership and wellness initiatives, and providing administrative support for the Centre’s daily operations, student organizations, and committees. The ideal candidate should be supportive, dynamic, and enthusiastic about working with students. SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Application Development & Support) (Ref. no.: 26270115)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities:
The candidate will focus on application support, design, development, and system enhancement, contributing to DevOps practices that streamline deployment, improve system stability, and support continuous improvement
Map, analyze, and document interfaces between legacy systems and new platforms, ensuring seamless integration and efficient, reliable data exchange
Perform end‑to‑end software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
Design and develop innovative application solutions and contribute to product and system enhancement initiatives
Enhance and modernize existing legacy applications to support institutional transformation and evolving operational needs
Prepare and maintain comprehensive testing and system documentation, ensuring quality, reliability, and adherence to delivery timelines
Produce clear and user‑friendly manuals to support effective adoption and optimal utilization of new systems
Collaborate closely with IT colleagues and business users on institution‑wide IT initiatives and projects
Perform other IT projects and assignments as assigned
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant work experience in end‑to‑end application development, covering front‑end, back‑end, and database design and development, with experience in responsive design and system integration. (Candidates with less relevant experience are welcome to apply and may be considered for an associate-level role)
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

The Department of Management and Marketing (MM) is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Business. MM is dedicated to providing cutting-edge knowledge and practical skills for our students in three key areas of business — Management , Marketing , and Management Information Systems . MM offers a full range of programmes leading to the awards of Doctor of Philosophy, Master of Science, and Bachelor of Business Administration. MM currently has around 60 full-time academic staff who are actively involved in research, consultancy, and management development work with businesses in Hong Kong, the Chinese mainland, and internationally. MM is committed to excellence in teaching, research and service to the community.
The Marketing discipline of the Department invites applications for faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor, in the area of Consumer Behavior . The faculty members in the Marketing discipline of MM regularly publish their research in top-tier refereed marketing journals such as the Journal of Consumer Research, Journal of Marketing Research, Journal of Marketing, and Marketing Science . Research-focused applicants who are interested in joining our vibrant and growing research team are strongly encouraged to apply for the post.
Please visit the website at https://mm.polyu.edu.hk/ for more information about MM. Applicants are invited to contact Professor Yuwei Jiang, Chair Professor and Associate Head of MM by email at yuwei.jiang@polyu.edu.hk for further information about the post.

The appointee will be required to:
(a) engage in top-level scholarly research in their areas of expertise;

School of Architecture
Research Assistant Professor
(Ref. 260000KJ) (Closing Date: Until the post is filled)
The Chinese University of Hong Kong is one of the world’s leading universities, ranked at 37 th place internationally and ranked No. 1 in Hong Kong in the recently released Best Global Universities Rankings 2025 by the U.S. News & World Report. Its location makes it one of the most exciting places to research on and teach architecture.
The School of Architecture has a world-class, research-led and professionally connected learning environment. It embraces new approaches to architectural education and cross-disciplinary research that impact society and profession.
The School has an ambitious growth plan and is now seeking outstanding candidates to make significant contributions to both diversify its portfolio and support its existing strengths in architectural scholarship. The appointee will drive forward a research agenda related to the School’s strategic areas and develop research collaborations within the University and beyond. He/ She will be a key player in the research team working on environmental studies led by Prof essor Edward Ng.
Applicants should have a doctoral degree in a subject area relevant to Statistics, Public Health, or related disciplines, with at least two years of postdoctoral research experience in environmental or urban climate studies. Preference will be given to candidates with a strong research and practical record in the following areas:
Impact assessment of climate change on urban and built environment
Measurement and modeling of climate vulnerability in urban designs
Risk analysis of climate-related hazards within high-density and complex settings
Application of advanced modeling technologies for climate and health impact evaluation
Development of strategies to enhance the resilience of urban structures and communities against extreme weather events
Applicants should have good proposal and report writing, communication and interpersonal skills. Applicants should have a good scholarly record demonstrating research excellence. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in research grant application and project management.
Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to two years, renewable subject to performance and mutual agreement.
To apply for the post, please complete the online application form, and submit a letter of interest, a full CV, a research statement, together with names/e-mail addresses of three referees with consent for providing references. Salary will be commensurate with the applicant’s qualifications and experience.
The CUHK School of Architecture is actively building a more diverse and inclusive environment. Qualified individuals from underrepresented sections of society are encouraged to apply.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. To explore the School and the post further, please visit https://www.arch.cuhk.edu.hk/people/careers . Enquiries may be directed to Ms. Tammy Kong, School Manager at arc.appointment@cuhk.edu.hk .
Review of applications and shortlisting will start in June/July 2026 until the post is filled.

4dd350415dc67b5b39b3e1fc.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Finance
Closing Date: Until the position(s) are filled
The Department of Finance at CUHK Business School now invites applications for the positions of Professor(s)/ Associate Professor(s). We welcome applications from qualified scholars specializing in all areas of finance.
The Department of Finance currently has 44 full-time faculty members, with 3/4 of them being tenured and tenure-track faculty in different areas of finance. The Department has been expanding in recent years and is on upward trajectory in research productivity, with many faculty members successfully publishing in Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, Review of Financial Studies, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, among others. The CUHK was ranked 36 th globally and 2 nd in the Asia-Pacific region in the UT Dallas World Business School Research Ranking based on the publications in the three finance top-tier journals (JF, JFE, RFS) from 2019-2024.
For appointment at the rank of Associate Professor, candidates should have excellent track record of publications at the very best journals and demonstrable teaching performance. For appointment at the rank of Professor, they should also demonstrate strong record of professional achievement and visibility. For either appointment, candidates are expected to provide leadership to help the Department to grow, and teach in the more demanding postgraduate programmes (MSc/MBA/EMBA/PhD).
For more detailed information about the Department and the faculty research, please visit our websites at https://www.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/departments/finance and https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/fin/research/top-publications.pdf respectively.
About CUHK Business School
CUHK Business School is a world-leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific.
CUHK Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (MBA, MSc, EMBA, DBA, MPhil, PhD) with over 5,000 students, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 45,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
o Schools
• Accountancy
• Hotel & Tourism Management
o Departments
• Decisions, Operations & Technology
• Finance
• Management
• Marketing
Application Procedures
Applicants should complete the on-line application form and upload a curriculum vitae at https://cuhk.taleo.net/careersection/cu_career_teach/jobdetail.ftl?job=250001TJ . The recruitment committee will follow up and may request additional information or schedule an online meeting if required.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Professor
School of Graduate Studies
(Post Ref.: 26/147)
The School of Graduate Studies (GS) was
established to strengthen the central support for postgraduate programmes and
monitor their quality in alignment with the University’s strategic direction of
expanding and providing quality postgraduate education in the digital
era. The GS also offers postgraduate programmes up to doctoral level in
various disciplines and provides professional education for the wider society.
It has a wide research and teaching scope and knowledge transfer programmes
that promote interdisciplinary teaching and research related to policy studies
and management, health and well-being studies, higher education, and urban
studies.
The GS is now searching for staff who possess research and teaching
experiences in these areas at postgraduate level:
• Social determinants of health and well-being
• Health and social services management
• Ageing, well-being and welfare policies
• Health and well-being of children and youth
• Research methods and data analytics
The appointee will be
expected to (a) support and lead in conducting high quality research; (b)
engage in teaching and learning activities in the areas specified above; (c)
support academic programme management and knowledge transfer activities; (d)
contribute to academic programme/course development, and (e) contribute to
other administrative duties as required by supervisors, such as academic
programme promotion.

a relevant discipline such as social policy, social work or sociology awarded
no more than five years prior to the commencement of the

good experience in teaching in the specified areas; (iv) excellent
interpersonal, organisational and communication skills; and (v) proficiency in
English and Putonghua. Preference will be given to candidates with outstanding
academic training and international exposure.

The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Remuneration will be
commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual
leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and

Postdoctoral Fellow
Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre
(Post Ref.: 26/26)
About the Centre
Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre (HKCRC) was established in January 2022 as a research centre within the Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University, one of Asia's best in analytic philosophy. The department has a thriving research environment and already hosts several Postdoctoral Fellows/Research Assistant Professors. Faculty members publish in leading journals, such as Analysis, Australasian Journal of Philosophy, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, Ethics, Journal of Philosophical Logic, Mind, Noûs, Philosophers’ Imprint, Philosophical Quarterly, Philosophical Studies, Philosophy and Phenomenological Research, and Philosophy of Science.
More information on the research centre can be found at: https://www.ln.edu.hk/philoso/hkcrc
More information on the interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.LN.edu.hk/philoso/?page_id=9/ .
Requirements
The Centre seeks to appoint a Postdoctoral Fellow with expertise in the ethics of AI (broadly understood). Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD in Philosophy degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than three years prior to the commencement of the appointment, and a record of publications in Philosophy, preferably in leading journals.
The appointee is expected to conduct focused research, publish scholarly outputs in reputable, peer-reviewed international philosophical journals, and apply for competitive peer-reviewed grants offered by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, as well as other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes. Teaching experience at undergraduate and/or taught master’s programme levels is an advantage.
Research: The Postdoctoral Fellow will (i) conduct research and submit papers to top philosophy journals, (ii) submit grant proposals to various funding bodies, and (iii) organise seminars, reading groups, workshops, or other related research activities.
Teaching: The appointee will play a central role in the daily operations of the Master of Arts in Artificial Intelligence and the Future (MAAIF), the Taught Postgraduate Programme offered by HKCRC and the Department of Philosophy. The teaching load will be two courses per year, distributed according to the Centre's needs and upon mutual agreement. English will be the language of instruction. The appointee would also be required to supervise students’ capstone projects.
Service: The appointee will perform administrative duties as assigned by the Director of HKCRC in accordance with the Head of the Department.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. The appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of up to three years.
The starting date would be no later than August 2026. The initial application must include:
1. An updated CV
2. A letter of interest
3. One and only one writing sample (no more than one writing sample will be read)
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the post is filled, starting from 2 March 2026. The candidate will be expected to start their position in August 2026. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
Informal inquiries concerning the post can be directed to the Director of HKCRC, Professor Andrea Sauchelli at andreasauchelli@ln.edu.hk .
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

• Strong skills in qualitative research analysis tools such as NVivo

is highly preferred

OFFICE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
Senior Analyst Programmer / Analyst Programmer (Financial Information System) (26270123)
Reporting to the Senior Information Technology Manager in the Office of Information Technology (Applications and Integration Services), the appointee is responsible for the development and support of Financial Information Systems as well as different projects of the University.
Responsibilities:
Assist supervisor in IT projects implementation and support involving vendor solution;
Assist supervisor in feasibility study, PoC/technical demonstration, documentation, testing, training and deployment to fulfil the business requirements and target outcomes;
Work as a team and responsible for web application development;
Ongoing systems monitoring, maintenance, and support; and
Support any other IT projects and tasks as directed.
Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related discipline;
At least 4 years of system development experience in software development and system integration;
Hands-on experience in using Java/JEE as development programming languages is a must;
Relevant skills and experience in:
Project implementation experience including vendor solutions.
EJB technologies, Development Framework and programming in PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSF, AJAX, React, Python, Node.js, Spring Boot, SQL, PL/SQL, and Linux/Unix shell scripting.
Working with RDBMS such as Sybase, MySQL, MSSQL, and Oracle.
Using web application servers such as Oracle Weblogic Server, and Apache.
Knowledge in Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Forms/Reports, Powerbuilder, MS Power Platform and ETL tool.
Prior experience with Finance Information Systems will be highly desirable;
Experience in using AI tools for software development is an advantage;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Good command of both written and spoken English and Cantonese; and
Fast learner with a can-do attitude, and the ability to work well in a team environment while also being capable of working independently.
Candidates with less experience or lower qualifications will be considered for the position of Analyst Programmer.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of one and a half years.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for an interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
(primarily stationed at the College of International Education)
Part-Time Lecturers For Full-Time Sub-degree And Undergraduate Degree Programmes
Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time Associate Degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage. English is used as the medium of instruction at the College. Applications are now invited for the part-time lecturer position for the following course areas /subjects for the First Semester of the 2026-27 academic year.
Course Areas:
DIVISION OF COMMUNICATION
Generic Content – Communication (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0096/25-26) Apply Now
Ethical Implications of Generative AI in Media Communication [Note 1]
Radio Broadcasting # ^ [Note 2]
Advertising, Public Relations and Strategic Communications (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0097/25-26) Apply Now
Persuasion and Social Influence
Media Business Environment
Creative Writing for Film, Television and New Media (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0098/25-26) Apply Now
Cinematic Storytelling
Creative Thinking and Community Arts
Studies in Non-Fiction Films
Applicants should possess at least a Master’s degree in relevant discipline and have substantial teaching experience preferably at tertiary level. Competence in using English as the medium of instruction is required. For courses marked with #, applicants should be able to understand and speak Cantonese. For courses marked with ^, applicants with a Bachelor’s degree AND substantial working experience in relevant discipline will also be considered.
[Notes]:
Knowledge in sociological, ethical and economic impacts of generative AI to media communication required.
Knowledge and experience in radio or online broadcasting required.
Application Procedures:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System ( https://jobs.hkbu.edu.hk ). Applicants not invited for interview 3 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post(s) advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions then applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications will continue until the positions are filled.

582738b134efbabb19d8b4a6.description:
SCHOOL OF CHINESE MEDICINE
Teaching and Research Division
Assistant Professor / Associate Professor (26270047)
Established in 1999, the School of Chinese Medicine offers comprehensive undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes in Chinese Medicine, Pharmacy in Chinese Medicine, and Pharmaceutical Science. Our core mission is to nurture outstanding talent committed to the inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine.The School now invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor or Associate Professor. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in Pharmacy in Chinese Medicine, Chinese Medicine Pharmacology, Chinese Medicine Processing, and Pharmaceutical Science to teach in English in our undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. The appointee is also expected to establish research collaborations within and beyond the School in one or more of the following areas: precision medicine and phenomics, translational medicine and innovative drug discovery, and authentication and testing of Chinese medicines.
Applicants with relevant postdoctoral training who can demonstrate a strong track record in related fields, evidenced by success in securing external grants, outstanding publications, and clear potential for research leadership in translational research and drug discovery, will be highly competitive.
This is a tenure-track position with an initial appointment on a fixed-term contract of up to three years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement. Tenured appointment is expected to be attained within six years.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

58671f3a0e7797192a0cfe5c.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (IT Business Analyst) (ref. no.: 25260789)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities:
The candidate will play a dual role as a System Analyst and IT Business Analyst, bridging business needs with technical implementation. The role requires strong analytical capability to translate user requirements into clear functional specifications, while also contributing to system design and development activities.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear user stories and functional specifications
Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to design practical, scalable solutions that meet business needs
Support development by providing clear requirements, guiding implementation, and ensuring alignment between business and technical delivery
Contribute to system design and development, and provide technical guidance to the developers
Analyze and document system interfaces, especially between legacy and new platforms, to ensure smooth integration and reliable data exchange
Participate in full SDLC activities, including requirements gathering, design, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support
Develop and enhance application solutions, including modernizing legacy systems to support evolving business needs
Prepare and maintain testing materials, system documentation, and user manuals to ensure quality and user adoption
Work closely with IT teams and business users on institution-wide IT initiatives and projects
Undertake other IT-related tasks and projects as assigned
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant experience in application development and business analysis, covering end-to-end system delivery across front-end, back-end, and database design
Strong business analysis skills with the ability to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions
Hands-on experience in system design and development, including responsive design and system integration
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment for the above post will be made on a fixed-term contract of one year. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

591898695c30e1e30b7e8373.description:
Full-time Assistant Professor/Associate Professor in Smart Cultural Tourism
(Ref: SCT 2026-06-29)
(Start date: September 2026)
Hong Kong Shue Yan University invites applications for three full-time academic positions
for its new Master of Social Sciences in Smart Cultural Tourism (MSSc-SCT) programme,
hosted by the Department of Sociology. The appointment will commence in September
2026. Rank will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualiﬁcations and experience.
The MSSc-SCT programme is a pioneering taught postgraduate programme in Hong Kong
that uniquely integrates cultural tourism with smart technologies. It is strategically
developed to align with the city’s vision of becoming a smart city and a cultural hub,
responding to the growing industry demand for professionals who can create in-depth,
technology-enhanced cultural experiences.
Responsibilities:
The appointee will be expected to:
• Teach postgraduate courses in the MSSc-SCT programme.
• Supervise students’ master projects and research-informed studio work.
• Contribute to the ongoing curriculum development and quality assurance of the
programme.
• Pursue an active research agenda, secure competitive research grants, and publish
in high-quality refereed journals.
• Engage in departmental and university service and administration.
Qualiﬁcations and Requirements:
Candidates should possess:
• A doctoral degree from a recognised university in a relevant ﬁeld (e.g., digital
heritage, digital humanities, or cultural computing).
• Demonstrated expertise or a strong research track record in conducting
interdisciplinary research at the intersection of cultural/heritage tourism and digital
technologies (e.g., AR, VR, MR).
• Relevant teaching experience in smart cultural tourism or closely related
disciplines.
• High proﬁciency in both English and Chinese (Putonghua), with the ability to teach
effectively across the programme’s dual-language streams.
• Relevant industry work experience or a strong professional industry network is
highly preferred.
The Programme:
The Master of Social Sciences in Smart Cultural Tourism (MSSc-SCT) is an innovative,
interdisciplinary programme designed to cultivate professionals who can transform
cultural content into engaging tourism experiences enhanced by smart technologies (e.g.,
AI, VR/AR, interactive media). The curriculum is built on two foundations: Domain
Knowledge of Cultural Tourism and Smart Technology Application Skills, preparing
graduates for diverse careers in the tourism, cultural, creative, and technology sectors.
Application Procedure:
Applications should be sent via email to recruit_ap@hksyu.edu and must include the
following documents:
1. A cover letter
2. A completed application form (please click here to download)
3. A full CV (including a detailed list of research projects and publications)
4. A teaching statement (max. 250 words)
5. A research statement (max. 250 words)
6. Two representative publications
7. Three reference letters (please arrange for the referees to send the letters directly to
the application email address)
For enquiries about the positions, please send an email to Dr. Shengdan CAI at
scai@hksyu.edu.
Closing Date: Review of applications will commence on 15 July 2026 and will continue
until the position is ﬁlled.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The personal data received will be kept
conﬁdential and used for recruitment purposes only.

59df05ddb3caa8e888b28665.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Social Work
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
As a world-leading centre of social work education and research, the Department is dedicated to developing and disseminating scientific, rigorous and socially impactful social work knowledge for human betterment and social development. We aspire, through our research and evaluation work, to improve the lives of vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, deepen our understanding of social issues and promote evidence-based practice locally and globally. The Department is looking for candidates who embrace these goals and values.
Scholars specializing in any of the following research areas are welcome to apply for the post:
- clinical social work
- children and family
- gerontology
- macro social work theories and practice
Applicants should (i) have a relevant PhD degree; (ii) have a strong publication track record and proven ability to obtain grants; and (iii) demonstrate potential in conducting research to generate academic and social impact. Being registered social workers and having professional expertise or substantial work experience in clinical or macro social work practice will be advantageous.
The appointee will (i) undertake research and (ii) teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation later.
Applications are open until the post is filled.
[Those who have responded to the previous advertisement (Ref. 200000G9) are under consideration and need not re-apply in this instance.]

5a0d66787b1164659139a65e.description:
HPC System Administrator
Information Technology Services Centre
(Post Ref.: 25/52)
Responsibilities
• Perform system administration tasks for various Linux distributions
• Oversee daily operations of High-Performance Computing (HPC) computing facilities, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning
• Manage user accounts and access to HPC resources running on Linux systems
• Manage and setup hardware and software for the HPC system
• Conduct regular health checks on all systems to proactively identify, resolve, or escalate issues
• Provide support to faculty members, students and other users of the HPC systems
• Assist users with job submission, scheduling and optimisation
• Work shifts and irregular hours as required
• Perform any other duties as requested by supervisors
Requirements
• A recognized bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
• At least 3 years of relevant work experience
• Proven experience in managing sizable Linux operating environments
• Proficiency with Linux/Unix operating systems, file systems and shell commands
• Proficiency with the installation of various Linux distributions, such as RHEL, Rocky, Ubuntu and Debian, from scratch
• Familiar with tools for installing and managing research software such as conda and docker/singularity
• Preferably with knowledge of HPC job schedulers such as Slurm
• Willing to learn HPC skills and technologies
• Good problem-solving skills
• Good communication and interpersonal skills for effective user support
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Candidates with less/more experience will be considered for appointment at a relevant rank.
Salary
and Benefits
The
rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include
annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and
gratuity.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for
recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer . Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified .
