79baeaba9d32e1cb0db6192e.description:
Assistant Professor
Division of Science
(Post Ref.: 26/128 )
The Division of Science (formerly known as Science Unit) (DoS) was established in 2015, comprising a dedicated team of scholars and researchers with expertise in biodiversity conservation, ecology, and sustainability analytics. The DoS offers 4 programmes in the field of environmental science and sustainability, including: (1) Minor in Environmental and Scientific Literacy; (2) MPhil in Environmental Science; (3) PhD in Environmental Science and
(4) Master of Science in Sustainability and Environmental Analytics. Apart from teaching and research, the DoS is highly engaged in community outreach and knowledge transfer activities. We promote science education and sustainable development through immersive field visits and internships, citizen science initiatives, and Service-Learning projects.
The Division of Science (DoS) invites applications for the position of Assistant Professor in biodiversity conservation, ecology, or a closely related field. We seek an outstanding and well-rounded scholar who can demonstrate excellence in research, teaching, student mentorship, grant acquisition, and external engagement. The successful candidate will be expected to obtain externally funded research projects, build and lead a productive research team, publish in high-impact peer-reviewed journals, and teach effectively at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels in a liberal arts setting. The appointee will also contribute to the academic, professional, outreach, and knowledge-transfer activities of the Division, School, and University, and is expected to build meaningful collaborations with local NGOs, government bodies, industry, and other external partners.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (1) a PhD/Post-doctoral experience in the field of biodiversity conservation ecology, or a closely related discipline; (2) relevant postdoctoral and/or independent research experience; (3) a strong publication record in peer-reviewed, international journals; (4) demonstrate success in securing competitive external research grants and fundings; (5) a strong commitment to excellent teaching, student supervision, outreach, and knowledge transfer; (6) experience in, or strong potential for, working with local NGOs and other external partners, and (7) the ability to contribute to, applied areas such as carbon auditing, sustainability assessment or related fields, alongside the university’s goal of producing socially significant research that informs sustainable development. The appointees are expected to submit applications for RGC grants, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click "Apply Now" to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will start immediately and continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

7a5491b5a51c9d85e5130480.description:
COLLEGE OF INTERNATIONAL EDUCATION
Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time Associate Degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage. English is used as the medium of instruction at the College. Applications are now invited for the following position:
Lecturer I / Lecturer II in English (24250306)
Responsibilities:
The appointee is required to perform teaching duties in related disciplines and perform administration duties; provide academic guidance to students; organise and coordinate experiential learning activities for students; and assist in the ongoing review and design of courses and programmes.
Requirements:
Applicants should have a higher degree, preferably a doctorate in Cultural Studies, Literature and/or Linguistics and at least three years relevant teaching experience at tertiary level. Applicants must show dedication and strong commitment to teaching and education within and beyond the classroom. They must also be a good team player with excellent communication skills. Ability to teach both English Language and English Literature will be an advantage. Applicants should have a strong link with industries and professional bodies and relevant professional qualifications.
Candidates with less experience will be considered for the post of Lecturer II.
Reference salary range:
Lecturer I : HK$51,000 - HK$86,000
Lecturer II : HK$38,000 - HK$53,000
The appointee will work at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of two years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications to the HKBU e-Recruitment System and send in their most recent teaching evaluation results . Those who are not invited for an interview four months after the submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. All application materials including publication samples, scholarly/creative works will be disposed of after completion of the recruitment exercise. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Dr Raymond Wong Research Centre for Arts Technology and Business
(Post Ref.: 26/169 )
Responsibilities
• Providing assistance in course preparation
• Attendance to evening classes and/or daytime classes as assigned
• Facilitating small team discussion under the supervision of the course instructors
• Coordinating various student activities
• Work closely with a team of teaching staff on a large-scale course, be responsible for practical and day-to-day aspects of course coordination, and support lectures on course delivery and assessment
• Performing other administrative duties as assigned
Requirements
• A bachelor’s degree or above, preferably a Master’s degree
• Good command of both English and Mandarin
• Excellent interpersonal, organizational skills and communication skills with ability to work independently
• Passionate in student caring are required
• Proactive, willing and capable to handle projects
• Having an understanding of the Taught Postgraduate Programme would be a plus
• Immediate availability will be an advantage
The appointee will work in the main campus and Satellite Campus Venues (Lingnan@WestKowloon), and may need to work outside normal office hours, including evenings and weekends.
Salary and Benefits
The commencing salary will be competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits and mandatory provident fund. Appointment will be normally made on a contract for one year, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance and the Centre’s operational need.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the posts advertised, or to fill the posts by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

7e05b6409f6dd339b3b34a44.description:
Department/ Unit: Faculty of Social Science
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Faculty of Social Science invites applications for a post at Lecturer rank for the new inter-Faculty undergraduate programme in Diplomacy and International Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong. This innovative programme aims to nurture high-level, interdisciplinary talent who are proficient in both Chinese and Western cultures and are prepared to excel in international relations, international organizations and diplomatic arenas. With a particular focus on China’s role in global governance, the programme sees to students’ developing a deep understanding of the historical, cultural, and political dimensions of China’s engagement in international affairs. For more details about the programme, please visit: https://socsc.cuhk.edu.hk/diplomacy-and-international-studies/introduction/ .
The appointee will be responsible for:
(a) supporting the development and continuous improvement of the new inter-Faculty undergraduate programme in meeting international standards;
(b) teaching and supporting curriculum design in areas such as international relations, international law and related disciplines; and
(c) coordinating programme administration, student advising, and collaborative activities with various programme partners/ stakeholders.
Applicants are expected to:
(i) have a PhD degree in International Relations/ International Law or related disciplines;
(ii) possess teaching experience in international relations, international law or related disciplines; and
(iii) be committed to and experienced in interdisciplinary collaboration, curriculum innovation, and student engagement.
Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to two years initially, targeted to start in August 2026 or as soon as practicable thereafter, renewable subject to performance, funding availability, and mutual agreement.
Application Procedure
To apply for the post, please complete the online application form, and submit a letter of interest, CV, teaching statement, past teaching performance records (if applicable), together with two reference letters.
Review of applications will commence from mid-May 2026. Applications will be considered until the post is filled.

7e95f9d7e4c327b6a6fb13f3.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Curriculum and Instruction
Closing Date: Until the position is filled
The Department of Curriculum and Instruction under the Faculty of Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a dynamic centre in the Asia-Pacific region for teaching and research in the broad areas of curriculum and instruction. In addition to Faculty-based undergraduate teacher education, Postgraduate Diploma in Education, Master of Education, Doctor of Education and PhD programmes, the Department offers several Master of Arts/ Science programmes as well as research supervision across a range of subject areas. The Faculty of Education of CUHK is an international centre for professional training and research in education. Detailed information about the Faculty of Education and the Department is available at http://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/ .
The Department now invites applications for full-time appointment as Associate Professor/ Assistant Professor in Curriculum Studies. Applicants should have (i) excellent academic qualifications including a relevant doctoral degree; (ii) a strong commitment to excellent teaching; and (iii) a track record of active research and publications. The ability to teach cross-disciplinary courses will be advantageous. Applicants for appointment as Associate Professor should have a track record of outstanding research and publications, as well as success in obtaining competitive research grants. They should also demonstrate strong scholarship with an international impact, evidenced by invitations to present at major international academic meetings, and experience in supervising research postgraduate students.
The appointee will (a) teach and design courses related to curriculum development, instructional design, and learning sciences in primary and secondary schools; (b) undertake scholarly research and seek external competitive research grants; (c) conduct teaching practicum supervision; (d) supervise postgraduate students; and (e) direct and manage programmes.
Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to funding and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. Applicants should complete the online application form and upload a full curriculum vitae with details of three referees.
Review of applications will start on March 30, 2026. Applications will be considered until the position is filled.
For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

7ee4277e5a59b0152bdde52f.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (IT Business Analyst) (Ref. No.: 25260789)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities :
The candidate will play a dual role as a System Analyst and IT Business Analyst, bridging business needs with technical implementation. The role requires strong analytical capability to translate user requirements into clear functional specifications, while also contributing to system design and development activities.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear user stories and functional specifications
Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to design practical, scalable solutions that meet business needs
Support development by providing clear requirements, guiding implementation, and ensuring alignment between business and technical delivery
Contribute to system design and development, and provide technical guidance to the developers
Analyze and document system interfaces, especially between legacy and new platforms, to ensure smooth integration and reliable data exchange
Participate in full SDLC activities, including requirements gathering, design, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support
Develop and enhance application solutions, including modernizing legacy systems to support evolving business needs
Prepare and maintain testing materials, system documentation, and user manuals to ensure quality and user adoption
Work closely with IT teams and business users on institution-wide IT initiatives and projects
Undertake other IT-related tasks and projects as assigned
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant experience in application development and business analysis, covering end-to-end system delivery across front-end, back-end, and database design
Strong business analysis skills with the ability to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions
Hands-on experience in system design and development, including responsive design and system integration
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment for the above post will be made on a fixed-term contract of one year. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

8112933522eaddd172b16e84.deadline_raw: Closing Date: Until the post is filled The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP). RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
8112933522eaddd172b16e84.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Electronic Engineering
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP).
RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
The research focuses on developing advanced energy saving technologies that integrate innovative materials, devices, and systems to enable intelligent detection and optical modulation. Key areas include smart materials design, optical modulation, and machine learning design for applications in energy saving, encryption, anticounterfeiting and beyond.
Applicants should have:
(i) a PhD in Materials Sciences , Physics, Chemistry or a related discipline;
(ii) a strong track record of research and publications in reputable journals, particularly in areas related to smart materials;
(iii) excellent communication and interpersonal skills; and
(iv) potential to become an independent researcher in obtaining future/sustained extramural funding and establishing significant externally-funded research programmes.
The appointee will work closely with Professor Long Yi in the Department to enhance the existing strengths. The appointee is expected to:
(a) be able to have top-tier research outputs and apply for RGC GRF grants and similar external competitive grants;
(b) undertake some teaching duties at undergraduate and postgraduate levels; and
(c) provide service at departmental, faculty and/or university levels.
HOW TO APPLY
To apply, please upload a full resume, copies of academic credentials, a publication list with soft copies of the five most representative publications, details of courses taught and evaluation results (if available), a research plan, a teaching statement, and the names and contact information of three to five referees.
Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years, renewable subject to performance, funding availability and mutual agreement. Review of applications will begin as soon as possible and only shortlisted applicants will be notified. Applications will be accepted until the post is filled.
Further information about the Department is available at http://www.ee.cuhk.edu.hk/ .

822d0e344df360555265424b.description:
Part-time Instructors (Assistant Coach) (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0006/26-27)
The School of Continuing Education (SCE) is one of the eight Faculties/Schools of the University. The School, operating on a self-financed basis, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes in various academic disciplines and professional areas.
Applications are now invited for the position of Part-time Instructors for a project tilted “The effectiveness of the 8-week GreenCare Programme in improving glycated haemoglobin levels, physical activity, and mental wellbeing in individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus in Hong Kong: A randomised controlled trial”.
Responsibilities
Physical Assessment & Exercise Prescription: Assist the research team in conducting baseline and follow-up physical assessments (including health-related and functional fitness tests) for individuals with type 2 diabetes, and design personalized indoor and outdoor (park circuit) aerobic and resistance exercise prescriptions based on their health conditions.
Lead Supervised Exercise Classes: Direct each session for 1.5-hour supervised exercise sessions (including indoor group training and park circuit sessions), demonstrate correct exercise techniques, and ensure participants' safety and proper exercise intensity.
Supervise Student Helpers: Assist in directing and supervising student helpers from Nursing, Physiotherapy, and Physical Education disciplines during exercise sessions.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Principal Investigator (PI), Physiotherapists, and Research Assistants to ensure all interventions strictly adhere to the study protocol.
Requirements

82484c27c1df5edb9ff100ab.description:
ERB Instructors
[Ref: 2026/ACAD023]
Duties
The appointee is expected to deliver various ERB courses at Levels 3 and 4, primarily focused on skill uplifting. This includes preparing course materials, conducting assessments, and providing constructive feedback to students to enhance their learning experience.
Requirements
All applicants must hold a Degree or Master’s degree in a relevant field, with a minimum of three years of teaching experience, along with relevant working experience in one of the following fields:
Project Management : Candidates should have a robust background in managing projects, with a preference for those holding certifications in Agile methodologies or CAPM. A minimum of five years of experience in leading teams, executing projects on time and within budget, and a proven track record of achieving project objectives is essential.
Online Business and Marketing : Applicants should demonstrate a strong foundation in digital marketing strategies, with at least three years of experience in online business development and collaboration with key opinion leaders in marketing. Experience in developing and implementing successful marketing campaigns is highly desirable.
Financial Services : Instructors should possess significant experience in financial planning and analysis, specifically with a focus on preparation for AFP® certification. Candidates should have at least five years of relevant industry experience, including roles in financial consulting or investment management.
Blockchain Development : Candidates must have hands-on experience in blockchain applications, including the development and implementation of blockchain solutions. A minimum of three years of experience in this field, along with a strong understanding of smart contracts and decentralized applications, is required.
Data Analysis : Applicants should have practical experience in data analytics, including proficiency in analytical tools and techniques that drive business insights. Candidates should have at least three years of experience in data analysis roles, preferably in a business or technology context.
Cloud Computing : Candidates should have substantial experience in cloud technologies, including deployment and management of cloud-based solutions. A minimum of three years of experience in cloud architecture or administration is required.
Mobile Application Development : Instructors should have a background in developing Android applications, with experience in both foundational and advanced programming techniques. Candidates should have at least three years of relevant development experience, including familiarity with app deployment and user experience design.
Professional English Training : Candidates must have experience in teaching business English, including writing, listening, and speaking skills tailored for professional environments. A minimum of three years of teaching experience in an adult education or corporate training setting is essential.
Putonghua Language Training : Instructors should have experience in teaching Putonghua, particularly in business communication contexts. Candidates should have at least three years of teaching experience, with a focus on practical language use in professional settings.
Arabic Language Training : Instructors will be responsible for teaching both fundamental and service-related language short courses, each comprising 30 contact hours. Applicants must hold a recognised university degree in Languages, Arts, Translation, English, or a closely related discipline, together with demonstrable experience in teaching the Arabic language.
Russian Language Training : Instructors will be responsible for teaching both fundamental and service-related language short courses, each comprising 30 contact hours. Applicants must hold a recognised university degree in Language, Arts, Translation, English, or a closely related discipline, together with demonstrable experience in teaching the Russian language.
Arboriculture : Candidates must be ISA Certified Arborists with a minimum of two years of experience in the field.
Risk Management (AI Applications) : Instructors will be responsible for delivering the "Certificate in Risk Management and Decision-Making (AI Applications)" course, which comprises 30 hours of instruction. Applicants must hold a recognised university degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Risk Management, or a related discipline. Candidates should also possess a PMI® certification (PMI-PMP® or PMI-RMP®) and have a minimum of five years of professional experience in project risk management. This must include practical, hands-on experience in applying artificial intelligence to risk management contexts.
Salary and Conditions of Service
Remuneration package will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The salary is based on an hourly rate ranging from $450 to $650, depending on the level of the course, number of participants and the qualifications of the instructor. For specialized professional courses that have specific instructor requirements, such as project management, the hourly rate may reach up to $1,000, subject to the instructor's expertise and the course's complexity.
Information and Application
Please submit a Cover Letter together with a Curriculum Vitae and a completed Application Form to UOWCHK, c/o Human Resources Unit, UOW College Hong Kong, 1/F, 18 Che Kung Miu Road, Tai Wai, N.T., Hong Kong or by Email: uowchk-hr@uow.edu.au . The Application Form is available for download under “Job Applications” on our website.
Please note that applications submitted without a complete Application Form will not be processed . Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please quote the reference number in the application. Applications will receive full consideration and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
UOWCHK is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to the principles of diversity, inclusiveness and equality. Personal data provided by applicants will be used strictly in accordance with UOWCHK’s personal data policy and for recruitment and other employment-related purposes.

Applicants should have (i) a PhD degree in biological sciences or related disciplines; and (ii) demonstrated research ability and experience in cell biology, molecular biology, patient derived cancer models for personalized therapy, anti-cancer drug studies (in-vitro and in-vivo) or other advanced techniques such as next-generation sequencing (NGS). Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education. It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a better world. Moving forward, Lingnan University is well positioned to take lead as a comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful research and innovations.
Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies. To foster interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students. With traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and critical thinking skills to thrive in the future. Subsequent to the establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric technology and social policies. Further information about Lingnan University is available at
https://www.ln.edu.hk/ .

Assistant Professor of Teaching
Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies
(Post Ref.: 26/199)
The Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies (WJYSIS) was established to deepen interdisciplinary studies and scholarly collaboration. The WJYSIS houses a number of interdisciplinary undergraduate programmes and now invites applications for the position of Assistant Professor of Teaching for the Global Development and Sustainability (GDS) programme. The WJYSIS is seeking a dynamic educator committed to fostering excellence through interdisciplinary teaching, while providing robust leadership in the day-to-day management and development of the GDS programme.
The appointee will be responsible for teaching core courses within the GDS programme, employing a comprehensive interdisciplinary approach to sustainable development. Candidates should be experienced in interdisciplinary, active, and project-based pedagogies, fostering an engaging learning environment that bridges theory and practice. All teaching will be conducted in English.
In addition to teaching, the appointee will:
· Engage in robust student advising and mentoring to support academic and professional development.
· Assume the role of Programme Director for GDS, providing leadership in programme management, curriculum enhancement, and strategic development.
· Contribute to departmental service and the continuous improvement of the student experience.
We welcome applications from candidates with expertise in fields related to global development and sustainability, including but not limited to human geography, environmental policy, sustainability economics, green urban design, humanitarian technology, climate change and public health, ecocultural tourism, biocultural diversity, community resilience, ESG and CSR. Priority will be given to candidates with interdisciplinary expertise.
Requirements
Candidates should have (i) a doctoral degree in relevant disciplines; and (ii) a minimum of 3 years’ experience in teaching relevant courses and relevant programme administrative experience.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click "Apply Now" to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
Research Assistant Professor in Computer Science (25260697)
The Department presently offers BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD programmes, and is now seeking outstanding applicants for the Research Assistant Professor positions (3 vacancies).
Responsibilities:
The positions are created and funded as part of the strategic research development initiatives in the Department. The appointees will be provided with a conducive research environment, and will work within an established group of faculty in the Department. They are also expected to perform group-based high-impact research and undertake some teaching duties.
Requirements:
Applicants should possess a PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, and sufficiently demonstrate abilities to conduct high-quality research in one of the Department's key research areas: (i) Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning; (ii) Big Data Analytics and Management; (iii) Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition; and (iv) Distributed Systems and Networking. These key research areas have a special thematic focus on (a) Health Informatics and (b) Security and Privacy-aware Computing related applications.
The initial appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract of two to three years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
For enquiry, please contact Prof. Jianliang Xu, Head of Department (email: xujl@comp.hkbu.edu.hk). More information about the Department can be found on its website at https://www.comp.hkbu.edu.hk.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

8581ac8a734f6f82ee5316e9.description:
School of Nursing
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Nursing
(Ref. 260730013)
Established in 1977, the School of Nursing supports the mission of the University by nurturing graduates who are critical thinkers, effective communicators, innovative problem solvers, lifelong learners and ethical leaders. It ranks 18 th for the best School of Nursing internationally (QS Ranking 2026). The education, research, consultancy and integrative health services are driven by a commitment to improve health of the community. Currently, it has a total of around 80 full-time faculty members. We welcome candidates from all nursing disciplines, including critical care, mental health, as well as prevention and infection control.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) provide quality teaching at undergraduate and postgraduate levels and supervise student projects and theses;
(b) conduct research that leads to publications in refereed journals and award of research grants;
(c) engage in applied research, creative development and consultancy projects in relation to health care related activities;
(d) contribute to the development of the School’s relevant research theme and participate in its activities;
(e) contribute to departmental activities and management;
(f) render professional service to the community and support activities that promote or foster links with the profession in the industry and/or in the community; and
(g) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of School or his/her delegates.
Applicants for appointment at Professor level should enhance his/her own international academic impact, play an active role in international academic exchange, and engage in services that contribute to the development of the School.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in Nursing or a relevant discipline with substantial years of relevant experience;
(b) professional nursing qualifications;
(c) a substantial record and reputation as an accomplished teacher with significant contribution to curriculum development / review or teaching and learning processes;
(d) an established track record in research and scholarship, including refereed publications, external grants and postgraduate supervision; and
(e) demonstrated academic management and leadership capabilities.
Applicants for appointment at Professor level should demonstrate a strong background in research in one of the school research themes with an international academic profile. They should also demonstrate excellent international reputation in research and possess an excellent record of academic leadership and research scholarship, both in terms of publications and funded research. Applicants with less experience will be considered for appointment at the level of Associate Professor/Assistant Professor. The job duty requirements and expectation would be in line with the appointed grade.
Preference will be given to those who are registrable with The Nursing Council of Hong Kong.
Applicants are invited to contact Professor Janelle Yorke, Head of School of Nursing via email at janelle.yorke@polyu.edu.hk for further information.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment for Assistant Professor will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Associate Professor and Professor levels. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 13 August 2026 until the position is filled.
Apply Now
Posting date: 30 July 2026

Postdoctoral Fellow
Division of Industrial Data Science
(Post Ref.: 26/112)
The main responsibilities of this post are to (i) conduct research and evaluation studies; (ii) collect and analyse data; (iii) participate in grant proposals and execution; (iv) participate in and help building academy-industry research; (v) advise several graduate students; (vi) draft manuscripts and write reports; (vii) assist in different research activities and handle administrative work and perform any other duties as assigned by the Person-in-charge or her delegates. The appointees are expected to submit applications for RGC grants, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (i) a PhD degree in imaging science or related field or an equivalent qualification; (ii) demonstrate research skills in imaging science and machine learning, particularly on image reverse engineering, fake image and video detection, statistical detection models and mathematical models of image processing; (iii) demonstrate experience in academy-industry projects; (iv) interest in publishing high-quality journal papers in the field; (v) demonstrated leadership in research projects; and (vi) fluency of written and spoken English required. Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than three years prior to the commencement of the appointment.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on a fixed-term contract of up to three years.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

85fa908fef44219d92068854.description:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
With offers of BSc (Hons) in Chemistry, BSc (Hons) in Analytical and Testing Sciences, MSc in Analytical Chemistry, MPhil (by research), and PhD degrees, the Department presently has around 150 undergraduate students, 70 taught postgraduate students and 90 research students and project staff.
The Department places a strong emphasis on both quality education and scholarly research/services, and has reached a significant milestone where its educational programmes are not only innovative but also accessible, and its major areas of research strength are well recognised and supported. It is now inviting applications for the position of:
Associate Professor / Assistant Professor (25260426)
Responsibilities:
The appointee will be expected to conduct independent, high-quality research, foster interdisciplinary collaborations, and demonstrate research achievements of originality and depth. The ideal candidate will have the potential to become a leading international scholar and contribute to impactful research and innovative technological applications.
The appointee will also supervise MPhil and PhD students, develop a vigorous research program at the forefront of basic and translational chemical / environmental engineering, and engage in broader scholarly activities such as organising academic conferences, symposia, and seminars.
Requirements:
Applicants should hold a PhD in Chemical Science or Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science or Environmental Engineering, Biomedical Science or Biomedical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. They must have relevant postdoctoral research experience, an excellent track record of publications in high-impact peer-reviewed international journals (as first and/or senior author), and a strong history of securing external research funding through competitive grants.
Expertise in chemical, biomedical, and/or environmental science and engineering including AI for chemistry is highly desirable, as it will complement the department’s existing strengths in related research and pedagogical areas. Candidates with proven potential for impactful translational research are especially encouraged to apply.
For enquiries, please contact Professor Kangning REN, Head of Department (email: chem@hkbu.edu.hk).
More information about the Department can be found at https://chem.hkbu.edu.hk/.
This is a tenure-track position with an initial appointment to be made on a fixed-term contract of three years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. Tenure is expected to be attained within six years.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System with samples of publications, preferably three best ones out of their most recent publications/works. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

86b6e845a032633ce18c7b5f.department: Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
86b6e845a032633ce18c7b5f.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
Closing Date: Until the position(s) are filled
The Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), is an academic department based at the Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH), a 1,637-bed tertiary referral teaching hospital. The hospital provides a wide range of acute specialist services, including stroke, obstetric, cardiac and trauma centres. The clinical service provides anaesthesia for 14,000 operations in the main operating theatres, with one third being emergency cases, with an additional 2000 anaesthetics are administered in other areas. The 26-bed adult intensive care unit provides medical and surgical critical care for approximately 1800 patients per year. The department is committed to achieving excellence in education and research and maintains active educational and research collaborations with numerous international and mainland institutions.
Applicants should have (i) a medical qualification (approved for registration with the Hong Kong Medical Council); (ii) a higher qualification in anaesthesia or intensive care registrable with the Hong Kong Medical Council Specialist Registry ; (iii) a minimum of five years' relevant post registration experience; and (iv) teaching/training experience in relevant disciplines.
The appointee(s) will perform clinical duties in either Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH) or CUHK Medical Centre (CUMC), assist in the teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students, support training of junior doctors, assist in clinical research and other duties as assigned by the Department Chairperson.
Salary will follow the standard pay scale of the Clinical Academic track of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and will depend on successful applicant’s prior experience and pay grade at their current or recent appointments. Appointment(s) will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years, renewable subject to performance and mutual agreement.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Senior Research Officer / Research Officer
Department of Digital Arts and Creative Industries
(Post Ref.: 26/141 )
The appointee will be involved in a few research projects led by Professor Matthew Ming-tak CHEW, an Associate Professor at the Department of Digital Arts and Creative Industries at Lingnan University ( https://www.ln.edu.hk/daci/our-people/faculty/prof-matthew-ming-tak-chew ). These research projects aim at producing journal articles on citizens’ reception of popular and social culture in China and Hong Kong.
Responsibilities
• Collate several sets of already collected quantitative survey data
• Perform quantitative data analyses based on these sets of data
• Support in conducting qualitative in-depth interviews
• Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor
Requirements
• Hold a Bachelor’s degree or above in Sociology, Social Policy, Cultural Studies, Political Science, Communications, Psychology, or related disciplines
• Proficiency in using statistical analysis software (SPSS or others)
• Possess sound knowledge of quantitative research methods and the ability to interpret results effectively
• Basic familiarity with critical social science and humanities
• The ability to work independently
• Previous experience in undertaking social statistics research is highly preferred
Candidates with less/more experience will also be considered for appointment at a relevant rank.
The appointee is expected to meet the Project Investigator regularly to report the progress.

88933dc4b56482afda26d9ff.description:
School of Hotel and Tourism Management
Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, Event Management or Information Technology in Hospitality & Tourism
(Ref. 260904007)
The School of Hotel and Tourism Management (SHTM) at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University seeks a qualified faculty member at the rank of Associate Professor or Assistant Professor to join its dynamic faculty of more than 90 members drawn from around 20 countries and regions.
The SHTM sets itself apart from other hospitality and tourism educational institutions by consistently earning a high standing in the upper echelons of international rankings. Placed No. 1 in the world in the “Hospitality and Tourism Management” category in ShanghaiRanking’s Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025 for the ninth consecutive year, ranked No. 1 globally in the “Commerce, Management, Tourism and Services” category in the University Ranking by Academic Performance in 2024/2025 for eight years in a row, rated No. 1 in the world in the “Hospitality, Leisure, Sport & Tourism” subject area by the CWUR Rankings by Subject 2017, and ranked No. 2 globally among comprehensive universities in the “Hospitality and Leisure Management” subject area in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026, the SHTM is a symbol of excellence in the field, exemplifying its motto of Leading Hospitality and Tourism . The Hong Kong Polytechnic University is among the world’s top 100 universities (No. 50 in QS World University Rankings 2027 and No. 80 in Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026).
The School currently enrols more than 1,500 students from close to 50 countries and regions around the world, offering a comprehensive range of programmes from bachelor’s and master’s degrees to professional doctoral (Doctor of Hotel and Tourism Management) and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) programmes. Through Hotel ICON ( www.hotel-icon.com ), the School’s groundbreaking teaching and research hotel and a vital aspect of its paradigm-shifting approach to hospitality and tourism education, the SHTM is advancing teaching, learning and research, inspiring a new generation of passionate, pioneering professionals to take their positions as leaders in the hospitality and tourism industry. Please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/shtm/ for more information about the School.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) teach and contribute to curriculum development at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels and supervise doctoral research;
(b) conduct impactful research that leads to publications in top-tier refereed journals, awards of external research grants, and meaningful societal impact;
(c) initiate, lead and participate in knowledge-transfer activities and other scholarly activities;
(d) undertake academic administration duties and departmental service; and
(e) perform any other duties as assigned by the Dean of the School or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) normally a PhD degree or equivalent in Hospitality, Tourism, Business or a related discipline;
(b) demonstrated potential for excellent teaching and research excellence; and
(c) substantial industry experience related to the position.
Applicants for appointment at Associate Professor level should have substantial university teaching experience and an excellent portfolio of teaching in respective areas, and demonstrated academic leadership in hospitality and tourism through research as evidenced by publications in top rated journals, awards of research grants, scholarship and high-level consultancy in respective areas.
Preferences will be given to candidates with a track record of research and expertise in smart technology applications, AI, robotics, big data analytics and innovations/entrepreneurship as related to hospitality, tourism and/or event management.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment for Assistant Professor will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Associate Professor level. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
In addition to a highly competitive compensation package, a start-up research fund and staff development support can be provided to the qualified appointees. Appointee is paid on a monthly basis for 12 months annually.
Consideration of applications will commence on 15 September 2026 until the position is filled.
Apply Now
Posting date: 4 September 2026

Research Assistant Professor
Institute of Insurance and Risk Management
(Post Ref.: 25/312)
Established in 2021, the Institute of Insurance and Risk Management is a department-level, research-focused unit which holds the Lingnan University-Sun Yat-sen University GBA Research Institute for Insurance and a Risk Management (LU-SYSU IRM). The Institute’s goal is to become a leading centre of excellence in research activities and talent trainings for the risk management and insurance industry in Hong Kong, Chinese Mainland, and the Region. The Institute will also contribute to developing Hong Kong as a premier international insurance hub through its academic and practice-oriented research as well as other related activities such as organizing industry-oriented forums, hosting various conferences and symposiums for academics and practitioners, and conducting practice-oriented surveys.
The Institute is looking for a Research Assistant Professor, who will primarily focus on conducting scholarly research and obtain external grants, teach undergraduate/ postgraduate courses and contribute to services.
General Requirements
Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification in a Risk and Insurance or related discipline for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment. In addition, the candidates should demonstrate strong commitment to quality research activities. Ideally, the candidate would have relevant experience in recognized institutions and a sound track record in research, scholarly activities, publications in top-tier journals and competitive grants. Applicants should provide information about their work experience, qualifications, research interests and achievements, and a statement of publication record. The appointee is expected to submit applications for RGC grants, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for two years.

89ec7d3358311e2b69305cfe.description:
Department of Building Environment and Energy Engineering
Visiting Lecturer (Part-time) in Building Environment
(Ref. 260624007)
[Appointment period: from September 2026 to May 2027]
The Department of Building Environment and Energy Engineering (BEEE) contributes to PolyU’s world ranking of 21st for Architecture and Built Environment and 18th for Civil and Structural Engineering in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026. BEEE is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Construction and Environment, and offers a full range of programmes leading to the awards of Doctor of Philosophy, Master of Philosophy, Master of Engineering, Master of Science and Bachelor of Engineering. Currently there are over 35 research staff and 190 research students (over 180 studying for PhD), over 600 full-time / part-time Master’s students, an undergraduate student body of over 250 full-time students. BEEE currently has over 50 full-time academic / teaching staff members engaging in a wide range of research activities organised in the following three themes:
Building Energy : Energy issues in buildings addressed in the context of both demand and supply to promote sustainable built environments, urban energy systems and emerging clean energy technologies.
Building Environment : Optimisation of buildings and built environments for thermal comfort, indoor air quality, visual / spatial and vibration / acoustic aspects to improve occupant health and productivity, and extraterrestrial human habitats.
Building Safety and Resilience : Protection of building occupants from hazards such as fire and lightning to improve safety and resilience of communities, buildings and the built environments.
The University and the Department strongly encourage a multi-cultural environment regarding both the staff and student body composition. Please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/beee/ for further information about the Department.
Duties
The appointee will be required to teach and conduct assessments in the daytime course “ Water System Engineering in Built Environments (BSE4312) ” to undergraduate students in Semester 2 of the 2026/2027 academic year.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree OR a master’s degree in a related discipline with corporate membership in relevant professional bodies such as HKIE, CIBSE or CIPHE;
(b) at least three years of post-qualification teaching / practical training experience in a related discipline; and
(c) a good command of written and spoken English, and strong communication skills.
Conditions of Service
The remuneration rate is HK$900 per hour.
C onsideration of applications will commence on 8 July 2026 until the position is filled .

Department/ Unit: Department of Biomedical Engineering
Closing Date: June 1, 2027
The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a widely accepted top institute in Asia (e.g. ranked #7 in QS Asia University Rankings 2026) with a high degree of global academic reputation (e.g. ranked #18 in QS World University Rankings 2027). The Faculty of Engineering at CUHK is famous for its research in optics and photonics, dating back to the early 1970s when Prof Charles Kao (2009 Nobel Laureate in Physics) joined CUHK.
The Department of Biomedical Engineering (BME) is the newest in the Faculty of Engineering. Still, it has already grown into global academic excellence (world #38 in 2025 Shanghai Ranking of Academic Subjects – Biomedical Engineering) and is consistently ranked No. 1 in Hong Kong. We are inviting applications for the post of Research Assistant Professor (RAP) in BME to engage in a project related to glycosaminoglycan-rich biomaterials for musculoskeletal tissue engineering applications. The project is highly interdisciplinary, involving areas of biomaterials, extracellular matrix, stem cells, mechanoregulation and musculoskeletal disorders.
Opportunities for Growth
The RAP position offers great opportunities for professional development, including leading independent cutting-edge research projects, mentoring postdocs and graduate students, collaborating with world-leading research groups, applying for grants and classroom teaching.
Requirements
Applicants should (i) possess a doctoral degree in the STEM field, such as biomedical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer engineering and applied physics; (ii) have a solid academic background in biomaterials, extracellular matrix, musculoskeletal tissue engineering and an excellent research track record; (iii) demonstrate a strong academic track record as evidenced by publishing in high-profile journals or conferences; and (iv) have proficiency in both written and spoken English. Solid postdoctoral training on carbohydrate materials is essential, but applicants with exceptional research achievements will be considered case-by-case. Experience in leading research projects independently is required, and success in research grant applications will be considered an advantage.
Research Directions
The RAP position is dedicated to working and developing glycosaminoglycan-rich biomaterials for musculoskeletal applications. This project is based on our prior foundation of complex extracellular matrix biomaterials for tissue engineering. Through the already-established collaboration, this study will pave the way for upcoming clinical translation in musculoskeletal tissue engineering and support the translation of Hong Kong’s scientific excellence into societal impacts. The specific aims and deliverables of research projects will be discussed with the PI, considering the applicant’s expertise, interests, and prior experience.
Responsibilities
The appointee’s roles and contributions include: (a) carry on the proposed project under the lead of the PI (Prof. CHAN Barbara): specifically, the appointee will (i) coordinate the GAG-rich biomaterial program; (ii) assist in mentoring RPg students working on the project; (iii) collaborate with biologists/clinicians to explore broad applications of the project; and (iv) prepare conference/journal manuscripts and drafting patents; (b) generate high-impact research outputs that are equivalent to the 4* research output in RAE: the appointee is expected to have cross-field working experience to support the multidisciplinary nature of this project; and (c) apply for external grants from RGC/NSFC/ITC/etc.: the appointee will be fostered to be an independent researcher with a good track record of securing external grants. The research results from this project are expected to strongly support the appointee in applying for and securing external grants.
Salary and Contract Details
Salary will be commensurate with the applicant’s qualifications and experience. Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years, starting as soon as possible, renewable subject to funding availability, performance and mutual agreement.
How to Apply
Applicants should submit an online application and attach a full resume, a list of publications, copies of academic credentials, together with names, addresses and e-mail addresses of three to five referees to whom the applicants' consent has been given for their providing references. The review of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the positions are filled. Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

UNDERGRADUATE STUDIES SECTION
Programme Officer (26270014)
The UG Studies Section administers one of the largest UG programmes at HKBU, offering 8 business concentrations to over 1,900 students. We are seeking a highly motivated, enthusiastic and service-oriented team player to join our dynamic team and undertake a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Administering financial support schemes and providing guidance to students on application and funding matters;
Coordinating financial, reimbursement, procurement and related administrative processes in accordance with University policies and procedures;
Managing scholarship administration, including nomination, assessment, and award processes, and liaising with relevant stakeholders; and
Performing other duties as assigned.

A recognised bachelor's degree with at least 2 years of relevant work experience, preferably in student affairs, event management or programme administration;
Good organisational, communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills;

A positive, proactive, and service-oriented attitude, with attention to detail;
Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (including Putonghua), with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; and
Experience in student engagement initiatives will be an advantage.

Salary and rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. 8db13d0931a1c057a728159a.description:
SCHOOL OF CREATIVE ARTS
Technical Manager (Creative Hub) (26270092)
The School of Creative Arts (SCA), comprised of three well-established academic units: the Academy of Film, the Academy of Music, and the Academy of Visual Arts. Established on July 1, 2022, SCA is dedicated to nurturing future-ready talents for Hong Kong and beyond, while making a significant impact on society through innovative research and transdisciplinary studies.
SCA is seeking a creative, strategic, and results-driven Technical Manager to provide hands-on leadership and management of the audio, video, venue operations, and equipment inventory systems for the Jockey Club Creative Hub. Working closely with the Executive Director, the successful candidate will play a key role in the development of technical infrastructure, manage day-to-day technical resource allocations, and ensure the seamless delivery of academic, education, commercial, and art-tech initiatives.
Responsibilities:
Oversee the Hub's master asset inventory, preventative maintenance schedules, and asset tracking systems for all state-of-the-art facilitates and equipment;
Act as the direct supervisor and Team Lead for the Hub's multi-disciplinary technical staff, driving daily task assignments, workflows, and performance standards; establish and enforce strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for venue usage;
Assist the Executive Director in aligning the Hub’s comprehensive technical capabilities with long-term academic curricula, high-level strategic programming, and institutional goals, managing operational budgets, evaluating equipment proposals, and handling the technical vetting for high-value equipment purchases, maintenance contracts, and upgrades;
Command the operational readiness and end-to-end setups across all flagship spaces, ensuring flawless coordination between the audio, filming/video, and physical staging pipelines; and
Undertaking other technical related duties and special assignments as required.
Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Music Production, Music Technology, Electronic Engineering, Stage Management, Creative Media, or a related technology-management discipline;
A minimum of 7 years of solid, verifiable professional experience in a major commercial studio complex, major performing arts centre, or elite academic production venue. Proven experience in a technical crew lead, team supervisor, or management-track capacity is required;
Strong interpersonal skills with a proven track record of managing technical teams, resolving operational friction on the ground, and translating complex engineering concepts into clear updates for senior management and non-technical stakeholders; and
Exceptional organisational discipline, with the agility to multi-task, manage tight production turnarounds, and dynamically adapt to changing institutional project priorities.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written and skills assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract for up to 2 years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of the application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

8f5e9a5f97d7ff72ce82dfce.description:
Department/Unit: School of Pharmacy
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
School of Pharmacy at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) invites applications for a tenure track faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor. We seek a highly motivated and collaborative scholar with a research focus that advances the fields of health economics, pharmacoepidemiology, medication safety, real-world data science, pharmacogenomics, or pharmacovigilance.
This position offers an outstanding opportunity to develop an independent, externally funded research program within a vibrant academic community. The successful candidate will contribute to the School’s mission of improving patient care and public health through innovative research and education.
Responsibilities:
The appointee is expected to:
(a) develop and maintain an independent, rigorous, and externally funded research programme;
(b) publish scholarly work in high-impact, peer-reviewed journals;
(c) contribute to the teaching mission of the School by instructing professional (Bachelor of Pharmacy) and graduate (Master of Clinical Pharmacy, MPhil and PhD in Pharmacy) students in relevant areas;
(d) mentor graduate students and postdoctoral fellows;
(e) provide service to the School, College, University, and the broader professional community; and
(f) other academic and professional duties assigned by the School Director.
Required Qualifications:
Applicants should have:
(i) a PharmD, PhD, or equivalent doctoral degree in pharmacoeconomics, pharmacoepidemiology, health outcomes research, pharmaceutical sciences, public health, or a closely related discipline;
(ii) a strong record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated by publications in peer-reviewed journals relevant to the stated research fields;
(iii) evidence of potential to secure independent external research funding;
(iv) excellent written and verbal communication skills; and
(v) a commitment to excellence in teaching and mentoring a diverse body of students.
Preferred Qualifications:
Applicants with the following will have an advantage:
(i) postdoctoral research experience or equivalent;
(ii) a proven record of, or strong potential for, interdisciplinary collaboration; and
(iii) experience in teaching or teaching assistant role in the pharmacy-related fields at the university level.
Review of applications will commence in February 2026 and continue until the post is filled. Candidates will be contacted before references being approached, and all grants will be validated with the appropriate funding agency.
Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation later.
For enquiries, please contact: pharmacy@cuhk.edu.hk
About the School:
The School of Pharmacy CUHK is a leader in pharmaceutical education, research, and practice. Our faculty members are at the forefront of discovery in drug development, clinical pharmacy, and population-based health sciences. We offer state-of-the-art research facilities, a supportive collegial environment, and strong collaborative ties with our academic medical center, other health science schools, and regional healthcare systems. For more information about our School's education programmes and research, please visit School's website https://www.pharmacy.cuhk.edu.hk .
Application Procedure:
To apply, please submit an online application with the following attachments:
1) a cover letter addressing qualifications and alignment with the position;
2) a statement of research interest and future plan (max 3 pages);
3) a statement of your teaching philosophy and experience (max 2 pages);
4) a comprehensive curriculum vitae; and
5) contact details for at least three professional references.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Research Assistant Professor
Department of Philosophy
(Post Ref.: 25/218)
The Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University is one of the best for analytic philosophy in Asia. It has particular research strengths in aesthetics, ethics, Chinese philosophy, metaphysics, philosophy of mind, philosophical logic, philosophy of science, and political philosophy. In addition to having a thriving research community, the department will be launching a Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Philosophy and AI Programme from 2025-26 and offers the Master in Arts 'Artificial Intelligence and the Future' in conjunction with the Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre (HKCRC).
More information on the research interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.LN.edu.hk/philoso/ .
Requirements
The Department seeks to appoint a Research Assistant Professor who can either teach a specialized course in Set Theory or effectively cover existing departmental courses to enable a current colleague to teach the Set Theory course. While preference will be given to candidates with expertise in Set Theory, this is not a strict requirement. We welcome applications from candidates who possess teaching competence in set theory or demonstrate the ability to effectively teach courses currently offered by other department members (including Critical Thinking, Philosophy of Artificial Intelligence, and Deductive Logic).
Candidates should have a PhD in Philosophy (or related disciplines) by the start of the appointment and a record of publications in Philosophy, preferably in leading journals.
Candidates should have obtained/been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment. The appointee is expected to either teach a cluster course titled "Introduction to Set Theory and Applications" (which would be open to all levels of undergraduate students in the University) or take on teaching responsibilities that allow a departmental colleague to deliver this specialized course. In addition, he/she would be expected to conduct focused research, publish scholarly outputs in respectable refereed international journals, and apply for competitive peer-reviewed grants offered by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes. Teaching experience at undergraduate programme levels is a definite advantage.
Research: The Research Assistant Professor will (i) carry out research and submit papers to top journals (e.g., including 3*/4*-ranked journals as per the current departmental journal list), and (ii) organize seminars, reading groups, workshops or other related research activities (especially in relation to new departmental initiatives).
Teaching: The teaching load will be three courses per year, distributed according to the needs of the Department and upon mutual agreement. English will be the language of instruction. The appointee may be required to teach courses on both undergraduate and taught postgraduate level, and to supervise students' capstone projects. Potential courses to be taught include: Introduction to Set Theory and Applications, Critical Thinking, Philosophy of Artificial Intelligence, and other courses within the candidate's area of expertise that meet departmental needs.
Service: The appointee will perform administrative duties as assigned by the Head of Department in accordance with the current guidelines.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of one year which is renewable subject to availability of funding.
The starting date would be no later than January 2027 or later (negotiable). The initial application must include:
1. An updated CV
2. A letter of interest
3. One writing sample (no more than one writing sample will be read)
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
Application deadline: 30 October 2026 (Friday)
Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references. Informal inquiries concerning the post can be directed to the Head of Department, Professor Andrea Sauchelli at andreasauchelli@ln.edu.hk .
We are an equal opportunities employer. The review of applications will start and continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
