968365a7db43990bf7a602cd.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology
Closing Date: December 31, 2026
The Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology comprises over 40 faculty members specializing in three research areas: Operations Management, Management Information Systems, and Business Economics. The Department now invites applications for a tenure-track faculty position in the area of Operations Management commencing Fall 2027. Applicants for all professoriate ranks will be considered.
Applicants should have (i) a PhD degree in Operations Management/Operations Research, or other related disciplines (by the time reporting for duty); (ii) high competence in research and demonstrated research interest in, but not limited to, business analytics, revenue management, service operations, supply chain management; and (iii) strong commitment to teaching and services. The appointee will teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses offered by the Department. Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to performance and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation. Senior applicants should have an outstanding track record of research and teaching accomplishments. CUHK Business School provides internationally competitive remuneration, generous research support and funding, and relocation assistance for international faculty relocating to Hong Kong.
The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific. The School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with over 6,500 students from 30+ countries/regions, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 49,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
Accountancy
Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
Decisions, Operations and Technology
Finance
Management
Marketing
Application Procedure
Please submit your application package (including a letter of interest, a full resume and recent teaching-related information such as teaching evaluations) via the CUHK career site and at least three reference letters should be sent directly to the Chairperson, Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology by the referees via e-mail ( dote@cuhk.edu.hk ). We will invite shortlisted candidates for in-person interviews at the INFORMS Annual Meeting (2026). Interested candidates are advised to submit the application by October 9, 2026 with information of their presentations at INFORMS, if any.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Professor/ Associate Professor/ Assistant Professor ( Sustainable and Environmental Design )
(Ref. 260000I9) (Closing Date: Until the post is filled)
The Chinese University of Hong Kong is one of the world’s leading universities. Its location makes it one of the most exciting places to research on and teach architecture.
The School of Architecture has a world-class, research-led and professionally connected learning environment. It embraces new approaches to architectural education and cross-disciplinary research that impact society and profession.
The School has an ambitious growth plan and is seeking an outstanding candidate to lead the development in the area of Sustainable and Environmental Design .
The appointees will drive forward a research agenda and deliver teaching for undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, while building research collaborations within the University and beyond.
Applicants should (i) have a PhD degree in a subject area relevant to architecture or urbanism; (ii) strong commitment to excellence in research and teaching; and (iii) outstanding accomplishments and research potential.

96f6b0d1069b151cfa2a85a2.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology
Closing Date: February 28, 2027
The Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology comprises over 40 faculty members specializing in three research areas: Operations Management, Management Information Systems, and Business Economics. The Department now invites applications for multiple tenure-track faculty positions in the area of Management Information Systems commencing Fall 2027. Applicants for all professoriate ranks will be considered.
Applicants should have (i) a PhD degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related disciplines (by the time reporting for duty); (ii) competence in high-quality research in information systems; and (iii) strong commitment to teaching and services. Senior applicants should have an outstanding track record of research and teaching accomplishments. The appointee(s) will teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses offered by the Department.
Appointments will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to performance and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation.
CUHK Business School provides internationally competitive remuneration, generous research support and funding, and relocation assistance for international faculty relocating to Hong Kong.
About CUHK Business School
CUHK Business School is a world-leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific.
The Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (MBA, MSc, EMBA, DBA, MPhil, PhD) with over 6,500 students, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 49,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
Accountancy
Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
Decisions, Operations and Technology
Finance
Management
Marketing
Application Procedure
Please submit your application package (including a letter of interest and a full resume) via the CUHK career site. Other information (e.g., teaching evaluations and reference letters) may be requested at a later stage.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Zoom interviews and/ or in-person interviews at conferences (e.g., AMCIS'26, CIST’26 or ICIS’26). Applications will be processed on a rolling basis.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time associate degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage. Applications are now invited for the following position:
Assistant Programme Officer (25260745)
The appointee will be responsible for providing operational and administrative assistance to the academic/teaching-related matters at the College of International Education (CIE). Major duties are composed of but not limited to: a) providing general clerical and secretarial support; b) providing on-site and logistic support to student development activities, outreach activities, and the College’s functions; and c) running and coordinating programme activities, including animal laboratory and internship work.
Requirements:
(i) Holder of Associate Degree / Higher Diploma with at least one year of work experience; OR (ii) Possession of HKCEE 5 passes including English Language (at least Grade C if Syllabus A / Level 2 from 2007) and Chinese Language (at least Level 2 from 2007), or at least 5 subjects attaining Level 2 in HKDSE including English Language and Chinese Language, or Yi Jin graduates, with more work experience;
Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (both Cantonese and Putonghua);
Effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently; and
Proficiency in computer applications including MS Office application (both English and Chinese) and Excel.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions then applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Project Assistant (Part-time) (26270079)
Join Our Team as a Project Assistant (24 hours/week - 2 positions)
The Library is seeking detail-oriented Project Assistants to join the Digital Initiatives and Research Cluster (DIR). The successful candidates will play a vital role in supporting the Library’s digitization efforts and contributing to the preservation and accessibility of valuable materials beneficial to the archiving of Hong Kong culture and history as well as relevant research.

Perform data indexing and metadata creation in accordance with established standards and guideline;
Verify and proofread optical character recognition (OCR) outputs to ensure a high level of textual accuracy;

Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisors.

A diploma holder with at least two years of relevant experience or a fresh graduate with a Bachelor’s degree;
Proficiency in Chinese word processing, Chinese typing, and comprehension of traditional Chinese characters;
Ability to work with details, patience with repetitive work, and effective communication skills; and
Must be able to work 24 hours per week (excluding lunch) that fall in normal office hours (8:00 am – 6:00 pm on weekdays).

9862add6a7d56234c41261ee.description:
Language Education Institute
Instructor (English Language) (several posts)
(Ref. 260512006)
The Language Education Institute (LEI), a new academic unit established on 1 July 2025, formulates policies, designs curricula and delivers teaching activities for the education of languages among students at PolyU, focusing mainly on the Chinese and English languages. LEI strives to become a regional and international leader in language education, particularly in the application of the latest technologies in language learning, teaching and assessment. It drives scholarship and best practices in language education among the PolyU community.
LEI comprises the Chinese Language Centre (CLC), English Language Centre (ELC) and Technology-Enhanced Language Education Centre (TELEC), which are constituent units with their own Directors. CLC and ELC offer service language teaching in Chinese and English for all students in the University while TELEC undertakes service language teaching using digital learning platforms and technological tools such as artificial intelligence and immersive technologies.
CLC and ELC are committed to excellence in learning and teaching and aim to strengthen students’ language proficiency and communication skills, foster independent and life‑long learning, and support whole‑person development. They provide English and Chinese language teaching services tailored to the diverse needs of the University’s students, delivering language enhancement and communication subjects, including AI as a Tool for Language Learning, in accordance with University requirements. In addition to curriculum‑based teaching, the Centres coordinate a range of co‑curricular learning activities to support students’ academic development and learning needs. Please visit the websites at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/clc/ and https://www.polyu.edu.hk/elc/ respectively for more information about CLC and ELC.
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) teach a range of courses in English for Academic Purposes (EAP), English for Specific Purposes (ESP) and communication skills for students, with effective and responsible integration of AI/GenAI to enhance learning, teaching, and assessment;
(b) engage in English language enhancement initiatives of the University, including workshops and support activities related to technology- and AI-enhanced language learning;
(c) participate in the pedagogical development and administration of teaching and learning activities, including promoting student language skills through technology-enhanced language teaching methods and responsible AI use; and
(d) perform any other duties as assigned by the Director of Language Education Institute or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should:
(a) have a master’s degree in English Language Education / TESOL / Applied Linguistics / Education or a related discipline;
(b) have a recognised language teaching qualification;
(c) preferably possess at least three years’ post-qualification relevant teaching experience at tertiary level;
(d) have effective classroom teaching skills;
(e) have demonstrated strong commitment to excellence in teaching;
(f) have demonstrated pedagogic AI competencies for English language education; and
(g) be a highly proficient English speaker.
Preference will be given to teachers with experience or expertise in incorporating GenAI in language teaching, expertise in discipline-related English, digital literacies, assessment design, and supporting students to use AI tools for self-regulated language learning.
Applicants should indicate in their cover letter how their qualifications and experience would enable them to effectively perform the duties of the post.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
C onsideration of applications will commence on 1 June 2026 .
Apply Now
Posting date: 12 May 2026

Assistant / Associate Professor ( Digital Technology and Computational Design )
(Ref. 240000KD) Closing Date: Until the post is filled.
The Chinese University of Hong Kong is one of the world’s leading universities. Its location makes it one of the most exciting places to research and teach architecture.
The School of Architecture has a world-class, research-led, and professionally connected learning environment. It embraces new approaches to architectural education and cross-disciplinary research that impact on society and the profession.
The School of Architecture is seeking an outstanding candidate to make significant contributions to research and teaching of Digital Technology and Computational Design, expanding ongoing explorations in design for robotic construction and innovation in the construction industry.
The appointees will advance an individual research agenda focused on academic contributions and experimental applications, building research collaborations within the University and beyond.
Applicants should (i) have a PhD degree in a subject area relevant to architecture, digital design or other related areas OR (ii) a professional Master’s degree in architecture and not less than 4 years (with professional registration) or 6 years (without professional registration) of practical experience in architecture thereafter.
Applicants with international recognition in the field will be highly appreciated. Preference will be given to candidates with an excellent record of studio teaching and research.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to performance, funding availability and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation later. Outstanding candidates may be considered for substantive appointment upon initial appointment.
To apply for the posts, please complete the online application form, and submit a letter of interest, CV, portfolio, together with names/e-mail addresses of three referees with consent for providing references. SCHOOL OF CHINESE MEDICINE
CLINICAL DIVISION
Post-Doctoral Research Fellow (Sleep and Mental Health Research) (25260418)
Project Introduction:
The School of Chinese Medicine at HKBU is dedicated to advance sleep and mental health research. Our research focuses on developing and evaluating the efficacy of various novel interventions for the treatment of sleep and mental disorders, drawing on traditional Chinese medicine (e.g., Chinese herbal medicine & acupuncture), exercise science (e.g., Tai Chi), and psychotherapy (e.g., CBT-I). Our work has led to multiple publications in top-tier journals, including the BMJ , the Lancet Child & Adolescent Health , British Journal of Sports Medicine , and more.
More information about our work: https://scholars.hkbu.edu.hk/en/persons/danny-yu/
Responsibilities:
Coordinate and supervise the conduct of clinical trials;
Manage clinical trial datasets and conduct data analysis;
Draft manuscript as lead author and support grant proposal preparation;
Ensure compliance with ethical and regulatory guidelines for human participant research; and
Perform any other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
A Ph.D. degree in Chinese medicine, psychology, public health, nursing, or a related field;
Experience in clinical research involving human participants is required;
Strong organisational and time-management skills with the ability to multitasking;
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal;
Detail-oriented, ensuring precision and quality in all tasks; and
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.
The initial appointment will be on a one-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of renewal subject to mutual agreement.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications via the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

9de5cdd54029cabd6c370052.description:
Department of Social Work
Associate Professor
(Ref. 250000U3) ( Closing Date: Until the post (s) is / are filled .)
As a world-leading centre of social work education and research, the Department is dedicated to developing and disseminating scientific rigorous and socially impactful social work knowledge for human betterment and social development. We aspire, through our research and evaluation work, to improve the lives of vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, deepen our understanding of social issues and promote evidence-based practice locally and globally. The Department is looking for candidates who embrace these goals and values.
Scholars specializing in any of the following research areas are welcome to apply for the post s :
- clinical social work
- children and family
- gerontology
- macro social work theories and practice
Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree; (ii) a strong publication track record; (iii) proven ability to obtain grants and conduct research to generate academic and social impact; (iv) demonstrated academic leadership; and (v) evidence of outstanding teaching performance. Being registered social workers and having professional expertise or substantial work experience in clinical or macro social work practice will be added assets.
The appointees will ( a ) undertake research; ( b ) teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses; ( c ) supervise research postgraduate students; and ( d ) take up key administrative roles for the Department.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Provide teaching assistance for undergraduate courses in Chinese Medicine (CM) including Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) fundamentals, CM classics and CM clinical courses;

Coordinate internship, teaching activities and assessment exercises for major, general education and elective courses offered by the Division;
Support the management of CM teaching laboratories and funded projects;

Perform other duties as assigned. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

INTERNATIONAL OFFICE
Reshaping tomorrow’s global leaders is one of the International Office’s top priorities on the internationalisation agenda. Partnership has taken on new meanings in today’s fast-changing world. The Office works closely with its partners worldwide and the university community to bring innovative and impactful collaborations for tomorrow’s world. It conducts proactive global outreach for branding and partnerships. Innovativeness has been at the core of its success.
The Office is dedicated to nurturing global inclusive generations. It seeks to create a diverse, inclusive and engaged community by offering a truly global education. It connects the university community with world-renowned academics and experts, industry players, as well as senior government officials, by hosting various intellectually stimulating programmes and initiatives (https://intl.hkbu.edu.hk).
Senior Officer (Role: Assistant Global Engagement Manager) (26270020)
Responsibilities:
Forge and manage strategic partnerships with international universities and organisations to drive student mobility and academic collaboration;
Develop and execute innovative global education initiatives to enhance student learning outcomes and intercultural competencies;
Lead and execute global events and conferences, and
Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders across education and government.
Requirements:
A recognised degree with at least 4 years of work experience;
Good command of written and spoken English is a must;
A confident leader and self-starter with an outgoing personality, positive attitude and ability to build strong, motivated teams;
Able to work effectively with people from different cultures, enthusiastic about working with students, detail-oriented, able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced office; and
Good organisational, coordination, communication and interpersonal skills.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of three years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement.

LU PRESIDENTIAL POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH FELLOWSHIP SCHEME
Postdoctoral Fellow
(Post Ref.: 24/888 )
Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education. It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a better world. Moving forward, Lingnan University is well positioned to take lead as a comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful research and innovations.
Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies. To foster interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students. With traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and critical thinking skills to thrive in the future. Subsequent to the establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric technology and social policies. Further information about Lingnan University is available at https://www.ln.edu.hk/ .
We are launching the LU Presidential Postdoctoral Research Fellowship Scheme (PPRF) and invite applications from early career researchers from all over the world. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to collaborate with our academics in a supportive and dynamic research environment. The University will provide them with the resources, expertise, and mentorship to achieve their research goals.
Eligibility
Applicants should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification, and the PhD degree should have been received no more than three years prior to the start of the Fellowship. They are expected to have a good research track record and demonstrate good potential in publishing high quality papers.
Duration and Requirements of the Fellowship
The duration of the Fellowship will normally be three years. The appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of 1 year, and further appointment for a period of 2 years is subject to the appointee’s satisfactory performance.
The appointees are required to submit
applications for the RGC Junior Research Fellow Scheme (JRFS) or the JC STEM
Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (JC STEM
ECRF), and are encouraged to apply for other local / overseas grants or
fellowship schemes.
Terms and Benefits
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees. The appointees will also be provided with research funding of HK$10,000 per year to support their research activities.
Application Procedure
Applicants are required to contact potential supervisors at Lingnan University and submit a research proposal (as discussed/developed by the applicants in conjunction with the potential supervisors) together with their applications. In the research proposal, please also indicate the name and the department of the potential supervisor.
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references.

LU PRESIDENTIAL POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH FELLOWSHIP SCHEME
Postdoctoral Fellow
(Post Ref.: 24/888 )
Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education. It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a better world. Moving forward, Lingnan University is well positioned to take lead as a comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful research and innovations.
Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies. To foster interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students. With traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and critical thinking skills to thrive in the future. Subsequent to the establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric technology and social policies. Further information about Lingnan University is available at https://www.ln.edu.hk/ .
We are launching the LU Presidential Postdoctoral Research Fellowship Scheme (PPRF) and invite applications from early career researchers from all over the world. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to collaborate with our academics in a supportive and dynamic research environment. The University will provide them with the resources, expertise, and mentorship to achieve their research goals.
Eligibility
Applicants should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification, and the PhD degree should have been received no more than three years prior to the start of the Fellowship. They are expected to have a good research track record and demonstrate good potential in publishing high quality papers.
Duration and Requirements of the Fellowship
The duration of the Fellowship will normally be three years. The appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of 1 year, and further appointment for a period of 2 years is subject to the appointee’s satisfactory performance.
The appointees are required to submit
applications for the RGC Junior Research Fellow Scheme (JRFS) or the JC STEM
Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (JC STEM
ECRF), and are encouraged to apply for other local / overseas grants or
fellowship schemes.
Terms and Benefits
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees. The appointees will also be provided with research funding of HK$10,000 per year to support their research activities.
Application Procedure
Applicants are required to contact potential supervisors at Lingnan University and submit a research proposal (as discussed/developed by the applicants in conjunction with the potential supervisors) together with their applications. In the research proposal, please also indicate the name and the department of the potential supervisor.
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references.
Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the posts are filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.

a161f7e2e38e267d50641cd3.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Statistics and Data Science
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
The Department of Statistics and Data Science at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) was founded in 1982. We have strived to provide students state-of-the-art statistical education as well as to conduct cutting-edge statistical research. The Department has accommodated world-class faculty members with diverse research areas including statistical finance and risk management science, statistical theory and methodology, machine learning & big data analytics, biostatistics and bioinformatics, and other areas of cross-disciplinary research. Various research fundings and equipment would be offered by the Department for enhancing teaching and research.
The Department and CUHK are committed to inclusive excellence and actively promote the success of a diverse population of students, staff, and faculty. We strive to recruit and retain a diverse community of scholars, and welcome applicants whose experience in teaching, research, or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to diversity.
Applications are invited for two tenured or tenure -track faculty position s at the level of Associate Professor / Assistant Professor for all areas of Statistics and Data Science . (Department’s strategic areas: http://www.sta.cuhk.edu.hk/research/#dos-tab1 ). The appointment rank will be determined by the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate .
Applicants should have (i) a Ph.D. degree in statistics or a related field; and (ii) high-quality research output and a strong teaching track record. Applicants with international exposure / background are highly preferred.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing in Fall 2026 or beyond, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointments or substantiation later. Further information about the competitive compensation and benefits, together with numerous supports on research and teaching could be found: https://www.hro.cuhk.edu.hk/en-gb/career/working-cuhk .
Application review will be commenced once application is received and will continue until the posts are filled.
The Global STEM Professorship Scheme is opened for application on a regular basis. We welcome distinguished scholars for applications and nominations (at the academic level of Professor or above). Please contact the Department (statdept@cuhk.edu.hk) directly for details.
Further information on the Department of Statistics and Data Science can be found at http://www.sta.cuhk.edu.hk .
Application Procedure
Applicants please complete the online application form and upload a cover letter, a full curriculum vitae, a statement of research and teaching interests, and copies of up to five recent publications. Applicants should also provide names, addresses and e-mail addresses of three referees to whom the applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the posts above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Office of the Faculty of Business
(Post Ref.: 25/296 )
The Faculty of Business ( https://www.ln.edu.hk/fb/ ) at Lingnan University has been accredited by the Association to Advanced Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International). The Faculty plays an important role in educating students about cutting-edge, practical knowledge and skills, improving students' academic and professional capabilities, as well as enhancing students' awareness on social responsibilities. Furthermore, we have been devoting every effort to the sustainable development of Lingnan University in the academic community and the substantive realization of our values and mission in the Hong Kong society and the world.
The appointee is expected to (a) conduct independent and collaborative research; (b) teach multiple subjects in both undergraduate-level and postgraduate-level programmes of the Faculty. The appointee will work for the Office of the Faculty of Business and Hong Kong Institute of Business Studies, and may be required to undertake certain administrative duties as required by supervisor(s).
General Requirements
Applicants should hold a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification in management science, operation research or other relevant fields for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment. Applicants should have a strong track record in research evidenced by quality research output in line with international standards. He/she should have strong commitment to research and have an excellent command of English and Chinese (including Mandarin). The appointees are expected to submit applications for RGC grants, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The rank and remuneration will be commensurate with experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will be normally made on an initial contract for up to two years.

Research Assistant Professor
Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre
(Post Ref.: 25/265)
About the Centre
Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre (HKCRC) was established in January 2022 as a research centre within the Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University, one of Asia's best in analytic philosophy. The department has a thriving research environment and already hosts several Postdoctoral Fellows/Research Assistant Professors. Faculty members publish in leading journals, such as Analysis, Australasian Journal of Philosophy, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, Ethics, Journal of Philosophical Logic, Mind, Noûs, Philosophers’ Imprint, Philosophical Quarterly, Philosophical Studies, Philosophy and Phenomenological Research, and Philosophy of Science.
More information on the research centre can be found at: https://www.ln.edu.hk/philoso/hkcrc
More information on the interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.LN.edu.hk/philoso/?page_id=9 .
Requirements
The Centre seeks to appoint a Research Assistant Professor with expertise in philosophy of AI (broadly understood) and/or ethics of risk. Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment, and a record of publications in Philosophy, preferably in leading journals. A technical background in AI—such as knowledge of machine learning or neural networks—will be an advantage.
The appointee is expected to conduct focused research, publish scholarly outputs in reputable, peer-reviewed international philosophical journals, and apply for competitive peer-reviewed grants offered by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, as well as other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes. Teaching experience at undergraduate and/or taught master’s programme levels is a definite advantage.
Research: The Research Assistant Professor will (i) conduct research and submit papers to top philosophy journals (e.g., including 3*/4*-ranked journals per the current departmental journal list), (ii) submit grant proposals to various funding bodies, and (iii) organise seminars, reading groups, workshops, or other related research activities.
Teaching: The appointee will play a central part in the daily operation of the Master of Arts in Artificial Intelligence and the Future (MAAIF), the Taught Postgraduate Programme offered by HKCRC and the Department of Philosophy, which has welcomed its second cohort of students in the 2025-26 academic year. The teaching load will be three courses per year, distributed according to the Centre's needs and upon mutual agreement. English will be the language of instruction. The appointee would also be required to supervise students’ capstone projects.
Service: The appointee will perform administrative duties as assigned by the Director of HKCRC in accordance with the Head of the Department.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. The appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of up to three years.
The initial application must include:
1. An updated CV
2. A letter of interest
3. One writing sample (no more than one writing sample will be read)
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the post is filled, starting from January 5, 2026. The candidate will be expected to start their position in August 2026. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
Informal inquiries concerning the post can be directed to the Director of HKCRC, Professor Andrea Sauchelli at andreasauchelli@ln.edu.hk .
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

a390382e2efefb94b5beb3c1.description:
Department/ Unit: School of Hotel and Tourism Management
Closing date: January 15, 2027
The School of Hotel and Tourism Management at the Business School of the Chinese University of Hong Kong is inviting applications for a tenure-track faculty position in hospitality and tourism, starting in August 2027.
Applicants should be promising scholars with a PhD (by the time of reporting for duty) in hospitality and tourism or a related field. The appointees will conduct high quality research which results in publications in top-tier hospitality and tourism journals. In addition, they are expected to undertake duties to teach basic and advanced-level hospitality and tourism courses at both undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, and to render services to the School of Hotel and Tourism Management. We welcome applications from scholars specializing in AI and machine learning, behavioral science, healthcare and aging, sports and entertainment, and related areas. Industry experience in related fields and/or grant experience is preferred.
Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing August 2027, which, subject to demonstration of the requisite level of performance and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation later.
About the School of Hotel and Tourism Management
Established in 1998, the School of Hotel and Tourism Management is one of six departments within the CUHK Business School. Leveraging the Business School's esteemed business education, the school is dedicated to developing future leaders in the experience economy, with a focus on hospitality, tourism, and real estate. The school provides an AACSB-accredited BBA program in Hospitality and Real Estate (HRE), the first integrated undergraduate program of its kind in Asia. At the postgraduate level, it offers two MSc programmes. The MSc in Real Estate (MRE) is the only master's degree in Asia that integrates multidisciplinary research and teaching from real estate, business, and hospitality and the MSc in Leadership for Experience Economy (LEE) is the first MSc programme in the Asia-Pacific region focusing on developing competencies in inspirational leadership, investment, and innovation to drive organizational success in the emerging experience economy. In addition, the school offers the MPhil-PhD in Business Administration, specializing in Hospitality and Real Estate, preparing students for academic and research careers.
Further information about the School of Hotel and Tourism Management is available at https://www.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/departments/hotel-and-tourism-management/
About CUHK Business School
The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific. The School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with over 6,500 students from 30+ countries/regions, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 49,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
· Accountancy
· Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
· Decisions, Operations and Technology
· Finance
· Management
· Marketing
Application Procedure
Applicants please upload the full resume with a cover letter, copies of academic credentials, publication list with abstracts of selected published papers, details of courses taught and evaluation results (if available), a research plan, a teaching statement, together with names, addresses and e-mail addresses of three referees for providing references via the CUHK e- recruitment system at http://career.cuhk.edu.hk/.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk.
Deadline for Application
The School will continue to review applications on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews in batches starting in fall 2026. Applications will be closed on 15 January 2027.

a3bea58f218c14ce4a1cf225.description:
Department of History
Assistant Professor (Public History)
(Ref. 260001AK) (Closing Date: October 1, 2026)
The Department of History at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) invites applications for a full-time, substantiation-track ( equivalent to U.S. tenure-track) position at the rank of Assistant Professor in the field of Public History, begin ning August 2, 2027.
CUHK’s History Department is proud to have been the first department in the region to offer an MA in Comparative and Public History, and we have recently added a unique undergraduate stream in Public History. We seek a dynamic scholar-practitioner whose work engages with both public and scholarly audiences in innovative ways. The successful candidate will be expected to teach an introductory methodology course in Public History. In addition, their research and practice should evince a dedication to meaningful engagement with the community, governmental and non-governmental organizations, etc. (either in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China or elsewhere). A track record (appropriate to career stage) of scholarly publication is expected.
We welcome applicants with specialisations in any area of Public History, including (but not limited to):
· Museum and heritage studies
· Oral history
· Community-engaged history
· Digital public history
· Archival and curatorial practice
· Historical memory and commemoration
Experience in Digital Humanities (DH) and innovative public-facing methodologies is highly desirable. The position is open to all qualified candidates, both local and international. The normal teaching load is two courses per term, reduced to one in the first term of appointment. Teaching will be conducted in English, although knowledge of Chinese will be considered an advantage.
Qualifications:
Applicants should:
i . h old a PhD in History or a closely related field by August 1, 202 7;
ii . h ave an active research agenda with clear plans for future publications ;
iii . d emonstrate a commitment to teaching and mentoring students ; and
iv . s how evidence of public history practice and engagement (including evidence of social impact, where appropriate) .
Salary and fringe benefits for the post will be highly competitive. Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially , which, subject to funding, performance and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation (equivalent to U.S. tenure), either after six years of service or earlier upon special application and recommendation.
Application Process
Applicants should complete the online application form, upload a letter of introduction, a CV, evidence of public history practice and/or engagement with the community and one writing sample. Review of applications will begin on October 1, 2026 and continue until the position is filled. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to provide further materials, including letters of recommendation (to be addressed to the Department Secretary directly by the referees), evidence of teaching and public engagement experience.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Department of Applied Mathematics
Assistant Professor in Optimization and Operations Research / Statistics and Data Science/ Financial Mathematics / Engineering and Computational Mathematics / Mathematical Science / Actuarial Science
(Ref. 260713005)
The Department of Applied Mathematics (AMA) is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Computer and Mathematical Sciences. Apart from making a significant contribution to most of other academic programmes of the University by providing service teaching, the Department also offers master programmes in Applied Mathematics for Science and Technology, Operational Research and Risk Analysis and Quantitative Finance and FinTech. Starting from 2025/26 academic year, the Department offers a new Bachelor Scheme in Applied Mathematics and Finance Analytics and Fast-track Integrated Bachelor’s and Master’s Degree Programmes and will launch a new master programme, MSc in Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence Technology in 2026/27. Members of the Department have expertise in applied optimization and optimal control, engineering computation, operational research, management science and applied statistics, FinTech, data science and machine learning. There are currently 56 academic staff and about 154 research personnel in the Department. Please visit the website at http://www.polyu.edu.hk/ama for more information about the Department.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) teach and contribute to curriculum development at undergraduate and postgraduate levels;
(b) supervise MPhil and PhD students;
(c) engage in scholarly research, consultancy and other scholarly activities leading to publications in top-tier refereed journals and award of research grants;
(d) undertake academic and departmental administrative duties; and
(e) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of the Department or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should:
(a) have a PhD degree in Mathematics / Statistics / Financial Mathematics / Operations Research / Computational Mathematics / Applied Mathematics or a closely related field with experience in Data Science and Analytics;
(b) have expertise in applied statistics, operation research or mathematics;
(c) have an established track record in research and scholarship, including refereed publications and external grant applications;
(d) have a demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching; and
(e) be highly proficient in written and spoken English.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 10 August 2026 until the position is filled.

a7dee8de13d25c66c5143518.description:
Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies
Professor in Supply Chain and Operations Management
(Ref. 260825005)
The Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Business. The Department offers a full range of degree programmes in supply chain and operations management, maritime studies and others. The Department takes a multi-disciplinary approach to establishing an area of excellence in logistics, supply chain, and operations management. It strives to be a key player in Hong Kong’s pursuit to become an international logistics hub.
The Department’s research portfolio lies in both academic and applied research. Professional services to industries are also provided by the academic staff in the form of consultancy in such areas as efficiency and quality improvement studies, market and operational analyses, optimisation, production, purchasing, and supply chain management. The Department also runs various self-financed programmes tailor-made to meet specific industry needs.
Please visit the website at http://www.lms.polyu.edu.hk for more information about the Department.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) undertake teaching duties at various levels in the area of Supply Chain and Operations Management;
(b) supervise undergraduate and postgraduate research projects and theses;
(c) conduct research in related areas and contribute to the development of the Department’s research strengths;
(d) initiate, lead and participate in scholarly research in their areas of expertise and be active in research leading to quality journal publications and in bidding for external research grants and applied research projects;
(e) engage in programme/curriculum planning, development and administration;
(f) undertake relevant administrative duties; and
(g) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Department or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in a related discipline;
(b) substantial years of relevant post-qualification and solid experience in teaching and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(c) an excellent record of relevant academic and/or research achievements; and
(d) qualities of creativity, initiative and leadership.
Preference will be given to those with prior business/managerial experience in related industries.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Professor level. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 1 September 2026 until the position is filled .

Part-time Teachers in Information Technology Programmes in the College of Life Sciences and Technology
[RF: 2025/26-PT-143-SW]
Duties: The appointees will teach one or more of the following courses for the relevant advanced diploma or bachelor’s degree programme:
AI-Era Cybersecurity and Digital Trust
AI Governance, Risk, and Ethics
AI Product Strategy and Technology Leadership
Computer Networking
Computer Systems Architecture and Operating Systems
Data Communication
Deep Learning and its Application
Digital Transformation
Enterprise and Private AI Systems
Ethical Hacking
Generative AI and Large Language Models
Intelligent Automation and Process Intelligence
Network and Protocol Analysis
Network Management and Disaster Recovery
Security Architectures and Cryptography
Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics

You may apply online or download an application form at http://hkuspace.hku.hk/jobs .
Closing Date for Applications: On-going
The information provided in an application will only be used for the purpose of consideration for appointment by HKU SPACE. Applicants not contacted within 8 weeks from the closing date may assume that their applications are unsuccessful. Unsuccessful applications will be kept for a maximum period of 12 months. The School reserves the right to offer different terms of appointment.

a8cd900cfbd42d4d1e053dd6.description:
Department of Chinese History and Culture
Teaching Fellow
(Ref. 260810008)
[will be conferred the title of Lecturer]
The Department of Chinese History and Culture is an academic department within the Faculty of Humanities. Its mission is to offer high-quality undergraduate and postgraduate programmes that provide interdisciplinary training in the study of Chinese history and culture. Currently, the Department offers PhD and MPhil programmes, a taught-master degree programme, a major degree programme in Chinese History and Culture, a minor degree programme in Chinese History and Culture, and university-wide general education courses. The media of instruction are English and Putonghua. Please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/chc/ for more information about the Department.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) engage in teaching Chinese history and culture and undertake related pedagogical activities at undergraduate and postgraduate levels;
(b) engage in programme/curriculum design and development, consultancy projects and other scholarly activities that help promote the department’s interests;
(c) provide administrative support for academic and departmental affairs; and
(d) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Department or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in a relevant discipline;
(b) at least three years of relevant post-qualification tertiary teaching experience;
(c) strong commitment to excellence in teaching and learning; and
(d) an excellent command of both English and Chinese.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
Consideration of applications will commence on 24 August 2026 until the position is filled.
Apply Now
Posting date: 10 August 2026

Assistant Manager I
Office of
Global Education
(Post Ref.: 26/203)
Responsibilities
• Assist in data collection and reporting of the Office
• Provide administrative support to budgeting, reporting, data collection and personal data privacy matters of the Office
• Provide administrative and secretarial support to committees and alliances which the University takes part in
• Manage and administer student exchange programmes and liaise with internal and external stakeholders
• Assist in the overall planning and execution of the University's non-local student recruitment strategies
• Organize a wide spectrum of promotional activities to prospective non-local students, foster sustainable relationships with overseas feeder schools
• Work closely with the University's UG Admissions team
• Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor(s)
Requirements
• A Bachelor's degree with at least 10 years' relevant work experience
• Proficient in written and verbal English and other European language(s) would be an advantage
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Experience in working in higher education and dealing with counterparts from diverse backgrounds would be an advantage
• Strong analytical skills with knowledge in data analytic/statistical software
• Sound knowledge of student exchange and campus inclusion is preferred
Candidates with less/more experience will also be considered for appointment at the relevant rank.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, and gratuity.

Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only .
We are an equal opportunities employer . Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified .

a9d4eea64305f7fe1185e595.department: The Chinese University of Hong Kong Interdisciplinary Artificial Intelligence Research Institute
a9d4eea64305f7fe1185e595.description:
Department/ Unit: CUHK Interdisciplinary Artificial Intelligence Research Institute
Closing Date: Until the post(s) is / are filled
CUHK Interdisciplinary Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (IAIRI) is set up jointly by The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory in 2021, with the aim to encourage and promote interdisciplinary research utilizing AI technology. The Institute is supported by Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Science and Faculty of Medicine. We are now seeking dedicated and creative scholars to help build up our newly established Institute through active research and strong commitment to teaching and mentoring of students.
The Institute invites applications from outstanding academics in emerging fields with potential for scientific and scholarly breakthroughs above and beyond our existing recruitment to join CUHK at the level of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Professor. Multiple positions in the general area of artificial intelligence and its applications, including machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and AI applications in various domains are available. Outstanding candidates from diverse disciplines in computing, distributed systems, statistics, optimization, applied mathematics, medicine and other related areas are also welcome. Successful candidates will be jointly appointed by the Institute and the Faculties to best align with the candidate's work.
This is a broad search open to all areas of data science including but not limited to databases and systems, fundamental machine learning, interface between optimization and machine learning, natural language processing, visions and robotics, Bayesian learning, causal inference, and decision making under uncertainty. Research collaborations across borders are highly encouraged and abundant research resources will be matched to facilitate the related research.
Appointment(s) will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to performance and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation later.
Applicants are encouraged to apply by June 30, 2025 to ensure earlier consideration, but the search will continue until positions are filled. To apply online, please complete the on-line application form together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae, research statement, teaching statement, 2 or 3 most significant research publications, and contact information for at least three referees.

a9da68aae3f16caa796701ed.description:
SCHOOL OF CHINESE MEDICINE
TEACHING AND RESEARCH DIVISION
Assistant Professor / Associate Professor (25260733)
The School of Chinese Medicine (SCM) was established in 1999 and offers comprehensive education programmes in Chinese medicine, including both undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes in Chinese Medicine and Pharmacy in Chinese Medicine. The School is engaged in a wide range of research projects, provides Chinese medicine healthcare services to the community, and seeks to foster modernisation of the Chinese medicine profession. To consolidate the strengths of innovative research, the School has established high quality theme-based Research Centres equipped with advanced equipment and facilities. The highlighted strategic research areas in the School include (1) Precision medicine and phenomics study; (2) Translational medicine and innovative drug discovery; and (3) Authentication and testing of Chinese medicines.
To strengthen research capacity and advance existing research disciplines in SCM through computer science and AI, we would like to recruit a full-time faculty member at the rank of Assistant Professor / Associate Professor in AI, Bioinformatics and/or Computational drug discovery in partnership with the Department of Computer Science on collaborative research to drive breakthroughs in AI and modern Chinese medicine including new drug discovery.
The successful candidate will be considered for a joint appointment between SCM (home unit) and the Department of Computer Science (CS) at the level of joint appointment, ranging from 0% affiliated appointment to 49% in CS, subject to the candidate’s academic qualifications and experiences.
We are looking for candidates in a related area(s) as follows:
Bioinformatics
Biostatistics
Computational drug discovery
Translational research
Responsibilities:
Teach both undergraduate and postgraduate levels in SCM and the Department of Computer Science;
Establish a vigorous research program in the relevant areas; and
Develop research clusters through collaborations.
Requirements:
Hold a PhD in a related field(s) (e.g. Computer Science / AI);
Have relevant postdoctoral training and demonstrate a strong track record in a related field(s); and
Candidate with a strong record of securing external grants, outstanding publications, and demonstrated potential for research leadership in clinical or translational research will be a great advantage.
This is a tenure-track position with an initial appointment on a fixed-term contract of up to three years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement. Tenured appointment is expected to be attained within six years.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. SCHOOL OF CHINESE MEDICINE
TEACHING AND RESEARCH DIVISION
Assistant Professor / Associate Professor (25260733)
The School of Chinese Medicine (SCM) was established in 1999 and offers comprehensive education programmes in Chinese medicine, including both undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes in Chinese Medicine and Pharmacy in Chinese Medicine. The School is engaged in a wide range of research projects, provides Chinese medicine healthcare services to the community, and seeks to foster modernisation of the Chinese medicine profession. To consolidate the strengths of innovative research, the School has established high quality theme-based Research Centres equipped with advanced equipment and facilities. To strengthen research capacity and advance existing research disciplines in SCM through computer science and AI, we would like to recruit a full-time faculty member at the rank of Assistant Professor / Associate Professor in AI, Bioinformatics and/or Computational drug discovery in partnership with the Department of Computer Science on collaborative research to drive breakthroughs in AI and modern Chinese medicine including new drug discovery.
The successful candidate will be considered for a joint appointment between SCM (home unit) and the Department of Computer Science (CS) at the level of joint appointment, ranging from 0% affiliated appointment to 49% in CS, subject to the candidate’s academic qualifications and experiences.

Bioinformatics
Biostatistics
Computational drug discovery
Translational research

Teach both undergraduate and postgraduate levels in SCM and the Department of Computer Science;
Establish a vigorous research program in the relevant areas; and
Develop research clusters through collaborations.

Hold a PhD in a related field(s) (e.g. Computer Science / AI);
Have relevant postdoctoral training and demonstrate a strong track record in a related field(s); and
Candidate with a strong record of securing external grants, outstanding publications, and demonstrated potential for research leadership in clinical or translational research will be a great advantage.

Department/ Unit: Department of Management
Closing Date: Until the position(s) is/ are filled
The Department of Management at the CUHK Business School is now inviting applications for the position(s) of Full-time/Fractional-time Professional Consultant. We welcome applications from the qualified scholars in the management fields, including but not limited to family business management, leadership, innovation management, entrepreneurship, organizational behaviour, s trategic management , etc.
Applicants should have (i) a higher degree, preferably a DBA or PhD in any business or other related disciplines from a recognized university; (ii) substantial and extensive professional experience in managing organizations, preferably at senior level; (iii) a strong and proven track record in teaching executive and master’s degree program me s (e.g. MBA , EMBA); and (iv) impressive academic/ professional records.
The appointee is expected to deliver high-quality teaching primarily for executive and master’s degree programmes and probably for some undergraduate courses as well ; assume administrative roles and responsibilities in the prgoramme/course levels, as assigned ; coordinate learning activities such as internships and study tours; and contribute to enhancing the programme quality and reputation.
The initial appointment will be made on a full-time/ fractional-time contract basis for two years commencing in 2026 , renewable subject to performance and mutual agreement.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
Salary will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The University offers a comprehensive fringe benefit package including medical care for eligible appointees.
About the Department of Management
The Department of Management offers three specialised concentrations in Entrepreneurship (ENT), Human Resource Management (HRM), and Management of International Business (MIB) in the Integrated BBA Programme, and two Master’s Programmes in Management and Sustainable Global Business. Our competitive curriculum equips students with cutting-edge knowledge in management, a global outlook, an innovative spirit, and a strong sense of social responsibility and integrity, enabling future business leaders to lead transformative initiatives worldwide. For more information about the Department, please visit our website at https://www.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/departments/management/ .
About CUHK Business School
The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong , China . Since its establishment in Hong Kong , China in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in the Asia Pacific.
The Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (DBA, MBA, MSc, MAcc, EMBA, PhD) with over 5,0 00 students from 3 0+ countries/regions, as well as executive education programmes. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 4 9 ,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
- Accountancy
- Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
- Finance
- Decisions, Operations and Technology
- Management
- Marketing
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above. Please also include your full resume, evidence of teaching ability, names and email addresses of at least three referees for providing confidential reference for your application. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .
Review of applications will be conducted on a rolling basis and will continue until the position(s) is/ are filled.

CENTRE FOR QUANTITATIVE SYSTEMS BIOLOGY
Research Assistant (25260802)
The Centre is recruiting Research Assistants to pursue highly collaborative and interdisciplinary projects of developing new cancer immunotherapy, using novel 3D tumor organoid models, microfluidic “tumor-on-a-chip” platforms, and 3D single-cell imaging.
Responsibilities:
The appointees will conduct cutting-edge research in immuno-oncology studies and drug discovery, collaborate with experts in the field, and develop new biomedical platforms for translational cancer research. For more information about the research projects and the principal investigator, Prof. Jue Shi, please refer to the following webpage: https://physics.hkbu.edu.hk/people/prof-shi-jue-jade
Requirements:
A master’s degree in any science or engineering subject, preferably Biomedical Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Immunology, Cancer Biology, Computational Biology, and Biophysics;
Applicants with previous experiences in cell culture and cancer or immunology research are preferred;
Ability to work independently; and
Good communication skills.
A highly competitive remuneration commensurate with qualifications and experience will be provided.
The initial appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract between 6 to 12 months. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement, or the incumbent(s) may choose to pursue PhD with full fellowship support upon mutual agreement.
Enquiries about the position can be directed to Prof. Jue Shi via jshi@hkbu.edu.hk.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. SCHOOL OF CREATIVE ARTS
Part-time Lecturer (26270038)
The Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration (Global Entertainment) program is a transdisciplinary initiative designed to nurture future leaders in the global entertainment and creative industries. The program is looking for Part-time Lecturer(s) to teach undergraduate course(s) in the following areas:
Fundamentals of the global entertainment business and operational models
Talent, brand, and artiste management in the creative sector
Creative entrepreneurship, design thinking, and business innovation
Planning, marketing, and management of signature/large-scale art events
Any other related disciplines within the creative industries
The ideal candidate should hold a master’s degree or above in related disciplines, with at least 3 years of professional experience in the global entertainment and creative industries. Candidates should possess strong industry knowledge in areas such as content development, licensing, artiste management, event planning, or creative entrepreneurship. ade9e825cf237e339940f2c3.deadline_raw: Closing Date: Until the post is filled The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP). RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
ade9e825cf237e339940f2c3.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Electronic Engineering
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Department of Electronic Engineering (EE) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking outstanding candidates for Research Assistant Professorship (RAP).
RESEARCH AREA OF INTEREST
Intelligent (Medical) Robotics, Image-Guided Procedures, VLA, WAM, Perception & Applications: Particularly, the main areas of interest include embodied AI-assisted procedures, Medical Image Processing, biorobotics & intelligent systems, multisensory perception, AI learning and control in image-guided procedures, medical mechatronics, continuum, and soft flexible robots and sensors, deployable motion generation, compliance modulation/sensing, cooperative and context-aware flexible/soft sensors/actuators in human environments.
The appointee will have opportunities to work with an interdisciplinary team consisting of clinicians and researchers from robotics, AI & perception, imaging, and medicine.
Applicants should have:
(i) a Ph.D. degree in robotics, AI, Computer Science/Engineering, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering, medical physics, automation, or mechatronics background;
(ii) preferably proven expertise in AI/robots/sensors, instrumentation, intelligent systems, magnetic actuation, ROS and general-purpose robotic control;
(iii) fluency in written and spoken English; good organizational skills; the ability to work independently; a strong sense of responsibility; and self-motivation;
(iv) outstanding academic records/publications or recognitions from worldwide top-ranking institutes;
(v) postdoctoral experience or equivalent qualifications, which are typically expected;
(vi) in-depth research and clear teaching statements; and
(vii) successful records in securing research grants and teaching excellence, which are preferred though not compulsory.
The appointee will work closely with Professor Hongliang Ren in the Department to enhance the existing strengths. The appointee is expected to:
(a) be able to have top-tier research outputs and apply for RGC GRF grants and similar external competitive grants;
(b) undertake some teaching duties at undergraduate and postgraduate levels; and
(c) provide service at departmental, faculty and/or university levels.
HOW TO APPLY
To apply, please upload a full resume, copies of academic credentials, a publication list with soft copies of the five most representative publications, details of courses taught and evaluation results (if available), a research plan, a teaching statement, and the names and contact information of three to five referees.
Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years, renewable subject to performance, funding availability and mutual agreement. Review of applications will begin as soon as possible and only shortlisted applicants will be notified. Applications will be accepted until the post is filled.
Further information about the Department is available at http://www.ee.cuhk.edu.hk/ .
