COLLEGE OF INTERNATIONAL EDUCATION
Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time Associate Degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage. English is used as the medium of instruction at the College. Applications are now invited for the following position:
Lecturer II / Assistant Lecturer in Communication (25260319)
The College invites applications for the position of Lecturer II / Assistant Lecturer in Communication. This position involves integrating update knowledge and practices of AI in media communication into the curriculum. Candidates should possess relevant knowledge and/or experience in the following fields:
AI and Digital Communication
Communication Research Method
Communication Theory
Data Analysis and Visualisation
Health Communication
Media and Consumerism
Media and Globalisation
Media and Public Opinion
The appointee is required to perform teaching duties in related disciplines; provide academic guidance to students; organise and coordinate experiential learning activities for students; and assist in the ongoing review and design of courses and programmes.
Applicants should have a post-graduate degree, preferably a doctorate in related disciplines and relevant teaching experience. A strong research track record, proficiency in AI tools in media and communication, or a strong link with industries and professional bodies are highly advantageous. Applicants must show dedication and strong commitment in teaching and education within and beyond the classroom. They must also be a good team player with excellent communication skills. Candidates with less experience will be considered for the post of Assistant Lecturer.
Reference salary range:
Lecturer II : HK$38,000 - HK$53,000
Assistant Lecturer : HK$30,000 - HK$39,000
The appointee will work at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System and send in their most recent teaching evaluation results. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after the submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. All application materials including publication samples, scholarly/creative works will be disposed of after completion of the recruitment exercise. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

aeeb6e102da65d7a6866fd79.description:
Language Education Institute
Senior Teaching Fellow (Chinese Language) (several posts)
(Ref. 260512001)
[will be conferred the title of Senior Lecturer]
The Language Education Institute (LEI), a new academic unit established on 1 July 2025, formulates policies, designs curricula and delivers teaching activities for the education of languages among students at PolyU, focusing mainly on the Chinese and English languages. LEI strives to become a regional and international leader in language education, particularly in the application of the latest technologies in language learning, teaching and assessment. It drives scholarship and best practices in language education among the PolyU community.
LEI comprises the Chinese Language Centre (CLC), English Language Centre (ELC) and Technology-Enhanced Language Education Centre (TELEC), which are constituent units with their own Directors. CLC and ELC offer service language teaching in Chinese and English for all students in the University while TELEC undertakes service language teaching using digital learning platforms and technological tools such as artificial intelligence and immersive technologies.
CLC and ELC are committed to excellence in learning and teaching and aim to strengthen students’ language proficiency and communication skills, foster independent and life‑long learning, and support whole‑person development. They provide Chinese and English language teaching services tailored to the diverse needs of the University’s students, delivering language enhancement and communication subjects, including AI as a Tool for Language Learning, in accordance with University requirements. In addition to curriculum‑based teaching, the Centres coordinate a range of co‑curricular learning activities to support students’ academic development and learning needs. Please visit the websites at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/clc/ and https://www.polyu.edu.hk/elc/ respectively for more information about CLC and ELC.
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) teach a range of courses in Chinese for Academic Purposes (CAP), Chinese for Specific Purposes (CSP) and communication skills for students, with effective and responsible integration of AI/GenAI to enhance learning, teaching, and assessment;
(b) provide effective and visionary leadership in a position of responsibility as coordinator of at least one major aspect of the Chinese Language Centre’s operation, including (where appropriate) leadership in AI-integrated curriculum, assessment and responsible-use practices;
(c) make a considerable contribution to the various aspects of the Centre’s work and digital initiatives through committee membership;
(d) play a leading administrative and pedagogic role in the Centre’s operation, including mentoring colleagues in AI-enhanced language teaching and the development of student AI literacy; and
(e) perform any other duties as assigned by the Director of Language Education Institute or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a master’s degree in Applied Linguistics / Chinese Language/Literature / Language Education or a related discipline, and preferably a PhD in a relevant field;
(b) at least nine years’ post-Master’s or at least six years’ post-doctoral relevant teaching experience at tertiary level, with a strong track record of teaching Chinese in higher education;
(c) considerable experience of, and demonstrated competence in, the coordination and management of teaching and learning activities at tertiary level, including curriculum leadership and quality assurance;
(d) demonstrated strong commitment to excellence in teaching;
(e) demonstrated pedagogic AI competencies for Chinese language education; and
(f) the ability to use English as a working language.
Applicants should demonstrate active scholarly engagement in the field of language education, through activities such as leading teaching-related projects, delivering presentations and publishing research at relevant conferences, developing language teaching materials, and/or undertaking instructional design work. Applications are particularly welcome from teachers with expertise in Chinese for Academic Purpose/academic literacy, multimodal communication, instructional and curriculum design, AI/GenAI-enhanced language pedagogy, or other areas of Applied Linguistics if of direct relevance to Language Education.
Applicants should indicate in their cover letter how their qualifications and experience would enable them to effectively perform the duties of the post.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
C onsideration of applications will commence on 1 June 2026.
Apply Now
Posting date: 12 May 2026

Department/ Unit: Department of Microbiology
Closing Date: Until the position(s) is/ are filled
The Department of Microbiology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong is seeking full-time academic staff at the rank of Professor. The Department has a wide range of research facilities, with access to a large comprehensive teaching hospital. The establishment provides a good environment for basic as well as clinical research and facilitates collaboration with other disciplines. Further information about the department is available at http://www.cuhk.edu.hk/med/mic/ .
Applicants should have (i) a PhD degree or equivalent; (ii) a strong research track record in the field of microbiology; and (iii) commitment to undergraduate teaching and postgraduate student supervision. Applicants should also have a strong record of external funding support, international recognition and leadership. Experience in microbial biology, translational microbiome research, bioinformatics and systems microbiology is an advantage.
The appointee(s) will (a) undertake teaching and related educational activities for undergraduate and postgraduate students; (b) supervise MPhil and PhD students; (c) apply for competitive research grants and related funding; and (d) conduct high-standard research projects independently and in collaboration with other parties.
Appointment(s) will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing as soon as possible, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Department/Unit: Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
Closing Date: December 31, 2026
The Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), is an academic department based at the Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH), a 1,637-bed tertiary referral teaching hospital. The hospital provides a wide range of acute specialist services, including stroke, obstetric, cardiac and trauma centres. The clinical service provides anaesthesia for 14,000 operations in the main operating theatres, with one third being emergency cases, with an additional 2000 anaesthetics are administered in other areas. The 26-bed adult intensive care unit provides medical and surgical critical care for approximately 1800 patients per year. The department is committed to achieving excellence in education and research and maintains active educational and research collaborations with numerous international and mainland institutions.
Applicants should have:
(i) a specialist medical qualification in Anaesthesia and/or Intensive Care (approved for specialist registration with The Medical Council of Hong Kong);
(ii) at least 3 years of relevant experience in anaesthesia and/or intensive care; and
(iii) a good command of spoken and written English. Proficiency in Cantonese and Putonghua will be an advantage, but not essential.
Duties include:
(a) providing high quality clinical services in anaesthesia and/or intensive care;
(b) student supervision and teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses;
(c) clinical research, and
(d) other duties as assigned by the Department Chairperson. Applicants with a plan to pursue a higher degree in anaesthesia/intensive care and/or education will be encouraged and supported.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, commencing as soon as possible. Subject to performance and mutual agreement, this may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Department of Architecture
Global Search for Chair Professor / Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Architecture
(Ref. 251111014)
The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) is inviting outstanding scholars to join our newly established Department of Architecture (ARCH) as Chair Professors, Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors.
PolyU is going to establish the Department of Architecture under the Faculty of Construction and Environment (FCE) with effect from 1 July 2026. FCE is globally renowned for its excellence in Architecture & Built Environment and Civil & Structural Engineering, both ranked 17 th worldwide by Quacquarelli Symonds (QS Subject Ranking) in 2025. As a new dynamic hub for architectural innovation, the Department aims to consolidate FCE’s academic strengths, drive innovative education and research, attract global talent, and elevate both the Faculty’s and PolyU’s international standing in architecture and advanced technologies.
The Department is looking for enthusiastic and established outstanding scholars to join the team and help build a strong academic community to achieve transformative impact in AI-enhanced and big data driven architectural education and research. Our priority research areas include:
• Architecture Technology and Engineering
• Architecture & Digital Theory
• Urban Planning and Design
• Urban Analytics & Smart Cities
• Sustainable Architecture Design Technology
• Landscape Architecture
• Heritage Conservation / Architectural Heritage
To boost the leadership and impact of PolyU’s research work in areas of significant societal needs and strategic importance, the Strategic Hiring Scheme (SHS) has been introduced to recruit faculty members at all levels and outstanding scholars are invited to join the University under the SHS. Appointees recruited under the SHS should have conducted / led world-leading research that is commensurate with the stage of their academic career. Faculty members recruited through SHS at Chair Professor or Professor level will receive a start-up grant of HKD 5 million or more to support research activities (including the admission of two PhD students, purchase of equipment, hiring of research staff, etc.) in the initial five years, whereas those appointed at Associate Professor or Assistant Professor level will receive a start-up grant of HKD 3 million or more.
For more information about PolyU, FCE and its constituent academic units, please visit PolyU’s website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk .
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) undertake teaching duties at various levels in the above architecture related areas;
(b) engage in programme and curriculum planning, development, validation, accreditation and administration of architecture-related programmes;
(c) supervise undergraduate and postgraduate research projects and theses;
(d) initiate and lead scholarly research projects in their areas of expertise, actively pursue quality journal publications, and seek external research grants to enhance the Department’s research strengths;
(e) undertake relevant administrative duties; and
(f) perform any other duties as assigned by the Dean and the Head of Unit or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should:
(a) have a bachelor degree in Architectural Studies and a master’s degree in Architecture or equivalent, leading to an architect professional qualification;
(b) have a PhD degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering, Urban Planning, Landscape Design or a related discipline;
(c) be a registered architect in Hong Kong and a member of the Hong Kong Institute of Architects or equivalent;
(d) have knowledge of advanced technology related to Architecture and Design, including proficiency in BIM, Revit and other relevant tools;
(e) have substantial years of relevant post-qualification experience, in particular programme development and management;
(f) have a strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(g) have an excellent proven record in research and scholarship achievement; and
(h) be able to demonstrate effective classroom teaching skills and have good interpersonal skills.
Applicants for appointment at Chair Professor level should have an outstanding record of global leadership and research achievement in the community, in addition to substantial years of relevant post-qualification experience.
Applicants for appointment at Professor or Associate Professor level should have a substantial number of years of experience and an excellent record of relevant academic and/or research achievement in the specified field. Applicants with less experience will be considered for appointment at the level of Assistant Professor.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment for Assistant Professor will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Associate Professor / Professor / Chair Professor levels. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 1 December 2025 until the positions are filled .
Apply Now
Posting date: 11 November 2025

b3b9c8f6a4580f3e3d2afa0a.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Information Technology Manager (Application Delivery & Support) (Ref. No.: 26270070)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
Key Responsibilities
Lead and own the Application DevOps function, including application development, support, maintenance, release management, service reliability, and continuous improvement across the application portfolio.
Drive end-to-end solution delivery by overseeing requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation review to ensure successful business outcomes.
Partner with business stakeholders and senior management to understand business needs, define application roadmaps, prioritize demand, and align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
Establish and govern application architecture, integration, security, and development standards to ensure scalable, resilient, and maintainable enterprise solutions.
Lead and develop the Application DevOps team, providing technical leadership, resource planning, performance management, coaching, and career development.
Drive DevOps and SDLC excellence through the implementation and continuous improvement of Agile practices, CI/CD pipelines, source code management, automated testing, release governance, and change management processes.
Manage internal and external delivery resources, including vendors and contractors, to ensure high-quality deliverables, effective resource utilization, and compliance with agreed service levels.
Ensure application quality, security, compliance, and operational readiness, including testing governance, documentation, knowledge management, business continuity, and support transition.
Oversee application service operations, including incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, performance monitoring, and continuous service improvement to meet service level objectives.
Manage application-related projects, budgets, procurement activities, and portfolio lifecycle planning, including application modernization, upgrades, technical debt management, and other duties as assigned.
Perform other IT projects and duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
At least 8 years of relevant experience in application delivery, DevOps, and system development with system integration exposure.
Proven end-to-end ownership of the application lifecycle in production—solution design, development, enhancement, performance optimization, CI/CD and release/cutover, monitoring, incident resolution, and ongoing support.
Strong hands-on programming in Java, PHP, Python, SQL, and RESTful APIs, including application integration and database interaction; experience in plugin/extension development, secure API design/consumption, data modeling/ETL, and integration via web services and SSO/OAuth2/SAML.
Knowledge of the following technologies and tools is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Jira, and test automation tools.
Strong troubleshooting and support capability across application, integration, and database layers, with the ability to diagnose root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Demonstrate proven business analysis capability: elicit and validate requirements; translate them into user stories with acceptance criteria; model current/future states and perform gap/impact analysis
Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify, assess, and resolve complex system and operational issues.
Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences; proactive, self‑motivated, and committed to service quality and delivery.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered a one-year contract (up to 31 August 2027). Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Assistant Global Engagement Manager (role: Global Engagement Manager) (26270149)
Reshaping tomorrow’s global leaders is one of the International Office’s top priorities on the internationalisation agenda. Partnership has taken on new meanings in today’s fast-changing world. The Office works closely with its partners worldwide and the university community to bring innovative and impactful collaborations for tomorrow’s world. It conducts proactive global outreach for branding and partnerships. Innovativeness has been at the core of its success.
The Office is dedicated to nurturing global inclusive generations. It seeks to create a diverse, inclusive and engaged community by offering a truly global education. It connects the university community with world-renowned academics and experts, industry players, as well as senior government officials, by hosting various intellectually stimulating programmes and initiatives (https://intl.hkbu.edu.hk).

Forge and manage strategic partnerships with international universities and organisations to drive student mobility and academic collaboration;
Develop and execute innovative global education initiatives to enhance student learning outcomes and intercultural competencies;
Lead and execute global events and conferences; and
Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders across education and government.
Requirements:
A recognised degree with at least 5 years of work experience;
Good command of written and spoken English is a must;
A confident leader and self-starter with an outgoing personality, positive attitude and ability to build strong, motivated teams;
Able to work effectively with people from different cultures, enthusiastic about working with students, detail-oriented, able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced office; and
Good organisational, coordination, communication and interpersonal skills.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of two years. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement.

Postdoctoral Fellow - Philosophy of Contemporary & Future Science
Department of Philosophy
(Post Ref.: 25/46)
The Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University is one of the best in Asia. Faculty members publish in leading journals in the field, such as Analysis, Australasian Journal of Philosophy, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, Ethics, Journal of Philosophical Logic, Mind, Noûs, Philosophers’ Imprint, Philosophical Quarterly, Philosophical Studies, Philosophy and Phenomenological Research, and Philosophy of Science. The department has a thriving PhD programme and also hosts several Postdoctoral Fellows/Research Assistant Professors.
More information on the research interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.LN.edu.hk/philoso/?page_id=9 .
Requirements
Areas of Specialization:
Philosophy of Science; Formal Epistemology; AI; or Philosophy of Biology, Chemistry, or Physics
These posts arise in connection with a Senior Research Fellowship on ‘Philosophy of Contemporary and Future Science’ awarded to Professor Darrell Rowbottom, which runs from 2022–2027. Professor Rowbottom is now seeking Two Postdoctoral Fellows to join the project team over the course of one to two years.
Details on the project, which involves scientists working with philosophers, can be found at www.pocfs.org .
We are especially interested in candidates whose work connects with the natural sciences, and especially with recent developments therein (such as increased interdisciplinarity and the involvement of AI). However, we are open to considering other applicants with excellent research records and a clear, well-articulated vision of how they can contribute to the project.
The appointee will work as part of the team headed by Professor Rowbottom. b85e3e4105a4d602af70c569.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Human Resources Manager (Ref. No.: 26270049)
The School aims to complete registration as a post-secondary college within one or two years, committed to enhancing the internationalisation and diversification of higher education, and developing distinctive and professional programmes that address the manpower needs of society. Once this strategic development is solidified, it is planned that the role will evolve with a long-term prospect.
The appointee will be assigned to the Human Resources Section of the School to performduties including recruitment and appointment, benefits administration, performance assessment, preparation of staff statistical reports, arrangement of staff training and development, supervision of Officers and clerical staff in daily operation of work. The appointee will be required to support the implementation and rollout of the new HCMS across departments. The appointee will also assist in policy and operation review, system development, and committee work.
Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in human resources management or related disciplines with at least seven years of relevant work experience;
Strong knowledge of Hong Kong employment legislation and HR best practices;
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills;
Excellent command of both written and spoken English and Chinese. Competency in computing applications and data extraction, processing and analysis are essential; and
Preference will be given to those with experience in HRMS platforms and data migration tools.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of applications may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Library
(Post Ref.: 26/164)

b907983dd4431bb470b48e0c.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Management
Closing Date: Until the position(s) is/ are filled
The Department of Management at the CUHK Business School is now inviting applications for the tenure-track position(s) at the Assistant Professor level. We welcome applications from both fresh PhD graduates and seasoned Assistant Professors who are engaged in high-quality scholarship specialized in macro management areas (e.g., strategy, innovation, entrepreneurship, international business, family business, sustainability, etc.) or micro management areas (e.g., organizational behavior, leadership, human resource management, etc.).
Applicants should possess a PhD degree in management or a related discipline; have a publication record commensurate with the years of experience; and be strongly committed to excellence in scholarly research, teaching and service.
Responsibilities include publishing high-quality scholarly research; teaching management courses at the undergraduate and/or graduate levels; and participating in academic and professional activities. The appointee(s) is/are also encouraged to apply for external funding to support research endeavors.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
Appointment(s) will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing in 202 7 , which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation. Salary will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The University offers a comprehensive fringe benefit package, including medical care and housing benefits for eligible appointee(s).
About the Department of Management
The Department of Management offers three specialized concentrations in Entrepreneurship (ENT), Human Resource Management (HRM), and Management of International Business (MIB) in the Integrated BBA Programme, and two Master’s Programmes in Management and Sustainable Global Business. Our competitive curriculum equips students with cutting-edge knowledge in management, a global outlook, an innovative spirit, and a strong sense of social responsibility and integrity, enabling future business leaders to lead transformative initiatives worldwide. For more information about the Department, please visit our website at https://www.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/departments/management/ .
About CUHK Business School
The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong, China. Since its establishment in Hong Kong, China in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in the Asia Pacific.
The Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (MBA, MSc, MAcc, EMBA, DBA, MPhill, PhD) with over 6,500 students from 30+ countries/regions, as well as executive education programmes. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 49,000 alumni around the world. It comprises two Schools and four Departments:
Schools
- Accountancy
- Hotel & Tourism Management
Departments
- Finance
- Decisions, Operations and Technology
- Management
- Marketing
Application Procedure
Applicants should submit the application package online via the CUHK career site (including s completed on-line application form, full resume, publication list, and evidence of teaching excellence, if any), and provide names and email addresses of at least three referees for providing reference.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .
Review of applications will be conducted on a rolling basis and will continue until the position(s) is/are filled. For enquiries, please contact the Department of Management via mgt@cuhk.edu.hk .
Interested scholars are welcome to connect with Department colleagues at upcoming major conferences to learn more about the Department. These include the 2026 AOM Conference (Philadelphia, US), the Department’s AOM Reception (Philadelphia Marriott Downtown, August 2, 2026), and the 2026 AIB Conference (Manchester, UK).

Information Manager (Virtualisation Services)
Information Technology Services Centre
(Post Ref.: 25/237)
Responsibilities
The appointee will be responsible for (i) overall planning, evaluation, implementation and management of the server virtualization infrastructure and Hyper Converged Infrastructure (HCI), including SAN storage and SAN switches; (ii) capacity/performance planning, life cycle control/management of virtualisation hardware, software and virtual machines; (iii) development and management of the campus-wide IoT infrastructure; (iv) preparing and maintaining the backup policies for virtual machines; (v) overseeing miscellaneous network supporting systems including DNS system, mail gateways, network and server monitoring tools, etc.; (vi) working with other ITSC teams in the development and management of on-campus and off-campus backup and recovery systems; (vii) working with other ITSC teams in the development and management of the container and orchestration infrastructure; and (viii) other tasks as assigned by supervisors. The appointee is also required to work in shifts and irregular hours.
Requirements
Applicants should have (i) a Bachelor's Degree or above in Computer Science; Information Technology, Information Engineering or equivalent; preferably a higher degree in relevant disciplines; (ii) at least 8 years of relevant IT experience, with preferably 3 years in management or a similar role; (iii) strong technical skill and solid hands-on experience with enterprise-grade virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, Sangfor) and related infrastructure components (hyperconverged infrastructure, servers, storage, networking); (iv) solid experience in IoT infrastructure, container technologies and backup and recovery systems (covering hardware, software and applications); (v) strong technical knowledge of common TCP/IP protocols (e.g. SMTP, LDAP, DNS, and DHCP) and operating systems (Linux and Windows); (vi) knowledge of information security, business continuity, and risk management; (vii) strong organizational and project management skills to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines; (viii) good customer service attitude and customer service experience; and (ix) excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Candidates with less/more experience will be considered for appointment at a relevant rank.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and gratuity.

Chair Professor and Dean
Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies
(Post Ref.: 26/180 )
The University is looking for a Chair Professor in the Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies to provide strong academic leadership in both research and teaching, and to contribute to the management and development of the Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies. The appointee is expected to have top tier scholarship on sustainability and the environment, and have experience in leading interdisciplinary studies. Specific research areas may include climate change and carbon neutrality, clean energy and energy storage, material genomics and the AI/ML-assisted design of advanced materials, and sustainable environments and infrastructure for AI adoption.
The appointee will be concurrently appointed as Dean of the Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies ( https://www.ln.edu.hk/academics/wu-jieh-yee-school-of-interdisciplinary-studies ). The appointee will be expected to provide academic and administrative leadership in teaching, research and curriculum development, and to drive translational knowledge transfer through transformative research-academia-industry capacity building.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (a) a PhD degree in a relevant discipline with substantial teaching experience; (b) a strong international reputation and an outstanding track record of high impact research publications and competitive research grants; (c) strong research leadership capabilities and experience, with a commitment to supporting faculty development in research and providing effective research supervision to students; and (d) previous administrative leadership experience at the Department or Faculty/School level will be a distinct advantage.
Lingnan University is fully committed to the pursuit of excellence in both teaching and research. Candidates are required to provide evidence of quality teaching and information on their research records. The appointee is expected to have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and services to the School and the University community, and to engage actively in quality research and publication.
Appointment
A globally competitive remuneration package commensurate with the appointee’s qualifications and experience will be offered. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund (retirement benefits scheme), gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
Appointment with substantiation/tenure will normally be considered.

Candidates should have (a) a PhD degree in a relevant discipline with substantial teaching experience; (b) a strong international reputation and an outstanding track record of high impact research publications and competitive research grants; (c) strong research leadership capabilities and experience, with a commitment to supporting faculty development in research and providing effective research supervision to students; and (d) previous administrative leadership experience at the Department or Faculty/School level will be a distinct advantage.
Lingnan University is fully committed to the pursuit of excellence in both teaching and research. Candidates are required to provide evidence of quality teaching and information on their research records. The appointee is expected to have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and services to the School and the University community, and to engage actively in quality research and publication.

A globally competitive remuneration package commensurate with the appointee’s qualifications and experience will be offered. Faculty Global Talent Recruitment Scheme
About the Faculty of Medicine
The motto of the Faculty of Medicine at CUHK is 'Transforming our Passion into Perfection'. The Faculty, established in 1981, now comprises 19 teaching departments/schools/units covering the entire range of pre-clinical and clinical disciplines, including the School of Biomedical Sciences, The Nethersole School of Nursing, the School of Pharmacy and The Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care. Its teaching hospital, Prince of Wales Hospital, provides more than 1,900 hospital beds and is also home to numerous medical and clinical research activities. With a team of around 1,500 full-time teaching and research staff and the back-up of the teaching hospital, the Faculty offers courses in 8 undergraduate programmes and around 60 postgraduate study programmes. The Faculty of Medicine also provides continuing and professional training for public health and healthcare professionals. In 2024-25, the numbers of undergraduate and postgraduate research students in the Faculty have reached 3,600 and 700 respectively.
About the Scheme
The Faculty of Medicine is now inviting applications under the Faculty Global Talent Recruitment Scheme. We welcome global talents with strong potential for scientific and scholarly breakthroughs across all disciplines to join us as Research Assistant Professors, Assistant Professors, Associate Professors, and Professors. Further information about the Faculty Global Talent Recruitment Scheme is available at https://www.med.cuhk.edu.hk/about-us/career .
Strategic Recruitment Areas
Applications are especially encouraged from scholars in the following priority areas:
· Infectious Diseases
· Academic Breast Surgery
· Cardiovascular Science
· Neuroscience
· Advanced Cell Therapies and Novel Oncological Treatments
· Chemical Engineering for New Drug Discovery and Development
· Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
Competitive Compensation and Benefits
Successful applicants under the Faculty Global Talent Recruitment Scheme will be offered a competitive compensation package, including start-up support, relocation support and other benefits such as housing allowance, annual leave, academic leave, medical benefits and retirement benefits.
Requirement and Application Procedures
Applicants for non-clinical positions should be holders of PhD degree. For clinical positions, applicants should have a medical qualification, preferably with a higher medical qualification in the relevant discipline. Please send in applications via the e-recruitment system. Your application should include:
· Cover Letter (Specifying the position applied for and your Department/School/Unit of interest)
· Curriculum Vitae
· Research & Teaching Statements
· Three Key Publications
The search will go on until the best candidates are presented for decision. The University reserves the right to fill the posts by invitation.

c50bccf9fc5f80ecb723e742.description:
Department of Health Technology and Informatics
Clinical Associate / Teaching Fellow in Radiography
(Ref. 260310002)
[will be conferred the title of Assistant Professor of Practice / Lecturer respectively]
Building on over 40 years of educational excellence in Hong Kong, the Department of Health Technology and Informatics (HTI) advances world-class teaching and research in four key medical fields (4M): Medical Laboratory Science, Medical Imaging & Radiation Science, Medical Physics, and Medical Data Science.
HTI cultivates future leaders with both professional expertise and scientific vision, fostering an inclusive learning environment that produces top graduates for Asia and beyond. At the forefront of innovation, HTI drives impactful research and technological breakthroughs in the 4M areas. Through cutting-edge scientific discovery and collaborations with leading global institutions, we deliver groundbreaking innovations with profound societal impact.
Explore more: www.polyu.edu.hk/hti
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) teach undergraduate/postgraduate courses and supervise students in their clinical training;
(b) perform other teaching support functions such as supervising students in projects and seminars;
(c) contribute to programme planning, administration and development;
(d) engage in teaching, learning and scholarly activities;
(e) carry out academic and administrative duties as required; and
(f) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Unit or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
For all posts , applicants should have a higher degree in Medical Imaging and Radiation Science (MIRS) or a related discipline.
Applicants for the Clinical Associate post should also have a qualification registrable with the Radiographers Board of the HKSAR and not less than five years of post-registration clinical experience in Radiography.
Applicants for the Teaching Fellow post should also have not less than five years of post-qualification tertiary teaching experience and/or relevant professional or practical experience.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
Consideration of applications will commence on 24 March 2026 until the position is filled.

Research Assistant Professor
Division of Science
(Post Ref.: 26/129 )
The Division of Science (formerly known as Science Unit) (DoS) was established in 2015, comprising a dedicated team of scholars and researchers with expertise in biodiversity conservation, ecology, and sustainability analytics. The DoS offers 4 programmes in the field of environmental science and sustainability, including: (1) Minor in Environmental and Scientific Literacy; (2) MPhil in Environmental Science; (3) PhD in Environmental Science and
(4) Master of Science in Sustainability and Environmental Analytics. Apart from teaching and research, the DoS is highly engaged in community outreach and knowledge transfer activities. We promote science education and sustainable development through immersive field visits and internships, citizen science initiatives, and Service-Learning projects.
The Division of Science (DoS) invites applications for the position of Research Assistant Professor in Geoinformatics. We seek an outstanding and well-rounded scholar with expertise in geoinformatics, geographical information systems (GIS), remote sensing, geospatial analysis, or related fields. The successful candidate is expected to obtain externally funded research projects, publish in high-quality peer-reviewed journals, and contribute to teaching and student supervision at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in a liberal arts setting. The appointee should also have the ability to develop and manage geospatial applications and to work with NGOs and external partners in support of knowledge transfer, applied research, and professional service.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (1) a PhD/Post-doctoral experience in the field of geography, GIS, remote sensing, GeoAI, or a related discipline; (2) relevant postdoctoral and/or independent research experience; (3) a good publication record in peer-reviewed, international journals; (4) a track record in competitive grant applications and fundings; (5) the ability to contribute to the Division of Science’s teaching at all levels, student supervision, outreach, knowledge-transfer, and services; (6) experience in developing, managing, and applying geospatial applications, tools, or platforms; and (7) the ability to contribute to the university’s goal of producing socially significant research that informs sustainable development. Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment. The appointees are expected to submit applications for RGC grants, other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. The remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click "Apply Now" to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will start immediately and continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

c5c8ee1874baf027fe27fe67.description:
Department of Management and Marketing
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Management
(Ref. 260421011)
The Department of Management and Marketing (MM) is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Business. According to the 2025 US News and World Report Global University Ranking, PolyU is ranked 58 th in the Best Global Universities and 25 th in the Best Universities for Economics and Business (7 th in Asia). The University of Texas at Dallas ranks our faculty's research 38 th in the world and 5 th in Asia (as of March 2026).
MM currently has around 60 full-time academic staff who are dedicated to providing cutting-edge knowledge and practical skills for our students in three key areas of business — Management , Marketing , and Management Information Systems . We offer a full range of programmes leading to the awards of Doctor of Philosophy, Master of Science, and Bachelor of Business Administration. Our doctoral program has successfully placed our PhD students in elite institutions in Asia and Australia, including Hong Kong University of Science & Technology, City University of Hong Kong, Renmin University, and Deakin University.
The Management discipline of the Department invites applications for open-ranked faculty positions in the Organisational Behavior and Human Resources (OBHR) and Strategic Management areas . The faculty members in the Management discipline of MM regularly publish their research in top-tier journals such as the Academy of Management Journal , Journal of Applied Psychology , Strategic Management Journal , Organization Science , Journal of International Business Studies , and other premier outlets. Our research support includes a reduced teaching load in the first three years, generous start-up grant, and considerate administrative services for junior members.
The department has a collegial environment. Currently the OBHR team includes Wu Liu, Michael Bond, Krishna Savani, Yi (Amy) Ou, Jia (Katrina) Lin, Jun (Melody) Zhang, Ren Li, Mannok Wong, Zhishuang (Olivia) Guan, Jingfeng Yin, and Kun Wang; the Strategic Management team includes Chinien Chung, Shuping Li, Xueyong Zhan, Qi Zhu, Hangjun Cho, Junghyun Mah, and Qinyu (Ryan) Wang.
Please visit the website at https://mm.polyu.edu.hk/ for more information about MM. Applicants are invited to contact Professor Wu Liu, Professor of Department of Management and Marketing by email at wu.liu@polyu.edu.hk or Professor Chinien Chung, Associate Dean and Chair Professor of Strategic and Organization Management by email at chinien.chung@polyu.edu.hk for further information about the post.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) engage in top-level scholarly research in their areas of expertise;
(b) supervise research students;
(c) secure external competitive research grants;
(d) teach at the undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels; and
(e) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Unit or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in Management or a relevant discipline at the time of appointment or be close to receiving it; and
(b) a focused research orientation and the potential or demonstrated ability to publish in high quality scholarly journals.
Conditions of Service
The compensation package, teaching loads, and research support are highly competitive. Initial appointment for Assistant Professor will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Associate Professor / Professor levels. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
C onsideration of applications will commence on 2 July 2026 until the position is filled .

c66cb5bec6bafcf8c4098c3f.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Surgery
Closing Date: Until the post(s) is/are filled
Founded in 1982, the Department of Surgery focuses on excellence in clinical work and scholarly research, with a strong commitment to education and training. Over the past decades, these values have been at the core of our academic activities. Located within the Prince of Wales Hospital, the Department of surgery offers opportunities in clinical and laboratory research in basic sciences as well as biomedical engineering. We are committed to improving care for our patients through research in clinical outcomes and have been at the forefront of both endoscopy and laparoscopy technology. We are looking for candidates who can contribute to the continuous growth of the Department.
Applicants should have (i) a doctoral degree; (ii) substantial postdoctoral experience in the following research area(s): oncology research, biomedical research, surgical sciences, mechatronics engineering or related disciplines; (iii) strong research accomplishments in grants and publications; (iv) active involvement in writing grant proposals; (v) the potential to become an independent researcher in obtaining future/sustained extramural funding as principal investigator and establishing significant externally-funded research programmes; (vi) a strong sense of responsibility and team spirit; (vii) capability to mentor postgraduate students and junior researchers; and (viii) an excellent command of both Chinese and English.
The appointee(s) will (a) work closely with faculty members in the Department in translational research; (b) conduct research in the identified research area, generate high impact research papers and secure extramural funding; (c) undertake teaching at undergraduate and postgraduate levels; and (d) undertake administrative duties in the Department, Faculty and University.
Further information about the scope of services provided by the Department is available at https://www.surgery.cuhk.edu.hk/
Appointment(s) will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to performance and approval, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation [for Professor(s) / Associate Professor(s) / Assistant Professor(s) only].
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time Associate Degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. The appointee will provide administrative support to the Guidance Counsellors and Administration teams at the Shek Mun Campus Student Development Centre (SDC); deliver on-site logistics for student activities and events, including setup and dismantling, registration, and venue coordination; drive student participation through targeted outreach and follow-up; support the collection, verification, and tracking of data related to activities and services; and plan, create, and publish content across SDC social media channels.
Requirements:
A recognised bachelor’s degree is required;
Relevant experience is preferred;
Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (both Cantonese and Putonghua);
Effective communication and interpersonal skills;
Outgoing, proactive, detail-minded and independent personality with strong sense of responsibility;
Proficiency in computer applications. Skills and experience in graphic design, video production and website management are preferred; and
Fresh graduates and candidates with less experience, but with a strong portfolio, are also welcome to apply.
The appointee will be required to serve on the Shek Mun campus in Shatin.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

cad7aafc59ac66ba5b7df2a9.description:
Research Assistant Professor(s)
Department/ Unit: Department of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences
Closing date: until the post is filled
The Department of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences, always “in search of excellence”, is working with more than 200 ophthalmologists and visual scientists in Hong Kong and Mainland China. We are committed to advancing clinical services, research, training, and education, to the highest standard in all major areas of Ophthalmology and the visual sciences. We are also dedicated to worthwhile community programmes and public education.
We are committed to supporting career development of all staff members and are looking for candidates with (i) effective, intelligent, energetic, resourceful, and forward-looking work attitude; (ii) personal integrity, sincerity, and teamwork. Local and overseas applications are both welcome.
Applicants should possess: (i) a PhD degree and a strong academic background in biomedical engineering, translational chemistry, biomaterials, or molecular biology; (ii) preferably at least two years of postdoctoral research experience; (iii) a competitive publication record in leading peer-reviewed journals, demonstrated research achievements, preferably related to ophthalmology; and (iv) a strong ability to lead research projects, with self-motivation, initiative in problem-solving, and clear potential to rapidly develop into an independent Principal Investigator. Proven research experience and success in securing research funding will be advantageous.
The appointee(s) will be responsible for (a) conducting, coordinating and supervising independent and/or collaborative research projects on drug discovery and modification/drug delivery system development/disease mechanisms; (b) actively pursuing external research grants; (c) supervising research students and staff; (d) administrative tasks related to research; and (e) performing other departmental tasks as assigned.
Appointment(s) will initially be made on contract basis for up to two years (with contract-end gratuity for a 2-year contract) commencing as soon as possible, renewal subject to good performance and mutual agreement.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

FACULTY OF ARTS AND SOCIAL SCIENCES
ACADEMY OF LANGUAGE AND CULTURE
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Language and Culture (25260541)
The Academy launched 1st July, 2024, is a dynamic academic unit, comprising three disciplines/departments: English Language and Literature (ENG), Humanities and Creative Writing (HMW), and Translation, Interpreting, and Intercultural Studies (TIIS) under the Faculty. Our vision is to be a leading centre of excellence fostering linguistic diversity, creative expression, and intercultural communication. We empower students and scholars to bridge cultural divides and innovate in literary, linguistic and translation arts, contributing to a globally interconnected world. The Academy offers multiple programmes, including BA (Hons) in English Language and Literature, BA (Hons) in Humanities, BA (Hons) in Creative and Professional Writing, and BA (Hons) in Translation, along with a range of taught postgraduate programmes.
We seek candidates with expertise in one or more of the following areas:
Cultural Studies, Visual Cultural Studies, and Media Studies (including aesthetics, gender studies, health humanities, and environmental humanities)
Translation and Artificial Intelligence (including translation and interpreting technologies, machine learning, and AI applications in translation)
Translation and Cultural Studies (including digital humanities, cultural identities, and intercultural communication)
Candidates should demonstrate a strong commitment to transdisciplinary and innovative teaching and research, and to advancing the humanities, languages, and translation through creative and/or computational approaches, as appropriate to their fields. Department/ Unit: Faculty of Social Science
Closing date: Until the post is filled
The Faculty of Social Science invites applications for the post of Professor. The appointee will be expected to serve as the inaugural Director for the new inter-Faculty undergraduate programme in Diplomacy and International Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK). This innovative programme aims to nurture high-level, interdisciplinary talent who are proficient in both Chinese and Western cultures and are prepared to excel in international relations, international organizations and diplomatic arenas. With a particular focus on China’s role in global governance, the programme sees to students’ developing a deep understanding of the historical, cultural, and political dimensions of China’s engagement in international affairs. The Faculty is seeking a visionary leader with demonstrated commitment to teaching, programme management, and the development of this distinctive new initiative. For more details about the programme, please visit: https://socsc.cuhk.edu.hk/diplomacy-and-international-studies/introduction/ .
The appointee will be responsible for:
(a) leading the development and continuous improvement of the new inter-Faculty undergraduate programme in meeting international standards;
(b) fostering interdisciplinary collaborations to ensure the development of and adherence to the international standards in research and teaching;
(c) providing leadership and strategic direction in alignment with the academic missions of CUHK and the participating Faculties; and
(d) enhancing global connections in the field of international studies and diplomacy.
Applicants are expected to have:
(i) a PhD degree in International Relations/International Law or related disciplines;
(ii) a distinguished record of academic achievements and international recognition in research, scholarship and teaching;
(iii) proven record of leadership and extensive administrative experience at senior levels, preferably in a prominent research institution;
(iv) demonstrated ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration; and
(v) strong international network and experience in programme development.
Appointment is targeted to start in August 2026 or as soon as practicable thereafter. Outstanding candidate may be specially considered for substantive appointment forthwith.
Application Procedure
To apply for the post, please complete the online application form, and submit a letter of interest, CV, teaching statement, research statement, representative research outputs, and past teaching performance records.
Review of applications will commence from mid-May 2026. Applications will be considered until the post is filled.

Senior Project Officer
Office of Service-Learning
(Post Ref.: 26/197)
The Office of Service-Learning (OSL) is seeking creative, self-motivated, and independent educators to lead the design, development and delivery of innovative programmes at undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate levels. The appointee will play a key role in shaping strategic directions for programme development, promotion and marketing, teaching and learning enhancement, course evaluation, international partnership development, and engagement with industry and professional bodies. The successful candidate is also expected to drive impactful Service-Learning initiatives, foster interdisciplinary collaboration, and contribute to the continuous advancement of the University's educational mission.
Responsibilities:
• Assist Programme Managers in overseeing day-to-day programme administration and operations
• Coordinate co-curriculum learning programmes, including local Service-Learning initiatives and internship opportunities for UG students
• Organize and manage interdisciplinary overseas programmes and experiential learning activities for UG students
• Liaise with faculty members, community partners, NGOs and industry stakeholders to develop and implement high-impact Service-Learning projects
• Build and maintain networks with international partners to develop collaborative courses and programmes
• Prepare proposals for grant applications and funding initiatives
• Prepare programme reports, funding reports, project evaluations, outcome assessments, and other documentation required for quality assurance, accreditation, and stakeholder reporting
• Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Office
Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree with solid qualitative analytical experience; a full-time Master’s or PhD is highly preferred
• At least 4 years relevant experience in the education sector
• Proven experience in organizing and managing overseas programmes, study tours, Service-Learning projects, or summer camps in the higher education sector
• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, resources management and communication skills
• Excellent command of both written and spoken English
• Demonstrated willingness to spearhead AI and technology-enabled Service-Learning (S-L) initiatives
• Undertake overseas travel, including to remote and under-resourced regions, to oversee project delivery, engage community partners, and support student learning and development
• Site visits and work irregular hours may be occasionally required, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays
• Proven track record of establishing and maintaining partnerships with NGOs is advantageous
Candidate with less experience will be considered for the position at the rank of Officer.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
The rank and commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and
experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical
and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund and gratuity.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only .
We are an equal opportunities employer . Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified .

Department/ Unit: School of Hotel and Tourism Management
Closing date: Until the position is filled
About CUHK Business School (Faculty of Business Administration)
The CUHK Business School is a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific region. The Business School comprises two schools – Accountancy and Hotel & Tourism Management; and four departments – Finance, Decision Sciences & Managerial Economics, Management, and Marketing.
The Business School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes (DBA, MBA, MSc, MAcc, EMBA, MPhil, PhD) with over 4,600 students, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 40,000 alumni around the world.
About the School of Hotel & Tourism Management
The School of Hotel & Tourism Management (SHTM) is an integral part of the CUHK Business School. It was established in 1998 in view of the growing significance of the hospitality industry in Hong Kong and Asia. The SHTM’s mission is to develop leaders for the hospitality and real estate industries through a broad-based business education. It now comprises a dynamic group of academic and professional teaching staff members supported by a team of teaching, research and administrative support staff as well as a food and beverage team.
The SHTM offers programmes at different levels to nurture future leaders for the hospitality and real estate industries. The following is a list of the undergraduate and postgraduate programmes:
BBA in Hospitality and Real Estate
MSc in Real Estate
MPhil-PhD in Business Administration
The CUHK Business School now seeks to appoint a Director of School of Hotel & Tourism Management. Reporting to the Dean of Business Administration, the Director will serve as a key member of the Business School’s leadership team and will have overall responsibility for academic leadership and administration in the SHTM. The ideal candidate should be a visionary and collaborative leader who excels at enhancing the quality and reputation of SHTM’s academic programmes and research, and strengthening connection with business communities, and should have:
a strong track record of scholarly eminence in the area of hospitality and/or real estate and demonstrate commitment to research and teaching excellence;
a doctoral degree in hospitality, real estate or other related business disciplines;
strong record of teaching and research experiences in a research university or other tertiary institutions;
administrative experiences in previous tertiary institutions and/or companies with strong communication and networking skills;
an international outlook as well as regional knowledge; and
strong established networks in hospitality and real estate industries.
Previous studying/working experiences outside Hong Kong are highly valued.
Appointment of Directorship will be made on fixed terms basis for three years and subject to renewal, as appropriate. An academic appointment will also be made either on substantive rank (with tenure) or fixed terms concurrently.
Application Procedure
The CUHK Business School is engaging the executive search firm, Perrett Laver Ltd., on this search. Applications should consist of a full CV detailing academic and professional qualifications and relevant achievements. It should be accompanied by a cover letter describing how candidates meet the selection criteria, why the appointment is of interest, what they believe they can bring to the role, and a statement describing strengths and experiences in advancing the research, teaching, connection with the profession as well as community engagement in their previous and/or current institutions. For a confidential discussion about the position, please contact Mr Kenny Mak via Kenny.Mak@perrettlaver.com or +852 3702 6493.
Review of applications will begin in December 2022, and will continue until the position is filled. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for informal discussions, on campus visits and interviews subsequently, as appropriate.

Assistant Professor
Department of Philosophy
(Post Ref.: 26/177)
The Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University is one of the best in Asia for the study and research of analytic philosophy. More information on the research interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.ln.edu.hk/philoso .
General Requirements
The department is interested in hiring a new Assistant Professor in ethics (broadly understood to include value theory, normative ethics, metaethics, and applied ethics) or in philosophy of AI.
Candidates should have obtained, or be about to be awarded, a PhD in Philosophy, and possess a strong track record of publications in the top journals in the field. Candidates without publications will not be considered. The appointee is expected to produce internationally excellent research and obtain competitively awarded research grants. Teaching experience at the undergraduate or taught master’s level will be an advantage. The appointee is also expected to have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and to design and offer courses in their area of expertise.
The teaching load will normally be four courses per year, which may be reduced under various circumstances, e.g. on receipt of external research funding or due to graduate supervision. English is the language of instruction with the possible exception of courses in Chinese philosophy.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The minimum basic salary is over HKD 934,000 / USD 120,000 per year on the current salary scale. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of three years, which, subject to review and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment with the possibility of consideration for substantiation (i.e., tenure). The preferred commencement date is January 2027, with a later start negotiable.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application.
Applicants should submit the following documents: (1) a curriculum vitae; (2) a cover letter; (3) one writing sample; (4) a teaching portfolio (including syllabi of courses taught or willing to teach, and course evaluations, if any); (5) a research statement (describing past and current research, future research plans, and plans for applying for external research grants); and (6) the names and contact information of three referees (who will be contacted if the candidate is shortlisted). Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will begin on 20 July 2026 and continue until the internal selection panel has identified a list of candidates. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration. For strictly clarificatory questions regarding the application procedure, candidates may contact Prof. Andrea Sauchelli (andreasauchelli@ln.edu.hk).
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

General Requirements
The department is interested in hiring a new Assistant Professor in ethics (broadly understood to include value theory, normative ethics, metaethics, and applied ethics) or in philosophy of AI.
Candidates should have obtained, or be about to be awarded, a PhD in Philosophy, and possess a strong track record of publications in the top journals in the field. Candidates without publications will not be considered. The appointee is expected to produce internationally excellent research and obtain competitively awarded research grants. Teaching experience at the undergraduate or taught master’s level will be an advantage. The appointee is also expected to have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and to design and offer courses in their area of expertise.
The teaching load will normally be four courses per year, which may be reduced under various circumstances, e.g. on receipt of external research funding or due to graduate supervision. English is the language of instruction with the possible exception of courses in Chinese philosophy.
Appointment
The conditions of appointment will be competitive. Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The minimum basic salary is over HKD 934,000 / USD 120,000 per year on the current salary scale. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee. Appointment will normally be made on an initial contract of three years, which, subject to review and mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment with the possibility of consideration for substantiation (i.e., tenure). The preferred commencement date is January 2027, with a later start negotiable.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application.
Applicants should submit the following documents: (1) a curriculum vitae; (2) a cover letter; (3) one writing sample; (4) a teaching portfolio (including syllabi of courses taught or willing to teach, and course evaluations, if any); (5) a research statement (describing past and current research, future research plans, and plans for applying for external research grants); and (6) the names and contact information of three referees (who will be contacted if the candidate is shortlisted). Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will begin on 20 July 2026 and continue until the internal selection panel has identified a list of candidates. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration. For strictly clarificatory questions regarding the application procedure, candidates may contact Prof. Andrea Sauchelli (andreasauchelli@ln.edu.hk).
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
