d3545ca4f36a42883c67ee21.description:
FACULTY OF ARTS AND SOCIAL SCIENCES
ACADEMY OF GEOGRAPHY, SOCIOLOGY AND INTERNATIONAL STUDIES
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Government and International Studies (25260816)
The Academy invites applications from high-calibre candidates for the above positions in the discipline of Government and International Studies (GIS), which has particular strengths in the study of politics and international relations in Europe and the Asia-Pacific region.
The appointee is expected to strengthen the Academy’s research profile and contribute to teaching in one or more of the following areas:
International Relations
European Government and Politics
Public Policy (especially technology, or well-being, related)
Applicants should hold a relevant doctoral degree and demonstrate an excellent record of research and publication, commensurate with the rank applied for. An ability to contribute to French language teaching or to bring expertise in advanced quantitative and computational methods would be a strong advantage. Candidates for Professor and Associate Professor should also show a clear track record of success in competitive grant applications and evidence of research leadership.
The Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor position is tenure-track, with an initial fixed-term contract of three years commencing as early as possible or in January / August–September 2027. Tenured appointment is normally expected to be attained within six years. Exceptionally strong candidates may be considered for direct tenure.
Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

香港浸會大學持續教育學院為大學七個學院的其中一所學院，提供不同學科的全日制及兼讀制課程，為發展迅速的社會培訓各方面的人材。
本院於2026-27年度開辦 應用教育文憑課程 ，旨為中六離校生及有志進修的人士，提供全人教育。本院現誠意招聘以下科目之兼職導師，加入應用教育文憑課程教學團隊。
應用教育文憑課程 (全日制)
科目範疇:
必修科目 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0062/25-26) Apply Now
中國語文 / 英國語文 / 普通話
補充科目 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0063/25-26) Apply Now
數碼公民 / 生涯規劃 / 人際傳意與個人發展
選修科目1 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0064/25-26) Apply Now
紀律人員課程 : 警隊工作概論 / 紀律人員道德操守與價值觀 / 消防工作概論 / 香港入境事務概論
運動教練 : 體適能與健康生活 / 運動教練技巧概論 / 運動基礎
選修科目2 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0065/25-26) Apply Now
商業管理 : 管理學原理 / 人力資源管理學概論 / 消費行為
銀行金融 : 銀行服務與運作 / 財務策劃精要 / 金融工具與投資
選修科目3 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0066/25-26) Apply Now
傳媒學 : 電子媒體製作基礎 / 公共關係及廣告概論
市場營銷 : 市場學原理 / 銷售及行銷管理 / 廣告與網上營銷
選修科目4 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0067/25-26) Apply Now
電腦學 : 程式編寫及數據庫應用 / 互聯網應用及網絡保安 / 網頁及流動應用程式編寫
食品安全管理 : 基礎食品科學 / 環境健康與食品衛生 / 食品安全和品質控制
選修科目5 (Ref. No.: PRSCEP0068/25-26) Apply Now
社會服務 : 社會工作技巧
健康護理 : 基礎健康護理 / 復康與社康護理 / 領袖心理學 / 人類成長與社會關懷
授課語言
粵語
申請資格:
1) 申請人須具備以下基本條件：
(i)大學學位、(ii)最少兩年相關之專業經驗及(iii)具備相關之教學經驗。
持有碩士學位及/或教育文憑者將獲優先考慮。
2) 若申請任教英國語文或普通話科目，除符合上述基本條件外，必須符合香港教育局訂明的教師語文能力要求（英文/普通話）或
具備同等資格。
3) 若申請選修科目屬於專業領域，符合以下條件的申請人，亦可考慮申請任教相關科目:
(i) 持有相關領域的文憑資歷，並具備最少五年相關領域的專業工作經驗；或
(ii) 具備最少十年相關領域的專業工作經驗。
申請程序
申請人可透過香港浸會大學網上求職系統 ( https://jobs.hkbu.edu.hk ) 遞交申請。如截止申請日期後三個月內未獲面試通知則作落選論。有關大學"收集個人資料聲明"的資料可瀏覽 https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy 。學院保留權利取消招聘以上所刊登職位，而聘用條款會根據聘用時之情況而定。
甄選程序將一直進行直至有合適人選為止。

d53bd3831131f06c25f7210c.description:
FACULTY OF ARTS AND SOCIAL SCIENCES
ACADEMY OF LANGUAGE AND CULTURE
Senior Lecturer / Lecturer I / Lecturer II in Translation, Intercultural Studies, Digital Humanities and Transdisciplinary Teaching & General Education (25260539)
The Academy launched 1 July, 2024, is a dynamic academic unit, comprising three disciplines/departments: English Language and Literature (ENG), Humanities and Creative Writing (HMW), and Translation, Interpreting, and Intercultural Studies (TIIS) under the Faculty. Our vision is to be a leading centre of excellence fostering linguistic diversity, creative expression, and intercultural communication. We empower students and scholars to bridge cultural divides and innovate in literary, linguistic and translation arts, contributing to a globally interconnected world. The Academy offers multiple programmes, including BA (Hons) in English Language and Literature, BA (Hons) in Humanities, BA (Hons) in Creative and Professional Writing, and BA (Hons) in Translation, along with a range of taught postgraduate programmes.
We seek candidates with expertise in one or more of the following areas:
Translation, Intercultural Studies and Digital Humanities (including translation & interpreting, cultural studies, language technologies, AI applications in translation)
Transdisciplinary Teaching & General Education (including humanity, culture & civilization, values & the meaning of life, and culture, creativity & innovation)
Responsibilities:
Teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses, both within and beyond the Academy’s programmes.
Participating in the development and enhancement of curriculum.
Contributing to the academic and administrative duties of the Academy.
Engaging in teaching and learning development activities appropriate to their level of appointment.
Requirements:
Candidates should have a PhD in a relevant discipline related to the programmes offered by the Academy, demonstrate a strong commitment to transdisciplinary teaching collaborations, open to adoption of technologies to facilitate teaching and learning, both within the Academy and other academic units in the Faculty. Preference will be given to applicants with university level teaching experience in (i) bridging intercultural studies, humanities, and values education, with a strong commitment to whole person education; (ii) in teaching both undergraduate and post-graduate courses; (iii) teaching in international context in the areas mentioned above; and (iv) demonstrating bilingual proficiency in English and a second language, preferably Chinese, where relevant to the position.
Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Applicants are requested to upload their (a) CV, (b) the most recent teaching evaluation results and (c) teaching statement to the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. All application materials will be disposed of after completion of the recruitment exercise. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

d5b7d20761dcca4a7854f1c4.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Human Resources Officer (Ref. No.:26270054)
The School aims to complete registration as a post-secondary college within one or two years, committed to enhancing the internationalisation and diversification of higher education, and developing distinctive and professional programmes that address the manpower needs of society. Once this strategic development is solidified, it is planned that the role will evolve with a long-term prospect.
The appointee will be assigned to the Human Resources Section of the School to perform core human resources functions, including but not limited to supporting recruitment activities, staff training and development, benefits administration, and compiling reports. He/She will be required to support the implementation and rollout of the new HCMS across departments and perform any other duties as assigned by supervisors.
Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in human resources management or related disciplines with at least one year of relevant work experience (Candidates possessing a Diploma/sub-degree qualification with substantial years of relevant work experience will also be considered);
Effective communication and interpersonal skills;
Excellent command of both written and spoken English and Chinese. Competency in computing applications and data extraction, processing and analysis are essential; and
Preference will be given to those with experience in HRMS platforms and data migration tools.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one year contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of applications may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions then applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Part-time Lecturers in Information Technology and Mathematics
Faculty of Science and Technology [Ref.2026/ACAD024]
Faculty of Science and Technology
The Faculty of Science and Technology at UOW College Hong Kong is dedicated to equipping students with the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in today’s fast-evolving technological landscape. Offering a diverse range of programmes—from aviation operations and computer science to environmental and sustainable development—the faculty blends academic rigor with practical training to prepare students for both local and global career opportunities.
Students benefit from hands-on learning experiences, an industry-relevant curriculum, and pathways to further studies, including articulation to the University of Wollongong in Australia. With a strong emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation, the faculty nurtures future professionals in fields such as logistics, media production, information systems, and emerging technologies like UAVs and generative AI.
Whether pursuing a bachelor’s degree, associate degree, or higher diploma, students at the Faculty of Science and Technology are empowered to become forward-thinking contributors to society and industry.
We are currently recruiting part-time instructors to support teaching in Associate Degree programmes:
Subject areas include:
AI Applications and Literacy
Programming
Game Development
Data Communication Theory and Network Administration
Mathematics
Duties
Appointees are expected to undertake the following tasks:
Deliver engaging and practical lessons aligned with curriculum guidelines.
Prepare teaching materials and assessments.
Support student learning and provide constructive feedback.
Participate in occasional meetings or training sessions as required.
Requirements
Applicants must meet the following requirements:
A relevant academic qualification (Master’s degree or above) in the subject area.
A minimum of two years’ of teaching experience in post-secondary education and/or relevant industry experience;
Strong communication and classroom management skills.
Preference will be given to candidates who are available to teach during daytime hours on weekdays.
Salary and Conditions of Service
Remuneration package will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Information and Application
Please submit a Cover Letter together with a Curriculum Vitae and a completed Application Form to UOWCHK, c/o Human Resources Unit, UOW College Hong Kong, 1/F, 18 Che Kung Miu Road, Tai Wai, N.T., Hong Kong or by Email: uowchk-hr@uow.edu.au . The Application Form is available for download under “Job Applications” on our website.
Please note that applications submitted without a complete Application Form will not be processed . Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please quote the reference number in the application. Applications will receive full consideration and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
UOWCHK is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to the principles of diversity, inclusiveness and equality. Personal data provided by applicants will be used strictly in accordance with UOWCHK’s personal data policy and for recruitment and other employment-related purposes.

d82e5a7d6e4546f2a699f8eb.description:
Department/ Unit: School of Accountancy
Closing Date: Until the positions are filled
Join Our Dynamic Faculty at the School of Accountancy
The School of Accountancy at the CUHK Business School is now inviting applications for the positions of Professors / Associate Professors / Assistant Professors, commencing duty in July-August 2027. Applications from qualified scholars in all specialty areas of accounting (including financial accounting, managerial accounting, auditing, taxation, accounting information systems) or information technology related to business applications will be considered.
Applicants should have a doctoral degree (or one that is close to completion) in accounting, finance, or economics. The appointee will be required to teach postgraduate and undergraduate accounting or accounting program-related courses and will be expected to publish in top-tier accounting/finance journals.
For assistant professor positions, appointments will initially be made on a contract basis for up to three years, which subject to demonstration of the requisite level of performance and mutual agreement may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation (tenure) later.
Salary, teaching load and faculty support are comparable to that of top US business schools and based on qualifications. A research start-up fund will be provided to support the appointees’ research general expenses and research support staff.
Attractive Compensation and Benefits

d9f76cc6c7802949034fa56f.description:
SCHOOL OF CREATIVE ARTS
ACADEMY OF MUSIC
Finance Manager (Creative Hub) (26270101)
The School of Creative Arts (SCA), comprised of three well-established academic units: the Academy of Film, the Academy of Music, and the Academy of Visual Arts. Established on July 1, 2022, SCA is dedicated to nurturing future-ready talents for Hong Kong and beyond, while making a significant impact on society through innovative research and transdisciplinary studies. SCA is inviting applications for the position of Finance Manager for the Jockey Club Creative Hub and other education projects.
Responsibilities:
Lead the financial planning and monitoring processes for the creative hub and other education projects including monitor project expenditure and financial performance against approved budgets and funding allocations, ensuring effective use of resources and compliance with funding requirements;
Oversee procurement, contract administration, reimbursement, and payment processes in accordance with relevant guidelines;
Oversee manpower planning and human resources administration for funded projects, including recruitment coordination, contract renewals, onboarding arrangements, leave records, and personnel-related matters;
Establish and maintain systems to monitor project milestones, deliverables, key performance indicators, and reporting schedules; and
Undertaking other duties and special assignments as required.
Requirements:
A recognised bachelor’s degree preferably in Finance, Business Administration, Cultural Management or a related discipline;
A minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in project administration or budget management, preferably in the education, arts and cultural sectors;
Excellent command of both written and spoken English and Chinese, including Putonghua;
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with a high level of attention to detail;
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions; and
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written / skills assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract of two years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to performance review, mutual agreement and funding availability.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after the closing date may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the positions are filled.

ACADEMY OF FILM
Chair Professor / Professor / Professor of Practice and Director (25260536)
Overview
The Academy of Film is a leading force in cinematic and creative media education, with aspirations that extend well beyond Hong Kong’s local film market. Its influence is reflected in the achievements of its respected faculty—many of whom are distinguished filmmakers and scholars —and its alumni, who are recognised across Asia and beyond. In recent years, the Academy has furthered its global engagement through initiatives such as the Global University Film Awards, which have garnered significant international attention and participation. State-of-the-art facilities support this vision, including the recent installation of two world-class virtual production studios, ensuring students and faculty work at the cutting edge of industry practice. Supported by strong industry connections and a commitment to excellence, the Academy of Film continues to cultivate talent equipped for the global screen industries. Established as the Department of Cinema and Television in 1991, today’s Academy of Film has grown into a leading hub for screen and media education. Renamed in 2009 to reflect its broader ambitions, the Academy is now part of the School of Creative Arts alongside the Academy of Music and Academy of Visual Arts, supporting a multidisciplinary approach that extends to art-tech and global entertainment business. Energised by innovation and driven by a spirit of creative exchange, the Academy of Film is a place for makers and thinkers ready to push boundaries and shape the future of screen arts.
Details of the post
The Academy of Film seeks an inspiring, visionary Director to lead the school at the intersection of traditional film scholarships and the rapidly evolving landscape of film and media production. Working to advance scholarship, promote creative and artistic accomplishment, education and civic engagement, and encourage distinctive curricular design and development, the Director fosters a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports faculty research and secures inspiring, future-focused learning experiences for students. A vital element of the role is forging and deepening partnerships with filmmakers, studios, and technology leaders across the creative industries, ensuring engagement with current industry trends and real-world projects.
Supporting the University’s research mission, the Director will advance the faculty’s scholarly activities, including opportunities afforded by interdisciplinary approaches. The Director serves as the Academy’s public voice, articulating its contributions to local, state, regional, cross-border and international communities.
Ideal candidates will be recognised for scholarly and/or professional achievement, with demonstrated leadership and administrative experience in a creative environment and academia, and a strong commitment to education and scholarship. The Director manages a large number of academic and administrative staff across Film/TV, Acting for Global Screen, MA in Producing, MFA in Film Production, and PhD studies.
While the Directorship will demand significant time commitment to management and administrative duties, it is expected to be a concurrent appointment alongside an academic position in the Academy, with the appointee contributing to research and teaching activities.
The successful candidate will be appointed to the rank of Chair Professor/Professor/Professor of Practice. Candidates with exemplary academic or professional achievements may be considered for an Endowed Professorship in Creative Arts.
Requirements:
For Chair Professor / Professor , a doctorate degree in relevant discipline with distinguished record in research and academic leadership;
For Professor of Practice , a master of Fine Arts (MFA) or master’s degree (MA) in relevant discipline, with a minimum of 15 years of high-level professional experience in the film industry and an established national or international reputation;
Proven experience with emerging technologies in Film/Cinematic Arts, Media Production;
Solid track record of collaborating effectively across academia and the creative industries;
Commitment to diversity, equity, and fostering inclusive excellence; and
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Salary and rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Terms of Appointment:
The University offers a competitive package which include gratuity/retirement benefits, annual leave, medical and dental coverage, monthly cash allowance and relocation allowance, as applicable. Direct tenure may be offered to exceptionally strong candidate.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Part-time Lecturers in KOL Marketing and Generative AI
Faculty of Science and Technology
[Ref.2026/ACAD018]
The Faculty of Science and Technology at UOW College Hong Kong is dedicated to equipping students with the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in today’s fast-evolving technological landscape. Offering a diverse range of programmes—from aviation operations and computer science to environmental and sustainable development—the faculty blends academic rigor with practical training to prepare students for both local and global career opportunities.
Students benefit from hands-on learning experiences, an industry-relevant curriculum, and pathways to further studies, including articulation to the University of Wollongong in Australia. With a strong emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation, the faculty nurtures future professionals in fields such as logistics, media production, information systems, and emerging technologies like UAVs and generative AI.
Whether pursuing a bachelor’s degree, associate degree, or higher diploma, students at the Faculty of Science and Technology are empowered to become forward-thinking contributors to society and industry.
We are currently recruiting part-time instructors to support teaching in the EDB Applied Learning (ApL):
KOL Marketing and Generative AI (course details at EDB website: https://www.edb.gov.hk/attachment/tc/curriculum-development/cross-kla-studies/applied-learning/course-information/2026-2028/23_AI%20in%20Biz%20Data(26-28)_c.pdf )
Duties
Appointees are expected to undertake the following tasks:
Deliver engaging and practical lessons aligned with curriculum guidelines.
Prepare teaching materials and assessments.
Support student learning and provide constructive feedback.
Participate in occasional meetings or training sessions as required.
Requirements
Applicants must meet the following requirements:
A relevant academic qualification (Master’s degree or above) in the subject area.
A minimum of two years’ of teaching experience in post-secondary education and/or relevant industry experience;
Strong communication and classroom management skills.
Preference will be given to candidates who are available to teach during daytime hours on weekdays.
Salary and Conditions of Service
Remuneration package will be highly competitive, commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Information and Application
Please submit Cover Letter together with a Curriculum Vitae and a completed Application Form to UOWCHK, c/o Human Resources Unit, UOW College Hong Kong, 1/F, 18 Che Kung Miu Road, Tai Wai, N.T., Hong Kong or by Email: uowchk-hr@uow.edu.au . The Application Form is available for download under “Job Applications” on our website.
Please note that applications submitted without a complete Application Form will not be processed . Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please quote the reference number in the application. Applications will receive full consideration and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
UOWCHK is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to the principles of diversity, inclusiveness and equality. Personal data provided by applicants will be used strictly in accordance with UOWCHK’s personal data policy and for recruitment and other employment-related purposes.

Office of Council/Court Business and Governance Administration
(Post Ref.: 26/145)
Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end secretariat support for Council and Court, including agenda planning, paper quality assurance, records and minute-keeping, action tracking, and follow-up

assigned

• Proven experience in committee/secretariat work, including drafting policy papers, reports, proposals, minutes, and speeches; experience in the higher education sector in Hong Kong would be an advantage
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure
• Highly organised, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities effectively

IT literacy

Chair Professor
Department of Accountancy
(Post Ref.: 25/208 )
The Department is looking for a Chair Professor to provide strong academic leadership in both research and teaching, and to contribute to the administration and management of the Department of Accountancy, and to the development of the Faculty of Business. It is expected that the appointee can contribute to AI, data science and STEM-related accounting research in alignment with the University’s strategy and to significant leadership service.
General Requirements
Candidates should have (a) a PhD degree in a relevant discipline with substantial teaching experience; (b) a strong international reputation and an outstanding track record of high impact research publications and competitive research grants; (c) strong research leadership capabilities and experience, with a commitment to helping other faculty develop their research and providing research supervision to students; and (d) previous administrative leadership experience at the Department or Faculty level will be a distinct advantage.
Lingnan University is fully committed to the pursuit of excellence in both teaching and research. Candidates are required to provide evidence of quality teaching and information on their research records. The appointee is expected to have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and services to the Department, the University community, and to engage actively in quality research and publication.
Appointment
Internationally competitive start-up packages are available for the successful candidate. A globally competitive remuneration package commensurate with the appointee’s qualifications and experience will be offered. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund (retirement benefits scheme), gratuity, and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointee.
Appointment with substantiation/tenure will normally be considered.
Application Procedure (online application only)
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their providing references. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

dc8d206e18fa9a1eeab32243.description:
Division of Artificial Intelligence and the Humanities
Assistant Professor in Artificial Intelligence and Humanities (two posts)
(Ref. 260326010)
The Division of Artificial Intelligence and the Humanities (AIH), a constituent academic unit within the Faculty of Humanities, is dedicated to advancing innovation at the intersection of artificial intelligence and humanistic inquiry. Positioned at the forefront of emerging technologies, AIH aims to promote the development of human-centred AI that enhances society through ethical, creative, and interdisciplinary approaches.
The Master of Science in Generative AI and the Humanities programme, launched in 2024 as the first-of-its-kind in Hong Kong and the world, serves as a flagship initiative of the Division. The programme is designed to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of AI’s impact on language, communication, the arts, and culture, and to prepare them for leadership in an AI-driven future.
AIH invites applications for multiple faculty positions across all academic ranks, with a preference for appointments at the Assistant Professor level. We seek applicants who are committed to leading the integration of AI into humanities-focused education, research, and knowledge transfer. Areas of particular interest include language science and technology, neuroscience and health, language teaching and learning, and Chinese history and culture. Ideal candidates should possess strong programming skills and solid understanding of AI methodologies, along with a deep engagement with humanistic inquiry and its broader potential. The ability to work collaboratively across departments is essential.
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) undertake teaching duties at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels, and contribute to programme and curriculum development;
(b) supervise students and their projects at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels;
(c) conduct research in related areas and contribute to the development of the AIH’s strategic research areas;
(d) initiate, lead, and participate in scholarly research in his/her area of expertise that leads to publications in top-tier refereed journals and awards of external research grants;
(e) contribute to departmental service; and
(f) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Division or his/her delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should:
(a) have a PhD degree in relevant disciplines;
(b) demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(c) have a proven track record in research and academic achievements; and
(d) be able to demonstrate effective classroom teaching skills, with the ability to use English as the medium of instruction.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 25 April 2026 until the positions are filled .
Apply Now
Posting date: 26 March 2026

SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time associate degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus. It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage. Applications are now invited for the following position:
Assistant Programme Officer (Ref. No.: 25260745)
The appointee will be responsible for providing operational and administrative assistance to the academic/teaching-related matters at the College of International Education (CIE). SCHOOL OF BUSINESS
DEPARTMENT OF ACCOUNTANCY, ECONOMICS AND FINANCE
Executive Officer (26270143)
The appointee is expected to provide comprehensive administrative, secretarial, and operational support to the Department, with a strong focus on academic matters and effective liaison with internal stakeholders to achieve smooth coordination of departmental and School activities.
Responsibilities:
Academic and office administration: Provide full-range secretarial and administrative assistance, including office management, office operations, document preparation, record maintenance, class scheduling, examination arrangements, and teaching assignment coordination.
Enquiry handling : Manage departmental enquiries, correspondence, and requests from faculty members, students, and administrative offices, to maintain timely and professional responses.
Stakeholder liaison : Liaise with internal stakeholders, including faculty members, master programme officers, central offices (RO, FO, HRO, GE Office, Student Affairs Office), and other administrative units to facilitate departmental operations and academic coordination.
Student and teaching support : Coordinate student-related activities and promotional events; support teaching and learning initiatives; and provide facilitation of academic matters to assist faculty members.
Event management : Coordinate and execute departmental events, seminars, workshops, and meetings, including logistics, publicity, and post-event reporting.
Project and compliance support : Assist in departmental and school-level projects, including data collection, reporting, compliance monitoring, and quality assurance exercises.
Perform any other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Academic qualiﬁcation : A recognised bachelor’s degree, preferably in business administration, management, or related disciplines.
Work experience: Preferably 3 years of relevant administrative experience; experience in tertiary institutions or academic programme administration is an advantage, and experience in sizable organisations with structured operations and multi-stakeholder coordination will also be considered.
Language proﬁciency : Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese (Putonghua and/or Cantonese).
Technical skills : Proﬁciency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); familiarity with university systems and databases is an advantage.
Communication and liaison skills : Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise effectively across multiple offices and stakeholders. Able to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team.
Organisational skills : Demonstrated ability to manage academic matters and support programme operations under tight timelines.
Professional attributes : High sense of responsibility, attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to service excellence.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written test and an interview. The initial appointment will be offered on a ﬁxed term contract of 2 years commencing as soon as possible. Re-appointment thereafter will be subject to mutual agreement.
Salary will be commensurate with qualiﬁcations and experience.

Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after the closing date may consider their applications unsuccessful. [RF: 2025/26-PT-254-JDB]
Duties: The appointee will undertake part-time teaching duties for courses offered by Social Sciences, College of Humanities and Law. Teaching areas may include design thinking, critical reasoning, critical thinking, leadership, the impact of management styles on followers, customer service, and coaching skills. Well-organised, detail-minded, highly self-motivated, and the ability to work independently under minimal supervision; and

Senior Research Officer
Division of Science
(Post Ref.: 26/221 )
The Division of Science ( http://www.LN.edu.hk/dos ) would like to invite applications for the above-mentioned post.
The appointee will join a joint research team bringing together the Freshwater Biodiversity & Ecosystem Functioning Lab (led by Dr. Alphonse Tsang) and Applied Ecology and Conservation Laboratory (led by Dr. Roger Lee). The candidate will play a key role in managing an aquatic insect conservation project in South Lantau’s freshwater marshes.
Responsibilities
• Conduct field surveys in freshwater marshes to establish an ecological baseline for aquatic insects
• Curate and digitize aquatic insect specimen collections
• Establish a DNA barcoding library for aquatic insects in freshwater marshes
• Conduct and advance environmental DNA (eDNA) methods in freshwater marshes
• Oversee project progress and prepare progress reports
• Prepare educational and public outreach materials to promote aquatic insect conservation
• Perform other education- and research-related duties assigned
Requirements
• A recognized master’s degree (or above) in earth/environmental sciences, life sciences, biology, or a related discipline
• Proven field survey and data analytics experience, with a strong passion for ecological research and biodiversity conservation
• An outstanding level of physical fitness, including the ability to conduct demanding, full-day outdoor fieldwork carrying equipment in freshwater marshes
• Knowledge and experience in bioinformatics and eDNA analysis are a plus
• Strong organization and communication skills (both written and spoken) to compile research data for reporting, creating clear public educational content, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders
Applicants with prior experience in bioinformatics and ecological surveys are highly encouraged to apply for this position.
Salary and Benefits
Commencing salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits, where applicable, include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, and mandatory provident fund.
Appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract for 12 months with the possibility of a further extension on related research projects.
Application Procedure
Please click " Apply Now " to submit your application. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are an equal opportunities employer. Review of applications will start immediately and continue until the post is filled. Qualified candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, or to fill the post by invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

e2740294511aee88ccb6ce27.description:
Jockey Club STEM Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (2024/25)
Postdoctoral Fellow
(Post Ref.: 24/341 )
Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly
funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and
has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher
education. It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a
focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a
better world. Moving forward, Lingnan University aspires to become a
comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful
research and innovations.
Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught
postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts,
Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies
and Interdisciplinary Studies. To foster interdisciplinary collaboration
and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University
Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from
around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students. With
traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary
studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and
critical thinking skills to thrive in the future. Subsequent to the
establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is
transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric
technology and social policies. Further information about Lingnan
University is available at https://www.ln.edu.hk/ .
The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust (the Trust) has set up the Jockey Club STEM Early Career Research Fellowship for Translation and Application (formerly known as Jockey Club Global STEM Post-doctoral Fellowship for Translational Research and Application) and is now inviting applications from early career researchers from all over the world. The Fellowship will provide comprehensive support and unique opportunity to help STEM post-doctoral researchers develop their research and innovation career, expand their professional network and create social impact. The Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong is a Partner Organisation of this Fellowship.
The Fellowship
The Trust provides support for 3 years of full-time appointment for each awardee as Postdoctoral Fellow at the supporting university plus a maximum of 1-year translational research industry attachment.
Terms and Benefits
(a) a stipend of up to $530,000 per annum for three years, with additional 15% gratuity to be offered upon completion of the Fellowship (including the industry attachment when applicable);
(b) academic development and exchange allowance: up to $30,600 per annum for three years;
(c) research project seed funding: up to $300,000;
(d) translational research industry attachment subsidy in an eligible local organisation: the Trust’s contribution to be capped at 50% of the salary (up to $30,000 per month) for a maximum of 12 months in addition to the three-year stipends; and

HUMAN RESOURCES OFFICE
Manager, Learning and Development (26270041)
The Office is looking for a learning and people development professional to support the development and of training and development strategies of the university.
We offer:
A dynamic and transformative environment for passionate, driven and adaptable individuals to develop their skills and career;
Various opportunities to strategise and implement training initiatives that aim to make a difference in employee development and learning; and
Exposure to campaign and projects that build our learning culture.
Responsibilities:
Responsible for the following related to learning and development, including:
Conducting analysis to understand training needs from internal clients;
Designing targeted learning and development strategies;
Developing appropriate learning tools and interventions;
Selecting and managing external vendors;
Executing and overseeing programme delivery; and
Evaluating programme effectiveness and preparing reports.
Supporting corporate HR projects focused on Organisation and Talent Development
Requirements:
A recognised degree, preferably in Human Resources, Language or Communications;
A minimum of 7 years of work experience in managing Learning and Development programme with at least 3 years in a managerial role;
Experience as a trainer / facilitator and an instructional designer
Strong analytical, communication, problem solving and project management skills;
Excellent written and spoken English and Chinese with proficiency in Putonghua; and
A passion in people development, team spirit and strong attention to details.
In addition to the above requirements, candidates with the following experience will be highly preferred:
Knowledge of talent management, career planning, succession planning to ensure learning is aligned with organisational objectives;
Working with HR Business Partners in enhancing organisational performance with learning initiatives;
L&D management experience in public organisations or NGOs would be highly relevant; and
The appointed candidate may be assigned to take up other duties under the O&TD team, such as those related to staff complaint, equal opportunity matters, HR communications, and/or performance management, policy and governance, etc.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a written test and interview(s).
The role is a regular position. The successful candidate will be offered a fixed-term contract of two years.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for an interview 8 weeks after submission of the application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications begins immediately until the position is filled.

e2f3579f9af13e49e1970b8a.description:
Department/Unit: Institute of Chinese Medicine
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
The Institue of Chinese Medicine ( https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/icm/ ) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is seeking exceptional applicants to join Prof. Joan Zuo’s ( https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/icm/director.html ) research team as Research Assistant Professor.
The appointee will (a) apply for external competitive research grants; (b) participate and/or develop in independent and/or collaborative research projects; (c) coordinate research projects and publish peer-reviewed papers; and (d) lead the investigations from the quality control to the pharmacological and mechanistic evaluations of the herbs and herbal products, but also be able to coordinate the trials with the TCM and western physician teams on TCM products.
Applicants should have (i) a PhD degree in Chinese Medicine, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related discipline; (ii) substantial postdoctoral experience in a relevant scientific discipline; (iii) a strong commitment to excellence in research; (iv) ample experiences in above research area(s) as evidenced by publications in international journals; (v) a strong sense of responsibility and team spirit, and (vi) excellent oral and written communication skills.
Applicants should submit an online application and attach (1) a letter of intent, and addresses how your experience matches the qualifications for the position; (2) a proposed plan of research at CUHK; (3) a complete curriculum vitae; and (4) names, addresses and contact information for at least three professional references. Candidates will be consulted before references are contacted, and all grants will be validated with the appropriate funding agency.
Appointment will initially be made on contract basis for up to three years commencing as soon as possible, renewable subject to good performance, funding availability and mutual agreement. The successful candidate shall be considered for potential affiliation with an academic department at CUHK.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

DEPARTMENT OF BIOLOGY
Post-Doctoral Research Fellow (25260578)
Responsibilities:
We currently have an open position for the role of Post-Doctoral Research Fellow. The new member will be tasked with investigating the molecular mechanisms of endoplasmic reticulum-mediated protein quality control using Arabidopsis thaliana as a convenient genetic model system.

Applicants should possess a relevant PhD degree with a solid track record in research. Candidates with strong background and research experience in molecular and cell biology, biochemistry, or genetics are encouraged to apply. e4edd8e86ad7fd2eb70f0b56.description:
Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies
Assistant Professor in Supply Chain and Operations Management
(Ref. 260825003)
The Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies is one of the constituent departments of the Faculty of Business. The Department offers a full range of degree programmes in supply chain and operations management, maritime studies and others. The Department takes a multi-disciplinary approach to establishing an area of excellence in logistics, supply chain, and operations management. It strives to be a key player in Hong Kong’s pursuit to become an international logistics hub.
The Department’s research portfolio lies in both academic and applied research. Professional services to industries are also provided by the academic staff in the form of consultancy in such areas as efficiency and quality improvement studies, market and operational analyses, optimisation, production, purchasing, and supply chain management. The Department also runs various self-financed programmes tailor-made to meet specific industry needs.
Please visit the website at http://www.lms.polyu.edu.hk for more information about the Department.
Duties
The appointee will be required to:
(a) undertake teaching duties at various levels in the area of Supply Chain and Operations Management;
(b) supervise undergraduate and postgraduate research projects and theses;
(c) conduct research in related areas and contribute to the development of the Department’s research strengths;
(d) initiate, lead and participate in scholarly research in their areas of expertise and be active in research leading to quality journal publications and in bidding for external research grants and applied research projects;
(e) engage in programme/curriculum planning, development and administration;
(f) undertake relevant administrative duties; and
(g) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Department or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD degree in a related discipline;
(b) solid experience in teaching and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(c) a proven record in research and scholarships; and
(d) qualities of creativity, initiative and leadership.
Preference will be given to those with prior business/managerial experience in related industries.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Initial appointment will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
Consideration of applications will commence on 1 September 2026 until the position is filled .

Posting date: 25 August 2026

Assistant Officer / Administrative Assistant (26270090)

Responsibilities:
Perform administrative duties to maintain office operation;
Provide administrative and logistic support to office operations, committees, meetings and events;

e6305c61f267065650739c5d.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
Information Technology Manager (Application Delivery & Support) (ref. no.: 26270070)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and own the Application DevOps function, including application development, support, maintenance, release management, service reliability, and continuous improvement across the application portfolio.
Drive end-to-end solution delivery by overseeing requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation review to ensure successful business outcomes.
Partner with business stakeholders and senior management to understand business needs, define application roadmaps, prioritize demand, and align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
Establish and govern application architecture, integration, security, and development standards to ensure scalable, resilient, and maintainable enterprise solutions.
Lead and develop the Application DevOps team, providing technical leadership, resource planning, performance management, coaching, and career development.
Drive DevOps and SDLC excellence through the implementation and continuous improvement of Agile practices, CI/CD pipelines, source code management, automated testing, release governance, and change management processes.
Manage internal and external delivery resources, including vendors and contractors, to ensure high-quality deliverables, effective resource utilization, and compliance with agreed service levels.
Ensure application quality, security, compliance, and operational readiness, including testing governance, documentation, knowledge management, business continuity, and support transition.
Oversee application service operations, including incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, performance monitoring, and continuous service improvement to meet service level objectives.
Manage application-related projects, budgets, procurement activities, and portfolio lifecycle planning, including application modernization, upgrades, technical debt management, and other duties as assigned.
Perform other IT projects and duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
At least 8 years of relevant experience in application delivery, DevOps, and system development with system integration exposure.
Proven end-to-end ownership of the application lifecycle in production—solution design, development, enhancement, performance optimization, CI/CD and release/cutover, monitoring, incident resolution, and ongoing support.
Strong hands-on programming in Java, PHP, Python, SQL, and RESTful APIs, including application integration and database interaction; experience in plugin/extension development, secure API design/consumption, data modeling/ETL, and integration via web services and SSO/OAuth2/SAML.
Knowledge of the following technologies and tools is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Jira, and test automation tools.
Strong troubleshooting and support capability across application, integration, and database layers, with the ability to diagnose root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Demonstrate proven business analysis capability: elicit and validate requirements; translate them into user stories with acceptance criteria; model current/future states and perform gap/impact analysis
Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify, assess, and resolve complex system and operational issues.
Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences; proactive, self‑motivated, and committed to service quality and delivery.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
The initial appointment will be offered a one-year contract (up to 31 August 2027). Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

Department/ Unit: Department of Information Engineering
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
The Department of Information Engineering (IE) has multiple tenure-track faculty openings at the levels of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. In particular, we are looking for strong candidates in the areas of artificial intelligence (broadly defined), internet of things (broadly defined), and optical communications (design and experimental research of the next-generation optical fiber transmission/access networks, optical-wireless terrestrial/underwater systems, etc.). We will also consider outstanding candidates in other areas of information engineering to supplement our existing strength in communication systems, networking, information theory, security, and deep learning research.
Further information about the Department can be found at http://www.ie.cuhk.edu.hk .
Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree; (ii) strong commitment to excellence in research and teaching; and (iii) outstanding accomplishments and research potential.
Appointments will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially commencing August 2026, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation.
Applicants please upload the full resume with a cover letter, copies of academic credentials, publication list with abstracts of selected published papers, a research plan, a teaching statement, together with names and email addresses of three to five referees to whom consent has been given for their providing reference (unless otherwise specified).
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Associate
Professor
School of Graduate
Studies
(Post
Ref.: 26/225)
The School of Graduate Studies (GS) was established
to strengthen the central support for postgraduate programmes and monitor their
quality in alignment with the University’s strategic direction of expanding and
providing quality postgraduate education in the digital era. To directly
provide professional education for the wider society, the GS also offers a
diverse range of Taught Postgraduate (TPg) programmes under three academic
clusters:
1. Policy and Education Leadership Cluster, covering public administration, policy studies, and higher education management;
2. Regional Development and Urban Studies Cluster, focusing on regional development, and urban governance, housing studies, and arts and heritage management; and
3. Health, Ageing and Social Innovation Cluster, addressing health services management, ageing studies, gerontechnology, and social innovation and entrepreneurship.
To support the continuous growth of GS TPg programmes,
the School is now inviting applications for the post of Associate Professor.
The appointee is expected to possess research and teaching experiences in one
or more of the following areas:
• Policy studies
• Social policy
• Education policy
• Higher education management
• Health and social care and policy
• Urban
policy
The appointee will be expected to (a) conduct
high-quality research in the state-of-the-art areas in the area(s) specified
above; (b) secure external competitive research grants in various funding
bodies; (c) teach multiple subjects in postgraduate-level programmes in the
area(s) specified above; (d) recruit and supervise research prostrgraduate
students; (e) work on the promotions and admissions as well as the operations
for postgraduate programmes; (f) contribute to academic programme/course
development; and (g) contribute to other administrative duties as required by
the Dean or Associate Dean of GS.
General Requirements
Applicants
should have (i) a doctoral degree in a relevant discipline such as policy
studies, public administration, education management, or other relevant areas; (ii)
a strong publication record and outstanding citation counts in the specific
area(s); (iii) a track record in securing external research grants; (iv) good
experience in teaching and programme administration in the specific area(s);
(v) excellent interpersonal, organisational and communication skills; and (vi) good
command of English and Chinese (including Putonghua). At least six years of
relevant experience in the tenure-track academic post is expected. Preference
will be given to candidates with outstanding academic training and
international exposure.
Appointment
The conditions of appointments will be
competitive. The rank and remuneration will be commensurate with
qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include annual leave,
medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and
incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees. Appointments
will normally be made on a fixed-term contract of up to three years.
Appointment
will normally be made on an initial contract of three years, which, subject to
review and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment with
possibility of consideration for substantiation.
Application Procedure (online
application only)
Please
click " Apply Now " to
submit your application. Applicants shall provide names and contact information
of at least three referees to whom applicants’ consent has been given for their
providing references. Personal data
collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
We are
an equal opportunities employer.
Review of applications will continue until the post is filled. Qualified
candidates are advised to submit their applications early for consideration.
The
University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post
advertised, or to fill the post by
invitation or by search. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be
notified.

LANGUAGE CENTRE
Assistant Learning Technology Developer (25260808)
The Language Centre is seeking a tech-savvy and research-driven AI Learning Technologist to coordinate a critical new initiative for AI-assisted language learning. This role is dedicated to exploring, compiling, and integrating the most effective AI and EdTech tools into a centralised platform to empower student-led language learning.
Responsibilities:
Research, evaluate, and compile Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and applications for student-focused independent language learning;
Develop, and maintain a centralised platform for students to access a curated collection of AI-powered learning tools, incorporating gamification strategies to enhance engagement;
Provide technical support for the Centre’s e-learning initiatives, internal systems, and website management, including troubleshooting and updating web content;
Assist in inventory management, stock-taking exercises, and the operation of the equipment loan service;
Provide technical and multimedia support for Centre functions and activities, including audio-visual setup, photography, and video recording; and
Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisors and the Head of the Language Centre.
Requirements:
Applicants should possess a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Educational Technology or a relevant subject. A strong research aptitude and proven ability in programming (such as Python or JavaScript) for the development and integration of AI tools and web platforms are essential. Knowledge of current trends in generative AI, gamification in education, and API integrations will be a distinct advantage. Experience in website management, multimedia software applications, and providing technical support in an educational setting is highly desirable.
A good command of written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Putonghua will be an added advantage.
The initial appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract of 1-1.5 years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to performance review, mutual agreement and availability of funding.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

e88997a29f6ca6d311358a70.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Educational Administration and Policy
Closing date: Until the position(s) is/ are filled
The Department of Educational Administration and Policy is looking for distinguished scholars for appointment at various professoriate levels in the areas of Educational Leadership and Administration. The Department is one of the four Academic departments under the Faculty of Education of CUHK ( http://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/ ), an international center for professional training and research in Education. Further information about the Department is available at http://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/eap .
Applicants should have (i) excellent academic qualifications including a doctoral degree in educational administration, leadership or related discipline; (ii) a strong research background in areas that will contribute or add to the existing strengths of the Department; (iii) a track record of programmatic research and publications; and (iv) strong commitment to excellence in teaching and scholarship. For Professor/ Associate Professor rank, applicants should have achieved a high standing in the relevant research field and demonstrated academic and international professional leadership.
The appointee(s) will (a) play a key role in teaching and research initiatives in educational administration and leadership; (b) teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses; (c) supervise postgraduate students; (d) obtain external competitive grants; and (e) assist in administrative matters. Concurrent leadership appointment in a research centre of the Faculty on educational leadership could also be considered for candidates with proven academic leadership and an outstanding track record in obtaining and managing diverse funded projects.
Applicants should complete the online application form and upload a full curriculum vitae with details of three referees. Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to funding and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation. Applicants may consider their applications unsuccessful if they are not invited for an interview within 3 months after application.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

e9816677cfb37ccaf8c026b0.description:
Department/Unit: Department of Mathematics and The Institute of Mathematical Sciences
Closing Date: Until the posts are filled
Founded in 1963, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a forward-looking comprehensive research university with a global vision and a mission to combine tradition with modernity, and to bring together China and the West. The Department of Mathematics in CUHK has developed a strong reputation in teaching and research. Many of the faculty members are internationally renowned and are recipients of prestigious awards and honours. The graduates are successful in both academia and industry. The Department is highly ranked internationally, e.g., it is 66th, 63rd and 42nd in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 QS World University Rankings, and 42nd, 56th and 51st in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 US News Rankings, respectively.
The Department is now inviting applications for substantiable-track faculty posts at all the academic levels. The appointees will be affiliated to both the Department and The Institute of Mathematical Sciences. Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree in mathematics or related disciplines; (ii) an established track record in research, including publications; and (iii) a demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching.
Applicants should submit online application form, copies of qualification documents, a publication list and/or selected abstracts, a research plan, a teaching statement, together with the names and e-mail addresses of three to five referees (at least two on research and one on teaching) to whom the applicants' consent has been given for their providing references.
Appointments will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially commencing January or September 2026, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to substantiation or longer-term appointment later.
Review of applications will begin on September 1, 2025.

ee56718e48ca88b1d554464c.description:
Department/ Unit: Department of Sociology
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
Founded in 1963, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a forward-looking comprehensive research university with a global vision and a mission to combine tradition with modernity, and to bring together China and the West. The Department of Sociology has a diverse international community, featuring academic staff and postgraduate students from six continents and fourteen countries over the past five years. In recent years, the Department has gained significant recognition in academic circles, ranking 18th globally in the 2025 QS World University Rankings by Subject. This achievement reaffirms our leadership position and highlights our commitment to academic excellence and impactful research.
The Department of Sociology is now inviting applications for a tenure-track faculty post at Professor/ Associate Professor/ Assistant Professor rank.
Applicants should have (i) a relevant PhD degree by the time of employment; and (ii) a proven record of academic scholarship and (iii) high potential for excellence in teaching and research. Applicants specializing in any of the following three areas are preferred:
• Economic sociology
• Social sustainability
• Digital sociology and technology
The appointee will be responsible for (a) teaching at undergraduate and postgraduate levels; (b) supervising research students; (c) undertaking scholarly research; (d) applying for competitive research grants; and (e) assisting in administrative work.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to mutual agreement, may lead to a longer-term appointment or substantiation. Outstanding candidates with substantial experience for Professor rank may be specially considered for appointment on substantive basis forthwith. The remuneration package will be highly competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The University offers a comprehensive fringe benefit package, including medical care and housing benefits for eligible appointees.
Application Procedure
Please submit the online application form, a letter of interest, CV, teaching statement, research statement, a publication list, and/or abstracts of selected published papers, together with names/e-mail addresses of three referees with consent for providing references.
Consideration of applications will continue until the post is filled.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

Applications are invited for the appointment as Part-time Lecturer in Population and Policy Analysis in the Faculty of Social Sciences (Ref. 537229) , to commence in December 2026 or as soon as possible on temporary term, with the possibility of renewal subject to funding availability and satisfactory performance.
Applicants should possess a Master’s degree in Public Policy, Public Administration, or a related field. They should demonstrate a strong record of either professional practice in policy design and evaluation within institutional settings (e.g., government, NGOs, or consultancy firms), and/or prior teaching experience of similar applied policy courses. Familiarity with drafting policy proposals, agenda-setting, consultations, conducting stakeholder analyses, and applying practical evaluation frameworks (such as logic models or cost-benefit reasoning) is highly desirable. Knowledge of the policy environment in Greater China or East Asia is an advantage. A background in demography, population studies, or quantitative/statistical modelling is not a must.
The appointee will teach the course "Applied Policy Design and Strategy," a generalist elective course offered by the Master of Social Sciences in the field of Population and Policy Analysis programme. He/She will be responsible for developing course materials, and delivering lectures and tutorials throughout a standard 12-week semester. The appointee will be supported by a Teaching Assistant, who will assist with course-related administrative duties and grading tasks.
A highly competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered.
The University only accepts online applications for the above post. Applicants should apply online and upload (1) an up-to-date C.V.; (2) a cover letter; (3) a one-page teaching statement, (4) the contact information of three senior referees familiar with the applicant's academic and professional background; and (5) a teaching portfolio (less than 50MB). Review of applications will start as soon as possible and continue until September 30, 2026 , or until the post is filled, whichever is earlier.

DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
Research Assistant Professor (25260473)
The Department presently offers BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD programmes, and is now seeking outstanding applicants for the position of Research Assistant Professor.
Responsibilities:
The position is created and funded as part of the strategic research development initiatives in the Department. The appointee will be provided with a conducive research environment, and will work within an established group of faculty in the Department. He/she is also expected to perform group-based high-impact research and undertake some teaching duties.
Requirements:
Applicants should possess a PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, and sufficiently demonstrate abilities to conduct high-quality research in one of the Department's key research areas: (i) Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning; (ii) Big Data and Data Management; (iii) Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition; and (iv) Distributed Systems and Networking. These key research areas have a special thematic focus on (a) Health Informatics and (b) Security and Privacy-aware Computing related applications.
The initial appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract of two to three years. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement.
For enquiry, please contact Prof. Jianliang Xu, Head of Department (email: xujl@comp.hkbu.edu.hk ) More information about the Department can be found on its website at https://www.comp.hkbu.edu.hk.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 4 months after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University's Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
The University reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the positions are filled.
